izzyondroid:ac.mdiq.Podcini.A.summary: Your premier podcast/media instrument, now extensible, capable of YouTubing
izzyondroid:ac.mdiq.Podcini.A.description:
Podcini.A, an open source extensible media instrument, attuned to Puccini, adorned with pasticcini and aromatized with porcini, invites your harmonious heartbeats.
 Notable features
 Not only handling podcasts, local media, but also any remote media served by external source providers.
 Features multiple, natural and circular play queues associable with any feed.
 Features volume hierarchies each of which can contain sub-volumes and feeds.
 Presents synthetic feeds and allows media to be separately shelved.
 Remote media (unsubscribed) can be reserved or played.
 Allows online search of remote media provided by external sources.
 Enables setting tags, todos, notes/comments, 5-level rating, and 12-level play state on every media.
 Boasts sophisticated sorting, filtering and searching on media and feeds.
 Supports sleep and auto-play timers.
 Presents 2 independent algorithms for auto-download or auto-enqueue specifiable on every feed.
 Supports spaced repetition of repeat media: auto-download or auto-enqueue them at preset intervals specified in the feed.
 Caches streamed audio for seamless local rewind and replay.
 is capable of playing 2 media simultaneously (one in each ear with earphones) with independent controls.
 Features audio clips recording and position marking on any media for better review.
 Allows linking/relating multiple media for better grouping.
 Is capable of preserving important media when a feed is unsubscribed.
 Spotlights sending/receiving feeds and subscriptions catalogue across devices without a server.
 Supports Podcasting 2.0 transcript and captions from external sources
 Offers Readability and Text-to-Speech for RSS contents.
 Supports auto-backups, customized media folder and importing DB from other apps
 Join the Podcini community! 
 Podcini is under active development by volunteers. You can contribute too, with code, comments or improvements. See source code on github.com/XilinJia/Podcini.A

izzyondroid:com.samco.trackandgraph.name: Track & Graph: Habit Tracker
izzyondroid:com.samco.trackandgraph.description:
Track & Graph: Dashboards for life
 Track & Graph helps you record, visualize, and understand patterns in your daily life. Record numerical values or simple occurrences to build personal dashboards that provide insights into your habits, behaviors, and activities.
 Visualize your data through line graphs, pie charts, and statistical reports that show trends, moving averages, and intervals between events. Organize tracking items into customizable groups that make sense for your needs.

fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.name: ¡Aquí hay tomate! - Pomodoro
fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.summary: Pomodoro timer with a one-cell home screen widget. Dark, fast and quiet.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.aquihaytomate.description:
A Pomodoro timer that fits in one cell.
Every Pomodoro app ships a 2×2 widget at minimum, and it eats your home screen. "¡Aquí hay tomate!" ships a one-cell widget: tap to start or pause, double-tap to reset. No app to open, nothing to hunt for.
Work for 25 minutes, rest for 5, and take a long break every four Pomodoros. Or set it up however you like — every duration is yours.
Actually reliable. It fires on the right second with the screen off, after you swipe the app away, and after a reboot. A timer that runs late is no timer at all.
And good-looking. A black background and a red tomato that drains as time passes. No giant buttons, no toy interface.
Main features:
• 1×1 home screen widget: start, pause and reset without opening the app
• Full cycles of focus, short break and long break
• Every duration configurable, plus how many Pomodoros per cycle
• Statistics: completed Pomodoros, time focused, day streak, monthly map and trend
• End-of-slot alert with its own sound and repeat count, one for each end of the slot
• Configurable vibration length
• Optional auto-start of the next slot
• Notification with the countdown and pause, skip and reset buttons
• Respects silent mode and Do Not Disturb
• Spanish and English
No accounts. No cloud. No ads. No tracking. All your data stays on your phone.
The name is a Spanish pun: pomodoro is Italian for tomato, which is where the technique's name comes from. And yes, it also nods to an old tinned-tomato commercial.

fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.name: PassVault
fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.summary: A secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager.
fdroid:com.jksalcedo.passvault.description:
PassVault is a secure, lightweight, and 100% offline password manager for Android.
PassVault is a lightweight password manager that allows users to securely store credentials on their device. All data is stored locally and sensitive information is encrypted using the Android Keystore system. The application does not require internet permissions. User data never leaves the device.
FEATURES:
- Secure Authentication: Access your vault using a PIN or Biometric (fingerprint) login.
- Encrypted Storage: All passwords are encrypted at rest using AES-256 and stored securely in a local Room database.
- 100% Offline-First: The app is fully functional without an internet connection.
- Password Generation: Create strong, random passwords directly within the app.
- Password Strength Scoring: Visual feedback on password security.
- Backups: Import or Export encrypted/unencrypted data
- Automatic Backups: Automatically backup your database with configurable retention and copies per backup.
- Custom Backup Location: Choose where to save your backups using Storage Access Framework.
- Third-Party Import: Seamlessly import existing vault from Bitwarden and KeePass.
- Supports JSON, CSV, and KDBX files.
- Custom Categories: Create and manage your own entry categories.
- Filter/Search Entries
- Block Screenshots: Prevent screen capture for enhanced security.

fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.name: QR Jukebox
fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.summary: Offline audio player for QR-linked music. Ideal for music trivia board games.
fdroid:com.lennardhanss.qrjukebox.description:
QR Jukebox is a lightweight, generic offline audio player designed to bridge the gap between physical objects and digital music. By mapping QR codes to your local music library, it becomes the perfect companion for DIY board games.
 Perfect for Music Trivia Games: This app was designed with versatility in mind. It is highly compatible with popular modern music trivia games (such as Hitster™). If you own a local collection of the songs from your favorite game, you can use QR Jukebox as a fast, privacy-friendly, and 100% offline alternative to the official online player. It even supports original URL structures to make mapping your library a breeze.
 How it works: The app scans a QR code containing a URL and maps it to a specific local audio file by mirroring the URL's path structure in your local filesystem.
 The domain of the URL is the root folder.
 All path segments before the last one are treated as subdirectories.
 The last segment is the track ID (filename prefix).
 Key Features: 
 Offline First: No internet connection required once your media is on the device.
 Privacy Focused: No tracking, no ads, and no cloud sync.
 Metadata and Art: Can display title, artist, album, and fullscreen cover art from ID3 tags.
 Customizable Playback: Set a global start offset (e.g. 30s) to skip intros automatically.
 Game Timer: Optional stopwatch to track "thinking time" per card or scan.
 Easy Navigation: Quick 10s skip buttons and smooth marquee for long titles.
 Supported Formats: .mp3, .m4a, .wav, .flac
 Disclaimer: This app is a generic tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Hitster™ or any other board game manufacturer. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.name: Termux Hub
fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.summary: A lightweight Android app that indexes Termux tools from metadata.
fdroid:com.maazm7d.termuxhub.description:
Termux Hub is a lightweight, open-source Android application that indexes and organizes tools designed for use with Termux .
 It provides a clean, searchable catalog of community tools using a transparent, metadata-driven data pipeline.
 The app focuses on reproducibility and reliability. All tool information is processed automatically from a public GitHub repository,
 validated, and stored locally on your device. Once synced, the local database becomes the single source of truth,
 ensuring fast access even when offline.
 Key features
 Browse and search curated Termux tools by category
 View detailed tool information, installation commands, and repositories
 Daily updates of GitHub star counts and README content (00:00 UTC)
 Offline-first design with local Room database storage
 No trackers, no analytics, no ads
 How it works
 Termux Hub fetches static metadata from GitHub and processes tool data, star counts,
 and README files independently. All validated data is stored in a local Room database.
 If syncing fails, the app safely falls back to cached or bundled data.
 Data sources
 All data is read-only and sourced from the public
 TermuxHub GitHub repository .
 This includes tool metadata, repositories, thumbnails, GitHub stars, READMEs,
 and Hall of Fame entries.
 Privacy
 Termux Hub does not collect personal data, does not require accounts,
 and does not include tracking, analytics, or advertising libraries.
 Contributing
 Anyone can help improve the catalog. To add or update a tool,
 please see the contribution guidelines in
 CONTRIBUTING.md .

fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.name: Tetherbug
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.summary: Your Mac turns on your phone's hotspot when its Wi-Fi disconnects. No taps.
fdroid:ie.xav.tetherbug.description:
When your Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects, Tetherbug turns on your Android phone's hotspot and your Mac joins it, the way Instant Hotspot works with an iPhone. No reaching for your phone, no tapping through settings.
How it works
• Your Mac and phone stay paired over Bluetooth. When the Mac's Wi-Fi disconnects and no known network is around, it asks the phone for its hotspot.
• Tetherbug turns the hotspot on through Shizuku, and your Mac joins it.
• The hotspot shows up in your Mac's Wi-Fi menu as a Personal Hotspot, with the link icon, just like an iPhone's.
• Once nothing has used the hotspot for a while, Android turns it off again. You choose how long.
What you need
• Android 13 or later
• Shizuku, which lets Tetherbug switch the hotspot without root
• A Mac with macOS 14 or later, running the free Tetherbug app for Mac: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug
Private by design
• Tetherbug has no internet access and collects no data.
• Only a Mac you've paired with your phone can see its status or turn its hotspot on, and the Bluetooth link between them is encrypted.
Open source under the MIT license: github.com/xav-ie/Tetherbug

fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.name: Open TimeLimit
fdroid:io.timelimit.android.open.description:
This App (Open TimeLimit) is mostly equal to TimeLimit without the linking of multiple devices.
Flexible
Apps are grouped to categories (a category can contain one or multiple App).
You can chose per category at which times it should be allowed. This allows preventing playing games too late.
Additionally, you can configure time limit rules. These rules limit the total usage duration at one day or over multiple days (e.g. a weekend). It is possible to combine both, e.g. 2 hours per week end day, but in total only 3 hours.
Moreover, there is the possibility to set an extra time. This allows using something longer than regulary once. This can be used as bonus. There is additionally the option to disable all time limits temporarily (e.g. for the whole day or an hour).
Multi user support
There is the scenario that one device is used by exactly one user. However, with tablets, there are often multiple possible users. Due to that, it is possible to create multiple user profiles in TimeLimit. Each user has got different settings and time counters. There are two kinds of users: parents and children. If a parent was chosen as user, then there are no restrictions. Parents can chose any other user as current user.
Notes
It can be a good idea to take a look at https://timelimit.io/en/configsuggestions/ if you don't use TimeLimit in the default scenario.
TimeLimit does not work good at some smartphone brands (mostly Huawei and Wiko). With the correct settings, it can work better. But better is not good.
If it "does not work": This can be caused by power saving features. You can find at https://dontkillmyapp.com/ how you can disable these features. Get in touch with the support if that does not help.
Depending on the Android version, TimeLimit uses the permission for the usage stats access or the GET_TASKS permission. These are only used to detect the currently used App. Based on the currently used App, the App is blocked, allowed, or the remaining time is calculated.
The device admin permission is used to detect an uninstallation of TimeLimit.
TimeLimit uses the notification access to block notifications of blocked apps and to count and block background playback. Notifications and their contents are not saved.
TimeLimit uses an accessibility service to press the home button before showing the lock screen. This fixes blocking in some cases. Moreover, this allows opening the lockscreen at newer Android versions.
TimeLimit uses the permission "draw over other Apps" to allow opening the lockscreen at newer android versions and to overlay blocked Apps until the lockscreen is launched.
TimeLimit uses the location access to detect the used WiFi network and allow/ block Apps depending on it and your settings. The location access is not used otherwise.

fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.name: Megrim: Migraine Log
fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.summary: Private, offline migraine log with automatic on-device pattern insights.
fdroid:org.maegley.megrim.description:
Smart migraine tracking that stays on your device.
Megrim is an open-source, offline-first migraine diary that helps you find your personal triggers. The app automatically adds time-of-day, season, daylight, and moon context to your entries — and, if you opt in, local weather and barometric pressure — calculating correlations entirely on your phone. With no accounts, no cloud servers, and zero tracking, your health data stays completely private and under your control.
What's inside:
* Automatic on-device enrichment — daylight hours, time of day, season, and moon phase computed locally; opt in to add local weather and barometric-pressure change (24h/48h). No manual entry.
* Real personal analytics — migraine days per month (the last 30 days, a 3-month average and a monthly chart), trends by day-of-week, time-of-day, season, daylight, pressure change, and moon phase, plus a "suspected factors" card that uses odds ratios over your own log.
* Clear days count too — tap "No migraine today" to record a good day, and Megrim compares your sleep, stress, triggers and foods on migraine days against clear days.
* Fast logging — one tap starts a migraine, or long-press the app icon and choose "Log migraine". Record symptoms, how much it affected your day, attacks without headache, medications and non-drug relief.
* Medications — classes for acute medications with a monthly medication-days count and a medication-overuse notice, preventives with start and stop dates, and what helped.
* Optional reminders — a daily reminder to log, and a "Migraine in progress" notification with an End button. Off until you turn them on (the notification permission is asked for only then), and never shown on a secure lock screen.
* Your data stays yours — on-device storage only, with full export and import (JSON and CSV), a printable PDF report for your doctor, and an optional backup reminder.
* Optional app lock — open Megrim with your phone's own fingerprint, face or PIN, and hide it in the recent-apps switcher.
* No accounts, no servers, no telemetry — by default the app makes no automatic network requests (the only exception is the place-name search you type when setting your home location). Weather enrichment is opt-in; when enabled, the only network request is to Open-Meteo.com, to fetch weather for the approximate (~1 km rounded) location and date of the entries you create.
* Free and open source (GPL-3.0-or-later).
Megrim is a personal diary and is NOT a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. "Suspected factors" are statistical associations in your own log — association is not causation. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional.
Weather data by Open-Meteo.com.

apple-macos:6783574263.name: BookSmarts
apple-macos:6783574263.description:
BookSmarts is a private EPUB reader and reading tracker built around your own library. Import your books, pick up exactly where you left off, turn every reading session into a clear picture of your reading life, and invite friends into a private Book Club when a story is better shared—without ads or a BookSmarts subscription. No BookSmarts account is required.
YOUR EPUB LIBRARY
• Import DRM-free EPUB books from Files
• Choose a folder for convenient automatic imports
• Continue reading from your saved place
• Organize books and series in Cover Grid
• Build a separate personal bookshelf with decorations, upright books, stacks, and adjustable title direction
• Create local cover-based or classic leather spines, upload your own artwork, or optionally generate full-art spines using your own OpenAI API account (separate provider charges apply)
• Sync saved shelf arrangements and spine artwork through iCloud
A READER THAT GETS OUT OF THE WAY
• Read in a focused, distraction-free view
• Choose page curl, slide, fade, rigid, or scrolling navigation
• Adjust text size and switch between day and night themes
• Save highlights and bookmarks
• Read across the outer and inner displays on iPhone Duo, with an optional two-page Book posture
• On supported iPhone Duo, optionally show cover art on the outer display with Performative Mode (requires an active camera session; no photos or video are recorded)
BUILD A READING HABIT
• Set a daily reading goal in minutes
• Log reading time and pages as you read
• Build streaks and review every reading day on your calendar
• Turn on optional reminders for unfinished daily goals
STATS THAT MEAN SOMETHING
• See reading time, pages, sessions, and completed books
• Follow your reading pace and speed over time
• Explore weekly charts and yearly reading goals
• Keep progress visible with Home Screen and native Mac widgets, including your bookshelf
• Explore finished books as a timeline or yearly bookshelf, and share a themed Year in Review
130 AWARDS TO UNLOCK
• Celebrate milestones for consistency, pages, pace, sessions, and finished books
• See the achievements closest to completion in your Trophy Case
READ TOGETHER IN PRIVATE BOOK CLUBS
• Create invitation-only groups around a book
• Compare chapter, progress, reading time, and standardized pages
• Discuss the story with automatic spoiler protection
• Link your own EPUB—book files are never redistributed
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Your library and reading history stay on your devices and in storage locations you choose
• No BookSmarts account is required
• Create backups of reading data, shelf layouts and saved artwork in a folder you control
• Keep saved spine image copies in your watched folder’s Spine Art folder
• Export reading sessions as CSV
• Optional club details and shared progress sync privately through iCloud
BookSmarts is made for readers who want a quiet, lightweight place to read their own EPUBs, understand their habits, and feel good about the time they spend with a book.

 It supports end-to-end encryption with OMEMO and OpenPGP and allows configuring privacy-related features such as read receipts and typing notifications.

flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.name: Modular Calculator
flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.summary: A powerful, scriptable, modular calculator aimed at scientific, engineering or computing work.
flathub:io.github.jordanl2.ModularCalcul.description:
A powerful, scriptable, modular calculator aimed at scientific, engineering or computing work. Long calculations can be written as a list of calculations, storing results into variables to be used in the next stage. All features can be added, removed, and customised, and new features can be written in python.
 Features:
 Numbers can be in any base and convert to another base
 Variable assignment
 Statistical and trigonometry functions
 Date and time manipulations and calculations
 Boolean logic
 Units, including conversion to other units - metric, US customary and British Imperial units supported
 Arrays - any operator or function can accept arrays as input and automatically execute across the entire array
 String manipulation, including regular expressions - strings can be used as numbers, and vice-versa
 User-defined functions - write your own functions you can then reuse
 Enable and disable any features in the calculator you wish, and customise how features work
 Write your own features in python to add to the calculator

flathub:io.howl.Editor.description:
Howl is a general purpose editor that aims to be both lightweight
 and fully customizable. It is built on top of the very fast LuaJIT
 runtime, and can be extended in either Lua or Moonscript. It has a
 minimalistic UI driven mainly by the keyboard.

flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.name: KCachegrind
flathub:org.kde.kcachegrind.description:
KCachegrind is a profile data visualization tool, used to determine the most time consuming
 parts in the execution of a program.
 Features:
 KCachegrind visualizes profiles (i.e. runtime characteristics) of applications in various
 ways, including call graph visualisations and source/disassembler annotation.
 It can load profiles generated by the cache simulation/call tracer Calltree, a Valgrind tool.
 Thus, profiling does not need any preparation, can cope with shared libraries and plugin architectures,
 and does not influence the measuring itself.
 Converter scripts for OProfile, Perl, and PHP.
 Switching between multiple visualization layouts.
 Call graph can be exported as image (PNG).
 Simultaneous display of 2 event types in Call and Annotation View

flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.name: KMyMoney
flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.summary: Personal finance manager based on double-entry bookkeeping
flathub:org.kde.kmymoney.description:
KMyMoney is a personal finance manager by KDE. It comes with a large set of features while being
 easy to use for the non-technical user.
 It supports different account types, categorisation of expenses and incomes, reconciliation
 of bank accounts and import/export to the “QIF” file format. Direct download using the OFX and
 HBCI formats is also possible via plugins. Online banking support (statement download) is also
 provided for the OFX and HBCI protocols.

flathub:org.kde.skrooge.name: Skrooge
flathub:org.kde.skrooge.description:
Skrooge is a personal finance manager powered by KDE that aims to be simple and intuitive. Skrooge allows you to keep track of your expenses and income, categorize them, and build reports of them.
 Features:
 QIF, CSV, SKROOGE, KMYMONEY import/export
 Microsoft Money, OFX, QFX, MT940, GNUCASH, GRISBI, HOMEBANK and MONEY MANAGER EX import
 Advanced Graphical Reports
 Multiple tabs to help you organize your work
 Infinite undo/redo (even after the file was closed !)
 Instant filtering on transactions and reports
 Infinite category levels
 Mass update of transactions
 Scheduled transactions
 Track refund of your expenses
 Automatically process transactions based on search conditions
 Multiple currencies
 Budget
 Dashboard
 Advice

flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.name: mpz Music Player
flathub:org.mpz_player.mpz.description:
A folder player for big local music collections. Instead of indexing every file into a library,
 mpz treats your files and folders as the library and provides a convenient way to build playlists
 directly from folders.
 The main feature is the three-column UI: a directory tree, the list of playlists, and the tracks
 of the current playlist — similar to Foobar2000's Album List. Choose library folders, middle-click
 a folder, and a playlist is created from it.
 Also supported: gapless playback, a 10-band and parametric equalizer with AutoEq presets, ReplayGain
 volume normalization, internet radio, CUE sheets, a tag editor, cover art and lyrics, MPRIS media
 control, and an experimental MPD client mode.

Groups of degree 32 are not included in Fedora due to the large size of the file (about 266 MB). Download it separately from https://www.math.colostate.edu/~hulpke/transgrp/trans32.tgz if you need it. Groups of degree 48 are not included in Fedora due to the large size of the file (about 30 GB). fedora-packages:ghc-concurrent-extra/ghc.name: ghc-concurrent-extra
fedora-packages:ghc-concurrent-extra/ghc.description: The 'concurrent-extra' package offers among other things the following selection of synchronisation primitives: * 'Broadcast': Wake multiple threads by broadcasting a value. * 'Event': Wake multiple threads by signaling an event. * 'Lock': Enforce exclusive access to a resource. Also known as a binary semaphore or mutex. The package additionally provides an alternative that works in the 'STM' monad. * 'RLock': A lock which can be acquired multiple times by the same thread. Also known as a reentrant mutex. * 'ReadWriteLock': Multiple-reader, single-writer locks. Used to protect shared resources which may be concurrently read, but only sequentially written. * 'ReadWriteVar': Concurrent read, sequential write variables. Please consult the API documentation of the individual modules for more detailed information. This package was inspired by the concurrency libraries of Java and Python.

It comes with a vast variety of pre-built and ready-to-use tools for proteomics and metabolomics data analysis (TOPPTools) and powerful 2D and 3D visualization(TOPPView). OpenMS offers analyses for various quantitation protocols, including label-free quantitation, SILAC, iTRAQ, SRM, SWATH, etc. It provides built-in algorithms for de-novo identification and database search, as well as adapters to other state-of-the art tools like Mascot, OMSSA, etc. It supports easy integration of OpenMS built tools into workflow engines like Knime, Galaxy, WS-Pgrade, and TOPPAS via the TOPPtools concept and a unified parameter handling via a 'common tool description' (CTD) scheme. The OpenMS Proteomics Pipeline is a pipeline for the analysis of HPLC-MS data. It consists of several small applications that can be chained to create analysis pipelines tailored for a specific problem. The TOPP tools are divided into several subgroups: - Graphical Tools - File Handling - Signal Processing and Preprocessing - Quantitation - Map Alignment - Protein/Peptide Identification - Protein/Peptide Processing - Targeted Experiments - Peptide Property Prediction - Misc

firefox-addons:2993471.summary: Protects against phishing, IP loggers, fake downloads & browser scams
firefox-addons:2993471.description:
🛡️ LinkSentry — Your Invisible Bodyguard While Browsing
LinkSentry automatically protects you from phishing, IP trackers, fake downloads, browser lockers, and fake shops — before you even notice.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WHY LINKSENTRY?
Every day, millions of people fall victim to online scams. Scammers are getting more sophisticated — fake websites look identical to real ones, IP loggers hide in harmless-looking links, and fake downloads disguise themselves as popular software.
LinkSentry detects these threats and blocks them at the network level — before your data is ever sent.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FREE FEATURES
🔒 Phishing Protection
Automatically blocks 157,000+ known scam sites from 4 daily-updated feeds. Sites are blocked at network level — they never even load.
📍 IP Logger Detection (UNIQUE!)
Detects 70+ known IP tracking services like Grabify, IPLogger, and more. When someone sends you a tracking link, LinkSentry blocks it before your IP address, location, or device data is ever transmitted.
⌨️ Typosquatting Warnings
Detects when you land on a fake domain that looks similar to a known website (e.g., paypa1.com instead of paypal.com ).
💾 Download Protection
Pauses suspicious downloads (.exe, .msi, .dmg) from unknown or very new domains and warns you before you open them.
🔒 Browser Locker Protection
Prevents websites from freezing your browser with fake virus warnings designed to trick you into calling a scam hotline.
⚙️ Protocol Blocker
Blocks 45 dangerous protocols (ms-settings, steam, discord, etc.) that try to launch programs on your computer.
🔗 Tab Protection
Automatically prevents websites from manipulating your other open tabs (reverse tabnabbing).
🔔 Notification Blocker
Blocks fake captcha tricks that cause browser notification spam on your desktop.
📋 Clipboard Protection
Blocks automatic clipboard access that wasn't initiated by you.
🏪 Fake Shop Detection
Analyzes online shops for suspicious signals: new domain, missing legal pages, crypto-only payments, extreme discounts.
🔒 Form Protection
Warns you when you enter passwords or credit card data on suspicious sites.
🌐 WebRTC Protection
Prevents suspicious sites from reading your real IP address via WebRTC — even if you're using a VPN.
🖱️ Right-Click Scanning
Right-click any link, then "Check with LinkSentry" — instantly see if it's safe without opening it.
📊 Dashboard
Clean dashboard shows you how many threats have been blocked.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRO FEATURES
⭐ Unlimited link scans
⭐ QR Code Scanner — check QR codes before scanning them with your phone
⭐ Email link protection — flags suspicious links in Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo
⭐ Messenger protection — flags links in WhatsApp Web and Telegram
⭐ OAuth consent scanner — warns about dangerous app permissions
⭐ Detailed reports — server country, redirect chain, certificate details
⭐ Evidence export — save evidence reports for law enforcement
⭐ Weekly protection report
⭐ Auto-cleanup — deletes cookies/trackers from suspicious sites
⭐ Fingerprint protection — prevents browser fingerprinting
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PRIVACY & TECHNOLOGY
✅ 100% local — no server, no database, no cloud
✅ Zero data collection — LinkSentry collects no personal data
✅ Open architecture — blocklists from Phishing Army, OpenPhish, URLhaus
✅ Manifest V3 — latest Chrome extension standard
✅ Network-level blocking — declarativeNetRequest blocks threats before a single byte is sent
✅ Auto-updates every 6 hours
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GET STARTED FOR FREE
Full basic protection is and always will be free. Pro adds detailed reports, email protection, and unlimited scans — starting at $1.99/month. 7-day free trial included.

firefox-addons:2792249.name: File System Access
firefox-addons:2792249.summary: The File System Access API allows web apps to interact with files on the local device.
firefox-addons:2792249.description:
This extension brings the File System Access API to Firefox that helps web apps such as https://vscode.dev read and write local files and folders.
Main features:
* Implemented showOpenFilePicker, showDirectoryPicker, showSaveFilePicker functions and related interfaces.
* Set to enable specific File System Access features on matching web pages.
* Provides File System Access API for other compatible WebExtensions.
Notes:
* The local file operations required by this extension cannot be performed in the browser, and a helper app needs to be installed to assist in the related work. 
* The optional Code Editor feature is provided by the Code Editor extension.
Limitations:
* By default, FileSystemHandle will lose its instance methods after cloning (e.g. using IndexedDB or postMessage ), and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.CLONE_ENABLED . Web developers can use __FILE_SYSTEM_TOOLS__.parseHandle(handle) to restore the instance methods.
* Limited Worker context support and requires additional configuration of the FS_CONFIG.WORKER_ENABLED .
* Read file size is limited by the FS_CONFIG.FILE_SIZE_LIMIT . Web developers can read large file streams and slices with handle.getFile({ _allowNonNative: true }) , and write large file in-place with handle.createWritable({ _inPlace: true, keepExistingData: true }) .
* DataTransferItem.prototype.getAsFileSystemHandle is not implemented.
This extension is open source and you can file bug reports or feature requests on the GitHub issue . 
References:
* https://wicg.github.io/file-system-access/

Good-looking
bluejetty:00141222:ios.description:
Need to build your Skin Care routine? Dreaming of a young, healthy and good-looking face skin? Can’t afford regular visits to cosmetologists, or simply don't have enough time for that? Then let ‘forYou’ take care of your face.
Good-looking skin is not simply a matter of DNA! Regular facial fitness and massage are essential if you want your skin to look good at any age.
To begin with, an Augmented Reality (AR) tool investigates your skin type and wrinkles to suggest the best skin care programme and unique skincare routine. Regular cycle of facial massage takes about 15 min, depending on the programme. We offer simple and effective facial massage exercises that you can do at home using your own hands. The result is youthful, toned skin that will shine and impress yourself and people around you. Our face massage programmes are suitable for people of all ages.
Your daily habits have a big impact on what you see in the mirror. With our face massage & fitness app you can master facial massage exercises that stimulate deep layers of the skin. Same as facial yoga, face building is one of the best ways to improve your skin texture. Face fitness routine will allow you to get rid of swelling, tighten your skin, lift cheeks and build a perfect face oval — exactly the one you dreamed of for many years. forYou skincare routine programmes were developed by professional cosmetologists and should be practiced regularly to achieve the desired results. It is suggested to practice face fitness exercises 10-20 min daily over at least 3 weeks to notice positive results. 
Face building can save you money on plastic surgeries: no more expensive cosmetic procedures such as lymphatic drainage and lifting, no more electric massagers. Forget about painful injections, just practice face fitness with forYou following our simple face-lifting techniques.
No matter how old you are, a man or a woman, just launch forYou and start working on your facial skin routine. Using the latest technologies, you can achieve better results in no time. We make this journey completely safe and pleasant by working with the best specialists in cosmetology and dermatology. 
ForYou will help you learn facial massage skills even if you are a complete beginner. Visual instructions will walk you through the process. AR will track your day by day progress and make sure you reach positive results. Our app will make your face fitness routine joyful and pleasurable. No matter how stressful the conditions might be, at home or while on the move. Our face fitness programmes are regularly updated by professional cosmetologists to help your skin look healthy and shiny.

bluejetty:00138101:ios.description:
MathTango makes learning addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division engaging and fun for kids aged 5-10+! 
They’ll progress through hundreds of playful math games for kids – collecting monsters, completing missions, building unique worlds, and discovering lots of fun and surprises along the way. Trusted by parents and teachers, MathTango helps kids learn math skills and build confidence – all while having fun! 
**MathTango is part of Piknik – one subscription, endless ways to play and learn! Get full access to the world's best preschool apps from Toca Boca, Sago Mini, and Originator with an Unlimited Plan.**
PRESS AND AWARDS
• kidSAFE Certified
• Common Sense Media's Best Math Apps for Kids List
• Children's Technology Review Editor's Choice
• Mom's Choice Awards Gold Recipient
• National Parenting Product Awards Winner
• Creative Child Magazine Children's App of the Year Award
• Apple App Store App of the Day
FEATURES
• Over 500 addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division math games for kids covering more than 40 math levels. Review levels help to reinforce what’s been learned, leading to better retention. 
• The lesson plan wizard generates a customized, age-appropriate curriculum for every user.
• A Common Core based curriculum dynamically adapts so a child advances only when they have finished the current lesson.
• Addition and subtraction lessons include 9 types of puzzle games including number patterns, counting, ordering numbers, and more.
• Multiplication and division lessons include 7 types of puzzle games covering multiplying and dividing single digits and factors of 10. 
• Kids learn and explore in two worlds – an island for addition and subtraction, and a starbase for multiplication and division. Each world has never-ending missions that are completed to earn unique characters and dozens of in-game items.
• Math games for kids designed and classroom-tested for kids 5-10+ (Grades K-5)
• Learn on the go! Play the downloaded app without WiFi.
• Multiple user profiles on each device allow the entire family to learn at their own pace.
• 100% ad-free and no in-app purchases.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
MathTango is a subscription service that gives total access to all math games for kids available in the app. You can choose to subscribe on a monthly or annual basis.
New users will have access to a free trial at the time of sign-up. After your free trial, you can choose to subscribe on a monthly or annual basis. If you change your mind at any point, cancellation is easy through your App Store settings.
• When you confirm your purchase, payment will be charged through your iTunes account.
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Don’t want to auto-renew? Manage your account and renewal settings in your user Account Settings.
• You can use your subscription on any device registered with your Apple ID. Like all Apple subscriptions, MathTango can’t use family sharing to share subscriptions across different Apple IDs.
• Cancel your subscription anytime through your Account Settings, with no cancellation fees.
• Questions? Need a hand? Give us a shout at support@playpiknik.com. 
Privacy Policy
Sago Mini is committed to protecting your privacy and the privacy of your children. We adhere to the strict guidelines set forth by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) & kidSAFE, which ensure the protection of your child’s information online. 
Privacy policy: https://playpiknik.link/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://playpiknik.link/terms-of-use
About Sago Mini
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.
Find us on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok at @sagomini.

bluejetty:00024679:ios.summary: SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professiona
bluejetty:00024679:ios.description:
SampleTank 2 for iOS is a professional, fully featured mobile sound and groove workstation that brings the sound, power and features of desktop virtual instruments to your iPad and iPhone — without compromise. It is designed for professional live performance, song composition and puts a comprehensive array of world-class instruments, sounds and patterns right at your fingertips.
SampleTank CS provides all the functionality of the full app, with 23 instruments in 16 categories, so you can try out this powerful workstation for free. Additional sounds are available a la cart via in-app purchase.
SampleTank gives you 8 multitimbral instrument slots that you can easily layer or split. Choose from a comprehensive, expandable sound collection that covers virtually every acoustic and electronic sound imaginable. Plus, each instrument category includes instrument riffs and grooves so you can start composing and playing in no time.
The included instruments and the new sound engine are derived from the desktop version of SampleTank, IK's flagship workstation, offering you unmatched realism, variety of sound and audio performance. For the first time on iOS, thousands of professional sample-based sounds and patterns can be easily accessed, layered and used for playing live or in the studio. 
What’s more, SampleTank offers an ever-growing library of sounds and are available via in-app purchase:
• Elektronika - a series of electronica and EDM-oriented groove libraries and sound collections that make it easy to create hits in today’s most popular styles
• Miroslav Philharmonik — the legendary orchestral libraries, now available on your mobile device! Stunningly realistic and expressive samples of a wide range of orchestra and percussion instruments.
• SampleTank PRO - the latest and most high-end sounds and grooves available, letting you create professional-grade compositions on your mobile device
• Plus additional libraries covering cinematic sounds, the finest pianos, drum libraries from iconic drummers and much more!
SampleTank for iOS offers over 2,300 instruments and over 1,200 MIDI patterns — the largest collection of sounds available for any virtual instrument for iOS.
Features:
• 23 sounds in 16 categories included free
• 8-part multitimbral professional quality sound and groove module
• Expandable sound library with 2300+ instrument
• Over 1,200 melodic and rhythmic patterns
• 8-track MIDI recorder with audio export
• Totally redesigned intuitive interface
• New sound engine derived from SampleTank 3 for Mac/PC
• Zones feature lets you easily create splits & layers on your controller
• Song and Live environments for composing and playing
• Built-in insert effects and master reverb
• MIDI learn feature makes programming external controllers easy
• Plug-and-play compatibility with iRig interfaces and controllers
• Polyphony: up to 64 voices on new Apple devices

bluejetty:00050828:android.description:
Do you think you have what it takes? BE A COACH while you watch live performances on The Voice!
It’s a whole new game. Champion coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson and John Legend return to discover incredible talent in an amped-up season full of thrilling twists, fan-favorite guests and spectacular performances.
Be part of the team that discovers and trains new superstar talent. Watch the competition and build your fantasy team of artists. Compete against fellow fans by answering The Voice trivia questions and by participating in polls to earn points. See where your points stack up on the Leaderboard and check your team's progress over the season!
Watch the auditions and performances live along with champion coaches Adam Levine, Kelly Clarkson and John Legend and their mentors as they search for America's best new talent.
Check out your favorite artists’ Instagram, Facebook and TikTok pages. Sing along and feel just like a coach on NBC’s Emmy Award-winning singing competition show!
Download The Voice Official App now and watch NBC to start building your fantasy team.
 WATCH NBC'S THE VOICE LIVE ON TV
• WATCH LIVE as the show goes on!
• WATCH video clips of your favorite artists’ performances after each episode.
BUILD YOUR TEAM
• PICK your favorite artists and build your own fantasy team. Start with 12 artists and refine your team as the season progresses - just like the coaches.
• EARN points as your artists progress in the competition.
• COLLECT badges as you hit milestones throughout the season.
• ANSWER trivia questions correctly and participate in polls to earn more points.
• PLAY ALONG! Check the Leaderboard and see how you stack up against players across the country.
CONNECT WITH THE VOICE COACHES AND ARTISTS
• CONNECT with your favorite artists instantly via the app.
• FOLLOW the artists on social media.
• LEARN about the artists you love with profiles featuring bios and video clips.
NOTE: If your device is running an Android operating system older than 10, please update your device before using The Voice Official App. If you experience issues, make sure to completely close out of the app, reboot your device and restart The Voice Official App. If issues persist, here's how to contact us: https://www.nbc.com.
Video is accessible via 3G, 4G, LTE and Wi-Fi networks. Data charges may apply.

• Your Privacy Choices: https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy/notrtoo?intake=NBC_Entertainment

bluejetty:00161820:ios.description:
Find your seasonal color palette with StyleIt AI!
Ever wonder why certain clothes make you glow, while others leave you feeling a little… off? With StyleIt AI, you’ll know which colors will make you stand out for all the right reasons. It’s your personal digital color consultant. Whether you’re looking to refine your wardrobe or explore new outfits that complement your natural beauty, our app is designed to give you a complete color analysis, tailored just for you.
Simply upload a selfie, and let our AI analyze your skin tone, hair color, and features to determine your perfect color palette. You’ll receive a detailed season breakdown, a virtual draping feature to visualize different shades and a custom set of colors that flatter you the most. From bold statement colors to everyday neutrals, we’ve got you covered.
But that's not all StyleIt AI goes beyond just telling you your colors. Snap a photo of any outfit, and our AI will score it based on how well it matches your personal palette, and some friendly tips to help you look your best. Whether you're out shopping or just deciding what to wear for the day, StyleIt AI is the pocket stylist.
Key Features:
1. Instant Personal Color Analysis: With just one photo, our AI instantly analyzes your appearance to provide a complete color profile. Whatever your season, you’ll discover the shades that enhance your natural beauty.
2. Virtual Draping: Not sure how a color will look on you? Try our virtual draping feature. It lets you visualize different shades against your skin tone, so you can experiment with your color palette before hitting the stores.
3. Outfit Scoring & Feedback: Get instant feedback on your outfits. Upload a photo of your look and receive a compatibility score based on your color palette and improvement suggestions.
4. Share & Save: Found your perfect color or scored the perfect outfit? Share your results with friends or save them for later! Build your style journey and make shopping for clothes easier than ever before.
Discover the colors that define you. Download StyleIt AI and start your color analysis now.
App questions, suggestions, or problems? Reach out to us at admin@styleIt.app.
Privacy Policy: https://styleit.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://styleit.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00015284:ios.name: Guitar Scales & Chords Power
bluejetty:00015284:ios.summary:
To improve your guitar playing, learn scales, chords, and the relationship between them. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your rhythm by practicing with the metronome.
Practice scale loops to master positions and develop muscle memo
bluejetty:00015284:ios.description:
To improve your guitar playing, learn scales, chords, and the relationship between them. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your rhythm by practicing with the metronome.
Practice scale loops to master positions and develop muscle memory. Engage in scale exercises that will improve your finger dexterity and ability to improvise. Begin slowly and gradually increase your speed as you improve.
Play scales and chords by swiping across the strings. The direction of the swipe determines whether the playback is ascending or descending. Tap on a note to play it.
Scale positions correspond to the CAGED system, which consists of five patterns that cover the fretboard for each scale. The chord shape for each position is displayed to assist you in learning it in any key.
The tuner offers a chromatic mode or the option to select from various tunings.
The tuner and instruments use an adj. reference frequency, set to 410 Hz - 470 Hz (default A = 440 Hz).
The Circle of Fifths displays common chords for a key, aiding in composing music, learning key signatures, and transposing songs to different keys.
Metronome provides click and drum voices, beat subdivisions, and tap to set the BPM (10 - 400). Time signatures: 2/2, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 3/8, 6/8, 7/8, 9/8, and 12/8.
Create PDF diagrams (color and black-and-white) of scale positions or all notes on a full fretboard, as well as diagrams of all chord notes on a full fretboard. These 8.5” x 11” PDFs are easy to print, save, and share.
FEATURES:
• Chromatic tuner
• Scale position and exercise loops with adj. playback speed
• Chord and scale information, including their compatibility
• Chord/scale notes display letter, interval, and fingering
• Chord/scale playback - choose from 5 instruments and set them independently
• Count-in option before scale playback
• Play scales and chords together to hear them in combination
• 48 alternate tunings
• Guitar display (vertical/horizontal and right/left-handed)
• iPhone - zoom in/out to see the complete fretboard
• iPad - 3 fretboards: full, scales, and chords
• One-time purchase usable on iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch
SCALES:
Pentatonic etc:
Major Pentatonic, Minor Pentatonic, Blues (Minor Blues), Major Blues
Major modes:
Ionian (Major), Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian (Relative Minor) and Locrian
Harmonic Minor modes:
Harmonic Minor, Phrygian Dominant (Spanish Gypsy)
Melodic Minor modes:
Melodic Minor Ascending (Jazz Minor), Dorian b2 (Javanese), Lydian Augmented, Lydian Dominant (Overtone), Mixolydian b6 (Hindu), Locrian #2 (Half-Diminished), Super Locrian (Altered)
Symmetrical:
Chromatic, Half/Whole Diminished (Octatonic), Whole/Half Diminished, Whole Tone
Miscellaneous:
Bebop Dominant
CHORDS:
Major:
Major, Major 7th (maj7), Major 9th (maj9), Major 13th (maj13), Major 6th (6), Major add9 (add9), and Major 6add9 (6/9)
Minor:
Minor (m), Minor 7th (m7), Minor 9th (m9), Minor 11th (m11), Minor 13th (m13), Minor 6th (m6), Minor Major 7th (m(maj7)), and Minor 7th b5th (m7b5) (Half-Diminished)
Dominant:
Dominant 7th (7), Dominant 9th (9), Dominant 11th (11), Dominant 13th (13), and Dominant 7th sus4th (7sus4)
Altered Dominant:
Dominant 7th b5th (7b5), Dominant 7th #5th (7#5), Dominant 7th b9th (7b9), and Dominant 7th #9th (7#9)
Other:
Augmented (aug), Diminished (dim), Diminished 7th (dim7), Perfect 5th (5) (Power Chord), Suspended 2nd (sus2), and Suspended 4th (sus4)
TUNINGS:
Standard, Std. Half Step Down, Std. Full Step Down, Drop D, Drop C#/Db, Drop C, Drop B, Drop A#/Bb, Drop A, Drop G#/Ab, Drop G, Drop F#/Gb, Drop F, Drop E, Double Drop D, Double Drop C#/Db, Double Drop C, Open A, Open A Alt., Open A Slide, Open C, Open D, Open E, Open F, Open G, Cross-note A, Cross-note A Alt., Cross-note C, Cross-note D, Cross-note E, Cross-note G, Asus4, Csus2, Dsus2, Dsus4 (Dad-Gad), Esus2, Esus4, Gsus2, Gsus4, E Modal, Bruce Palmer Modal, All Fourths, Baritone, C6, Dad-Gad (Dsus4), Dad-Dad, Dobro, Lute, New Standard

bluejetty:00134523:ios.name: RNI Flashback
bluejetty:00134523:ios.summary:
This app is a pretty scientific experiment in deep photo editing.
At RNI we wanted to make our photos look more special with less effort and more fun. So we created RNI Flashback — an app that works like film not like an app.
Using Flashb
bluejetty:00134523:ios.description:
This app is a pretty scientific experiment in deep photo editing.
At RNI we wanted to make our photos look more special with less effort and more fun. So we created RNI Flashback — an app that works like film not like an app.
Using Flashback is simple. You just press the button and it generates editing options for you. And then you choose the best one. Because you’re the boss.
Unlike other apps, RNI Flashback has no pre-defined filters. Instead it mixes virtual 'chemicals' and creates a unique look every time you press the button. This transforms digital medium making it more true to life and more refreshing. 
Flashback is created for everyone. But professional photographers and aficionados familiar with shooting film will especially love it. Because Flashback works more like photographic film rather than like digital software. Unlike any other existing software, Flashback uses real film data and simulates the response of real film layers by light when processing digital colours. This results in a completely unique output which can't be achieved in traditional image editors with conventional tools.
Some of its looks can be weird, some can render skintones too red. But some will be just absolutely fabulous, making for film-like colour harmony and colour separation, far beyond what’s achievable in any other piece of software you have ever tried. 
Experience RNI Flashback now. Bring custom artistic flair into your photos and never get bored again.
--
#RNIFlashback 
Tag your photos with #RNIFlashback for a chance to get featured in RNI’s official newsletter, blog and Instagram @reallyniceimages.
To find out more about RNI products please visit
reallyniceimages.com

bluejetty:00073879:ios.description:
Ready for the next「Reborn」?
Gunfire Reborn is an adventure level-based game featured with FPS, Roguelite and RPG. Players can control heroes with various abilities to experience diverse build gameplay, use randomly dropped weapons and props to explore random levels. This game supports solo mode and multiplayer mode with up to four players.
Venture into hail of gunfire, reborn in desperate landscapes!
After 2 million of sales on Steam, Gunfire Reborn is now on mobile！
[Features]
·A refreshing FPS+Roguelite experience: Involve in a never-ending reincarnation loop and find different ways to victory
·Distinctive heroes and diversified weapons: Achieve dissimilar builds with dozens of weapons and hundreds of scrolls
·Go solo, or be social: Go for a thrilling single-player adventure, or team up for more fun
·Unique Art: Low-poly art style delivers a brand new FPS visual experience 
·Optimized for Mobile Devices: Strive to achieve a balanced Control and Shooting experience
·PlayStation and Xbox Controller support (Other controllers are supported after mapping calibration)
[Original Edition]
The Original Edition contains all 4 Acts, weapons, Occult Scrolls & items (update with version changes) and three initial heroes. 
[System Requirements]
· iOS 10.0 or higher
· Devices with 3GB RAM or above
· iPhone 8p or higher
· iPad mini 5 or higher

bluejetty:00140914:ios.name: Hexdom™
bluejetty:00140914:ios.summary: Get ready to dive into Hexdom: Color Sort Puzzle, where puzzle-solving meets creativity in the world of hexa-sort challenges! This innovative mobile game takes the classic color-sorting concept and elevates it, inviting players to immerse t
bluejetty:00140914:ios.description:
Get ready to dive into Hexdom: Color Sort Puzzle, where puzzle-solving meets creativity in the world of hexa-sort challenges! This innovative mobile game takes the classic color-sorting concept and elevates it, inviting players to immerse themselves in strategic gameplay and embark on a journey to build their own Hexa kingdom. With each move, you’ll find yourself sorting, merging, and stacking hexagonal tiles by color to complete vibrant collections and unlock new realms. It’s more than just a game—it’s a relaxing and engaging experience perfect for puzzle enthusiasts who love both color sort and merge games.
A Unique Twist on Color Sorting
Hexdom: Color Sort Puzzle introduces a refreshing take on traditional sorting games. Here, you’ll find a blend of relaxation and strategy, where each level encourages you to refine your skills in matching and organizing hexagonal tile stacks. The objective is simple yet rewarding: sort and merge hexagon tiles into color-coordinated stacks of 10 layers. Once a stack reaches 10 layers, it’s cleared from the board, giving you points and creating more room for new hexagons. Every point brings you closer to unlocking new slots on the board, adding layers of strategy to the Hexa-sort experience.
Build Your Hexa Kingdom
Your ultimate goal in Hexdom is to build a majestic Hexa kingdom! With each puzzle solved you’ll collect the essential elements needed to unlock various royal areas. These elements are crucial to your kingdom’s growth and are only obtained by conquering challenging color sort puzzles. As you progress, you’ll encounter new elements to collect and ever-more complex puzzles, requiring you to think ahead and strategize with every tile placement. Watch as your kingdom flourishes, one puzzle at a time!
Exciting Challenges and Strategic Gameplay
In Hexdom, each level introduces new challenges and obstacles to keep you engaged. Some hexagon stacks are locked in place with chains, adding complexity to the gameplay. To free these stacks, you must clear the adjacent tiles, requiring careful planning and strategic thinking. As you advance, Hexdom ramps up the difficulty by introducing more intricate patterns, making each success even more satisfying. This clever merge and sorting mechanic adds depth to each level and offers a unique way to test your skills.
Features That Make Hexdom a Must-Play
Hexdom: Color Sort Puzzle brings an array of features designed to keep you entertained and engaged:
- Relaxing ASMR Gameplay: Easy to play yet challenging enough to keep you hooked, Hexdom offers a peaceful color sort experience.
- Dynamic Point System: Earn points to expand your board, unlocking new slots that allow for even more strategic gameplay.
- Endless Puzzle Variety: With hundreds of challenging levels, each puzzle presents a new twist on the classic hexa sort game.
- Beautiful Visuals: Enjoy stunning, immersive environments that transport you into a world of endless possibilities.
- Social Features: Connect with friends, share achievements, and compete on the global leaderboard for puzzle mastery.
Whether you have a few minutes or several hours, Hexdom: Color Sort Puzzle is ideal for a quick mental break or an extended puzzle-solving session. It’s a game where simplicity meets depth, making it accessible to all ages while challenging players to refine their skills as they progress. With its combination of color sort, merge, and hexa stacking mechanics, Hexdom offers a unique and enriching experience for those who love engaging and relaxing mobile games.

bluejetty:00114217:ios.description:
Bites Match – where simplicity meets brain-teasing fun! This thrilling match-3 game boasts ultra-easy controls that let you jump right in, but don’t be fooled – it demands sharp strategy to master.

bluejetty:00168369:ios.description:
Simply Plural is an app designed for plurals/systems who want to keep track of their members and optionally share those details with their friends. The app also includes functionality to vote per member on decisions within the system as well as chatting with your members.
See your front history in a handy graph that shows every person who fronted.
We designed the app privacy-first and any data that is not explicitly set to shared by you will not be shared with anyone.
The app is built with accessibility in mind and comes with high contrast mode and dark mode for both dark and bright mode. In addition, you can scale up and down the font size. If you have any accessibility concerns we are very interested in listening.
In addition, we added the possibility to share who's front and to allow specific people or systems of your choosing to be notified of front changes, to more easily communicate who is front.
Should you need support with using this app or you are experiencing issues, do let us know on our Discord, we'd be happy to help.
Finally, we hope you enjoy this app :)

bluejetty:00127460:ios.description:
Your tactical whiteboard — always in your pocket.
Create animated plays, design drills and organize your team faster than ever.
Trusted by thousands of coaches worldwide with a 4.7 rating.
Plan & Create
• Create animated plays and tactical boards
• Design drills using full training equipment (cones, balls, ladders, and more)
• Use powerful drawing tools with multiple line styles (solid, dotted, curved, etc.)
Training Sessions
• Build complete training sessions from your saved drills
• Run sessions on the pitch with easy drill switching and a built-in timer
• Export professional training plans to PDF with your club logo, team details and drill descriptions
Organize
• Save an unlimited number of tactics and drills
• Organize tactics by opponent, match or training session using folders
• Quickly switch between full pitch, half pitch, training pitch or plain board
Teams & Players

• Save to Photos, Dropbox, or other apps
• Easily share your ideas with players or staff

Built to be fast and intuitive, stable and reliable — focused on coaching, not distractions.

bluejetty:00178624:ios.description:
Want to play something quick and fun with friends when you party? 
5 Second is a party game for groups, for those who can act under pressure. 
Rules are pretty straightforward. Players are asked a simple question and they have 5 seconds to come up with 3 answers before the buzzer rings. 
If the player doesn’t give all the answers before the time runs out, you do the punishment.
Can you name 3 types of screams in 5 seconds? 
Can you name 3 hairy things in 5 seconds?
Can you name 3 brands of beer in 5 seconds?
The game includes normal cards, and also you can turn on sexy cards if you want to get your house party to the next level.

Peach Pass Verify is the new mobile app that provides a convenient way for existing Peach Pass customers to claim free toll benefits when carpooling. With just a few taps on your smartphone, you can verify that you have three or more people (driver included) and tolls will be waived for your ride in the High Occupancy Toll Lanes – specifically, the Georgia I-85 Express Lanes and I-85 Extension Express Lanes!
To learn more please go to https://peachpass.com/peachpassverify/. If you are experiencing any technical difficulties, please contact Peach Pass customer service directly at https://peachpass.com/contact/.

bluejetty:00139699:ios.description:
From the creators of beloved classics like Solitaire and fresh new hits like Monopoly Solitaire, we’re excited to bring you Cribbage Daily - a timeless card game reimagined for your mobile device!
Step into the world of Cribbage, where strategy meets fun in a game that has entertained players for centuries. Whether you’re a seasoned Cribbage pro or new to the game, our version offers something for everyone with easy-to-learn gameplay, innovative scoring, and exciting new features.
CRIBBAGE DAILY features:
- Classic Gameplay with a Modern Twist: Enjoy the traditional Cribbage experience with an intuitive interface that makes it easy to play anywhere, anytime.
- Innovative Scoring Board: Track your points with our sleek, easy-to-use scoring board that brings the Cribbage experience to life.
- Skunk and Double Skunk Your Opponents: Outplay your competition and enjoy the satisfaction of skunking your opponents, or even delivering a double skunk for extra bragging rights!
- Unlimited Hints: Whether you're new to Cribbage or looking to refine your strategy, our unlimited hints will guide you to victory.
- Strategize and Score Big: Use your skills and strategy to maximize your points, create combos, and outmaneuver your opponents. 
- Earn Rewards and Compete in League Play: Test your skills in competitive league play, earn rewards, and rise through the ranks to become a Cribbage champion.
Easy to Learn, Fun to Master: New to Cribbage? No problem! Our step-by-step guidance will have you playing like a pro in no time.
Download Cribbage Daily now and enjoy the timeless game of skill and strategy, with new features that make it better than ever!

-> TRULY PERSONALIZE
bluejetty:00187695:ios.description:
Gleeph recommends books chosen just for you, based on your library, the authors you love, and the writing style that speaks to you. The more complete your library is, the more personalized your recommendations will be. 
-> TRULY PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS 
Every day, Gleeph offers you new books selected according to your reader profile. Novels, romance, fantasy, thrillers, essays: your next favorite book is waiting for you. 
-> SCAN YOUR ENTIRE LIBRARY 
Scan your books' barcodes, one by one or in batches, and carry your whole library in your pocket. In a bookstore, check in an instant whether you already own a book. 
-> TRACK YOUR READING 
Organize your books however you like: read, currently reading, TBR, wishlist, custom shelves. Rate and review every book you read. 
-> TAKE ON YOUR READING CHALLENGE 
Set your yearly goal, track your progress, and share your reading challenge with the community. 
-> THE SOCIAL NETWORK FOR READERS
Talk about any book on the news feed: share your honest thoughts or post a reading photo. Share your reviews, favorite quotes, shelves, challenges, and statistics. On every book page, find quotes and reviews shared by the community. Follow readers who share your taste and discover what they are reading.
-> BOOKSTORES NEAR YOU 
Find a book at a nearby local bookstore and reserve it in seconds. 
-> GLEEPH PREMIUM 
Go further with a Premium subscription: 
• Affinity: on each book page, discover your compatibility score with the book. 
• Analysis: understand why a book might suit you, or not. Strengths, points to consider, connections to your past reading, authors you've read, and writing styles you enjoy. 
• Advanced reading stats: genres, pace, authors, progress… detailed charts to better understand the reader you are. 
Gleeph is free. Affinity, Analysis, and Advanced Statistics features require an auto-renewing Premium subscription (in-app purchase), cancelable at any time in your Apple account settings. 
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00120388:ios.description:
With My Town 's Police station it is your time to become a policeman or woman, a detective and even a crook. Adventure and fun can be found all around the police station. Check out the Police car, take it for a ride, Help solve mysteries, lock away the bad guys and even plan a daring escape. Everything is possible in this highly interactive imagination game for children.
FEATURES
* Lots of new characters to play with, including Both a police man, policewoman, detective crooks and many more.
* Huge game pack including 7 different locations around the police station to explore such as Jail, Police dog training yard and the Safe !
* Over 300 different accessories and clothing to interact and play with!
* Game connects to other My Town games, Move characters and items between all our games for an even bigger adventure
* Multitouch feature added, Play with your friends and family on the same device!
WHAT IS MY TOWN ALL ABOUT?
My Town games are all about experiencing, imagining and having pure playtime fun. Our digital doll house games allow million’s of kids to have a new and fun adventure everyday! Our games promote imagination and stress free fun game play for kids. 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Younger kids will enjoy playing together with parents while the older kids can play alone or with a friend using our new multitouch feature!
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!

bluejetty:00114871:ios.description:
Join Finn and Rufus on a Daring Match-3 Adventure in Foxy Match!
Step into a vibrant forest world with Finn, the clever fox, and Rufus, his inventive badger companion, as they embark on a quest to recover lost family treasures. Navigate playful puzzles and discover magic hidden in the Royal Forest and beyond.
Engaging Storyline
Finn’s peaceful life in Fox Meadow is disrupted when his cherished family jewels are stolen. Together with Rufus, a quirky genius, he sets off on a journey through whimsical landscapes, from enchanted heather fields to mysterious shadow castles. Each chapter brings new challenges, quirky characters, and surprises as they work to restore the family’s magical legacy.
Game Features
Match-3 Magic
Solve colorful puzzles featuring forest-themed gems, symbols, and delightful animations. Experience the thrill of explosive combos as you progress through each level!
Boosters and Gadgets
Unleash creative boosters and power-ups inspired by Rufus’s ingenious inventions to overcome tricky challenges.
Cooperative Gameplay
Team up with friends in vibrant community events! Compete for leaderboard glory, share tips, and celebrate victories together in a friendly and engaging environment.
Exciting Events
Test your skills in weekly Mushroom Hunt Challenges. Collect magical red mushrooms to unlock unique rewards and boost your journey.
Rich Characters and Humor
Meet eccentric allies like the wise Mr. Mosswood, the flamboyant Lord Puffer, and the musical Carmen Canter. Each interaction adds charm and humor to your adventure.
Relaxing and Ad-Free Fun
Enjoy a seamless gaming experience with no intrusive ads, perfect for both casual and competitive players.
Free to Play
Download Foxy Match for free and immerse yourself in a tale filled with puzzles, humor, and magic. Join Finn and Rufus on their unforgettable quest today!
Stay Connected
Have questions or need assistance? Our friendly support team is ready to help. Reach out at contact@bestgames.ai.

bluejetty:00149595:ios.description:
My UCI Health
Our mobile app gives you easy access to the most important information you need as a UCI Health patient or visitor. You can get access to your health information with the integrated MyChart patient portal, or you can learn about our doctors and locations or find the amenities available to you while you’re at UC Irvine Medical Center. And our Live Well blog feed can help you stay up-to-date on the latest health tips and stories.
Use our app to:
• Search our database of providers
• Find location maps, addresses, hours and parking information
• Get turn-by-turn navigation with the Find My Way feature
• Learn about patient and visitor services
• Find out how to get urgent care and walk-in care
• View our Live Well blog feed
Are you a patient with UCI Health? You can access MyChart directly through our app, making it more convenient to manage your health information anytime, anywhere.* 
With MyChart, you can: 
• Communicate securely with your provider’s office
• Manage your appointments
• Review test results, medications, immunization history, and more
• Request prescription renewals
• Stay in touch with your physician
• View and pay your bills
• Access your family's health information
*To use MyChart on the My UCI Health mobile app, you need a MyChart account with UCI Health. If you are a patient but do not have a MyChart account, learn how to sign up at ucihealth.org/mychart.

- News Analysis: Optionally include the latest market news for any asset in your analysis.
What You'll Get:
- Market Trend Analysis: Bullish, Bearish, or Neutral.
- Indicator Insights: Simplified RSI, MACD, and moving averages.
- Pattern Recognition: Spots double tops/bottoms, head & shoulders, breakouts, and more.

bluejetty:00119545:ios.description:
Gestiona tu dinero de forma fácil, segura y rápida
Lleva tu banco siempre contigo con la App Santander, diseñada para hacer tu día a día más sencillo. Gestiona tu día a día (cuentas, tarjetas y pagos), inversiones y seguros con una navegación simplificada.
Gestiona tu dinero. Consultas y Pagos de tu día a día
• Bizum: envía y recibe dinero en segundos, solicita pagos y paga en comercios con Bizum directamente desde la app
• Pagos: envía dinero a destinatarios favoritos nacionales e internacionales; envía de forma inmediata o programa un pago
• Tarjetas a tu medida: activa, desactiva o bloquea tus tarjetas en cualquier momento. Consulta tu CVV y PIN al instante y ajusta los límites de gasto según tus necesidades
• Pagos móviles y sin contacto: usa Apple Pay, Google Pay y Samsung Pay para pagar de forma rápida y segura
• Retira dinero sin tarjeta: genera un código desde la app y saca dinero en cajeros Santander sin necesidad de llevar tu tarjeta física
• Recibos e impuestos: consulta y gestiona todos tus recibos domiciliados, impuestos o multas en un solo lugar
Financiación al instante
• Conoce tus límites preconcedidos de financiación y contrata el producto que mejor se adecúe a tus necesidades: tarjeta de crédito, préstamo consumo, renting auto, etc.
• Gestiona tus financiaciones desde la App y aplaza pagos y compras
Inversiones y Ahorro al alcance de tu mano
• Plataforma de inversión avanzada: compra y vende valores, fondos, ETFs, renta fija y contrata y aporta a tus planes de pensiones desde la app
• Santander Activa: obtén asesoramiento digital o habla con un experto para tomar mejores decisiones de inversión
• Seguimiento de inversiones: consulta la evolución de tu cartera en tiempo real con análisis detallado de rendimientos
Protección
• Protégete tú y a tus seres queridos, también tus bienes materiales
• Unifica tus pagos de seguros de protección con Planeta Seguros
• Compara coberturas y elige el seguro de protección que mejor encaje con tu situación personal
Seguridad y confianza en cada operación
• Inicio de sesión seguro: accede con huella dactilar, Face ID o clave personal para proteger tu cuenta
• Santander Key: firma operaciones con doble verificación y recibe alertas de actividad sospechosa
• Control total de tus tarjetas: bloquea o desbloquea tu tarjeta en segundos si la pierdes o detectas un movimiento no autorizado
• Modifica límites de operativa: ajusta los importes máximos de tus transferencias y pagos para mayor control
Control total de tus finanzas
• Asistente Financiero: analiza tus ingresos y gastos por categoría, visualiza gráficos detallados y planifica mejor tu economía
• Multi-banco: agrega cuentas de otros bancos y consulta todos tus movimientos desde una sola pantalla
• Notificaciones en tiempo real: recibe alertas de movimientos, pagos, ingresos y posibles actividades sospechosas
Tu banco siempre disponible
• Gestor personal a un clic: contacta con tu asesor a través de chat o llamada para resolver cualquier duda
• Buscador inteligente: encuentra fácilmente lo que necesitas: movimientos, productos, operaciones y más
• Cajeros y oficinas: localiza más de 7.500 cajeros en España y en el extranjero, y gestiona citas en oficinas desde la app
Descarga la App Santander y lleva el control de tu dinero siempre contigo.
¿Alguna duda? Visita nuestro centro de ayuda en https://www.bancosantander.es/particulares/atencion-cliente

Download now and let the magical adventure begin!

bluejetty:00026802:ios.description:
The best way to view WYDOT 511 traffic alerts, road conditions and travel information.
MAIN FEATURES INCLUDE:
 + WYDOT 511 Traffic Incidents
 + Road Conditions & Planned Events
 + Customizable Push Notifications
 + Home Screen Camera Widgets
 + Winter Weather Analysis
 + CCTV Cameras
WYDOT TRAFFIC INCIDENTS INCLUDE:
Traffic collisions, advisories, hazards, weather / wind advisories, heavy traffic, road closures, chain control, planned construction
CCTV CAMERAS
Create customized groups of CCTV cameras for viewing traffic on your route. This feature gives users a quick way of assessing road and traffic conditions.
HOME SCREEN CAMERA WIDGETS
Add up to (4) home screen widgets displaying your favorite CCTV cams.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Track WYDOT incidents and receive Push Notifications when new updates are available. The app also sends notifications when an incident is no longer being tracked by WYDOT. This feature is critical for staying up-to-date on road closures due to accidents. 
ROAD CONDITION CATEGORIES INCLUDE:
Dry, scattered showers, rain, wet slushy, high wind, poor visibility, snow, drifted snow, black ice, icy, icy spots, blowing snow, closed, rock slide
WINTER WEATHER ANALYSIS:
 - NOAA Snowfall Reports
 - Current Radar
 - NWS Watches & Warnings
 - Winter Weather Severity Index
TERMS & CONDITIONS
https://lwbrandsllc.com/wyoming-road-conditions-app-terms-conditions/
