bluejetty:00031027:ios.description:
Your Skin. Finally Understood.
Skin Bliss is the world’s smartest skincare app—powered by science, built for real results.
From AI face scanning to routine planning, ingredient safety checks to daily tracking, Skin Bliss is your complete skincare operating system.
Whether you’re just starting out or you’ve tried everything—Skin Bliss helps you finally understand what your skin truly needs, build the right routine, and track visible progress over time.
Powered by AI. Backed by science. Loved by skincare geeks.
We combine cutting-edge AI, ingredient research, and dermatological expertise to help you:
• Discover your true skin profile
• Build a routine that fits your goals, lifestyle, and concerns
• Avoid product clashes, overuse, or missing steps
• Track your visible progress with photos, mood logs, and our AI analyzer
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH SKIN BLISS
Face Scanner – Your Skin Profile in Seconds
Scan your face to detect visible concerns and build a personalized profile: skin type, concerns, and what your routine should actually do.
Routine Builder & Templates
Build from scratch or start with expert-designed routines. Schedule products with ingredient-smart logic, daily or on rotation.
Routine Evaluator + Timeline
Evaluate your full routine: what goals it supports, what’s missing, and how long to expect results.
Routine Player
Follow your routine step by step with timing, application guidance, and mirror mode—so every product works better.
Skin Diary
Track how your skin feels, log symptoms, note triggers, and reflect on daily patterns.
AI Photo Comparison
Upload daily photos and let our AI analyze progress vs. your original scan—spot subtle shifts over time.
Side-by-Side Product Comparison
Compare any products by ingredients, performance, price, and suitability for your skin.
Ingredient Compatibility Checker
Check for clashes, duplication, or irritation risks between products in your routine.
Shelf Analysis
Take a photo of your skincare shelf and instantly analyze all your products—together and individually.
Weather-Driven Skincare Tips
Get personalized product tips based on your local climate, UV, and humidity.
Smart Product Search & Analyzer
Scan barcodes, paste ingredient lists, or search 100 k+ products to see if they match your skin and routine goals.
Product Organizer
Build your routine shelf, wishlist, and expiration tracker.
Skincare Programs (incl. Clear Your Acne)
Follow expert-led video courses for acne, skincare foundations, and beyond.
84% of Users See Results
In a survey of tens of thousands of users, 84% said their skin visibly improved since starting with Skin Bliss.
Built by scientists. Loved by skincare geeks.
Skin Bliss is a skincare intelligence platform for beginners, product junkies, and anyone with stubborn concerns.
Available in 14 languages
English, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Portuguese, Polish, Dutch, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian and Turkish
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Download Skin Bliss and enjoy a FREE trial of Skin Bliss Pro for a limited time!
Unlock unlimited scans, advanced insights, routine timelines, photo comparisons, and more.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel any time in your Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://skinbliss.app/privacy

bluejetty:00173080:ios.name: Rich Hero Go
bluejetty:00173080:ios.summary:
City under siege by alien forces, needing heroes more than ever! 
Unleash your inner hero, navigating the chaos with skill, agility, and courage!
It's not just about saving the city—it's about reaping rewards worthy of courage!
Aliens in UF
bluejetty:00173080:ios.description:
City under siege by alien forces, needing heroes more than ever! 
Unleash your inner hero, navigating the chaos with skill, agility, and courage!
It's not just about saving the city—it's about reaping rewards worthy of courage!
Aliens in UFOs attacking our city! Heroes from around the world need help!
Use your parkour skills to glide, dodge, and sprint on streets, collecting coins! Join us in repelling aliens and saving citizens!
Game Features:
● New Gameplay Features: Players can unlock new scenes through a combination of parkour and new roulette gameplay, controlling UFOs and battling for town defense!
● Embark on a Roguelike-style parkour adventure across unique cities in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and beyond!
● Run through streets, highways, palaces, and jungles, becoming the ultimate parkour star!
● Complete random missions in parkour races and win various rewards! Create your unique parkour route and journey with random and unique skill combinations!
● Choose from a range of exclusive city heroes, including the swift Black Panther and the surfing expert! Join the parkour chase! Fight to protect the city!
● New characters: "Sand Assassin," "Colorful Revelry," "Fiery Melody," and "Rainbow Dust."
Various Game Modes:
■ Treasure Mode: includes "Treasury Challenge" and "Treasure Hunt" mini-games for great rewards.
■ Classic Mode: Experience the classic feel of the game, with endless adventure and challenges awaiting you.
■ Battle Mode: Duel with other players in real-time, using strategy and speed to claim the title of battle king.
■ Rush Mode: Experience the thrill of high-speed challenges, a favorite among many skilled players.
■ Ability Mode: Possess unique abilities, devise personalized strategies, and take on various challenges in the game.
■ Battle Mode_Item Race: Use items like banana peels, squids, and missiles to interfere with each other, and see who can reach the finish line fastest in the chaos!
Various System Benefits:
● Complete random missions in parkour races and win various rewards!
● Create your unique parkour route and journey with random and unique skill combinations!
● Utilize unique flying, surfing, and vehicle skills!
● Experience vibrant city parkour themes!
● Play with friends, reach milestones, and compete on global leaderboards!
● Dive into action with the Hero Pass, unlocking gates to glory, discounts, and a range of rewards that will make your parkour adventure unforgettable!
● New trophy leaderboards and friend leaderboards allow you to compete and interact with good friends!
 Not only can you receive free resources by logging in every day, but also practical items to challenge exclusive tracks worldwide. You can also earn super generous rewards through activities such as accumulating views!
 Continuously adding famous scenes and streets from around the world, with tracks composed of random obstacles, allowing you to experience the fun of street parkour in extreme games. Invite your friends to challenge and try it out together! This captivating and exciting Roguelike-style parkour game, featuring the swift Black Panther, the surfing expert, and action-packed golden runs, will definitely not disappoint you!

NCLEX PN Exam Practice 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry testing experts. With more than 2,000 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the NCLEX PN certification exam on your first try!
NCLEX PN Exam Practice 2026 now supports The National Council Licensure Examination for Practical Nurses (NCLEX-PN) exam preparation. Our examiners will update and revise the content based on the latest syllabus provided by the National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN).
NCLEX PN Exam Practice 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied the content of previous exams and the latest exam requirements and have expertly categorized all the subjects on the exam so that you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 2,000 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the NCLEX PN certification exam can be difficult, but with the help of NCLEX PN Exam Practice 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the NCLEX PN exam, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of NCLEX PN Exam Practice 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

bluejetty:00157286:ios.description:
Your trips as GPS logs, cockpit in screen landscape format, maintenance logbook, your documents allways with you, complete vehicle management for your bike.
mo.ride offers a visionary new level of interaction with your motorcycle. Log all your rides with curve counter, top speed, fun factor, course of the tour, and much more. Turn your smartphone to launch the cockpit with 21 functions. Choose from a variety of different values and Functions.
Vehicle status
Start motorcycle GPS tour log

Last ride

Logbook

All motorcycle maintenance tasks at a glance. Receive notifications. Use our huge motorcycle parts database.
Season
Compare your season progress with the community.
Documents 
TÜV report, driver's license, vehicle registration document, receipts always with you.
Vehicle Database
Free access to 8000 motorcycle vehicle records with all compatible tyres, spark plugs, chain kits, batteries, oils and more. Easy creation of your own data records.
Costs
mo.ride is free for normal use. More than 250 annual tours require a Power-User subscription for EUR 9.90 annually.
Terms of Use at https://www.mo-ride.de/en/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00014552:ios.summary: The first and #1 app in the foodservice equipment industry allows you to take Parts Town on the go! Find and buy the real OEM commercial kitchen parts you need and access online equipment manuals with our user-friendly, innovative parts ID
bluejetty:00014552:ios.description:
The first and #1 app in the foodservice equipment industry allows you to take Parts Town on the go! Find and buy the real OEM commercial kitchen parts you need and access online equipment manuals with our user-friendly, innovative parts ID tools. Wherever your day (or night) takes you, we’re here to help every step of the way from simple fixes to large projects in commercial kitchens.
Quick Search – Search by manufacturer, model and/or part category all in one place to swiftly narrow your search. You'll find everything for fryers, combi ovens, ice machines, refrigeration and much more.
My Equipment – Log into your account to save the commercial kitchen equipment you own or service to access parts and manuals.
My Parts – Save a list of foodservice parts you use most for easy reordering. 
Saved Manuals – Find the OEM manual you need, download it to your device and save it for easy reference.
Smart Manuals – Tens of thousands of hyperlinked commercial food equipment manuals that lead directly to product detail pages. You can even save them on your device to view offline.
Interactive Diagrams – Bringing technical schematics to life, these diagrams show a detailed breakdown of parts. Refer to product details and add a part to your cart without leaving the diagram.
Serial Number Lookup – Enter your equipment’s serial number to see an exact list of restaurant equipment parts needed, along with available warranty info.
Synchronized Cart – Your shopping cart is available across all of your devices when you log into your account. It’s easy to pick up right where you left off anytime.
Order History and Tracking – Just log into your account to see your previous orders and find out where your stuff is. 
Live Chat – When you need a little help, chat with a friendly expert in real time.
Join the hundreds of thousands already here when you download today! We’ll see you around Town.

bluejetty:00183649:ios.description:

Account Balance and Transactions
• Summary of your accounts at one glance
• View and download up to 180 days of transactions history for your savings and current accounts 
Funds Transfer
• Transfer funds locally internationally, own accounts
transfer, to third-party accounts, or to any FAST participating banks,
• Transfer funds to partnered Payment Service Providers (PSP)
• Transfer within Sathapana Bank to Mobile number’s beneficiary 
• Transfer funds to Bakong & Bakong to Bankong
Pay Bills 
• Pay bills to various participating bill Companies
• Insurance payment 
Online Account 
• Faster and easier to registers and manage your account and transactions.
• Get accounts instantly after the successful registration
• Access account via Sathapana Mobile or iBanking.
• Account in Khmer Riel and US Dollar
• Initial funding from any channel such as:
- Sathapana Account, ATM (cashless deposit), Sathapana Partnerships, Bakong Account
Online Term Deposit Opening
• Create term deposit and manage it online
 Cards
• Check Credit Summary / Detail
• Pay Credit Card Bills
• Activate / Block / Unblock / PIN Change 
• Credit Card Statement 
• View Transaction History
• Raise Dispute 
• Link Card to Account 
• Card Request
Cheque Management 
• Cheque book request
• Stop cheque payment 
• Cheque status enquiry
• Banker cheque request
Sathapana Pay
• Scan pay at the merchant outlet
• Scan QR to transfer
• Scan Thai QR for cross border payment
Virtual Card
• No annual fee
• Issued instantly on the screen
• Secure online payment 
• Block and unblock anytime
• SMS notification on transaction 
• Transaction summary
Top-Up 
• Instant top-up to your prepaid mobile number
Apply Now 
• Bakong Account
• Loan
• CASA
• Card
• Online Account
In-app notification
• Be updated in real time of your transaction 
• Receive bank information or promotion
Touch ID or Face to login to Sathapana Mobile
• Just face or touch ID to login to Sathapana Mobile App

bluejetty:00123119:ios.description:
Road Trip is the fastest and easiest app for tracking of your car’s fuel economy, maintenance history, and expenses. 
Road Trip is a one-time purchase. There are no ads, subscriptions, or recurring fees. Your data is always private.
Remember to checkout Road Trip Lite and Road Trip HD for the iPad.
_____________________________ 
"There’s a ton of MPG apps on the App Store but Road Trip is the best because of its amazingly dense summary screen and its best in class fuel entry screen." 
— Jason D. O'Grady, zdnet.com 
"The most comprehensive road travel app of them all, Road Trip allows you to track mileage, fuel prices, graph out trip expenses, and even export the data to CSV" 
— Ben Parr, mashable.com 
"The part we like the most is the cool graph that shows fuel costs and average mpg over time. And it lets you look at the cost per day to keep those wheels turning." 
— Car and Driver Magazine 
_____________________________ 
Road Trip will… 
• Track your fuel economy and fuel costs. 
• Track your maintenance history. 
• Track and compare your vacations and trip costs. 
• Remind you when regular maintenance is due. 
• Prevent expensive premature maintenance. 
• Show you how much money you spend on your car. 
FEATURES 
• Mileage and fuel economy tracking. 
• Service and repair log, with service reminders. 
• Expense tracking. 
• Trip tracking and reporting. 
• Comprehensive statistics. 
• Full international support (Metric, US, and Imperial units). 
• Unlimited number of vehicles. 
• Full screen, interactive graphs.
• Customizable Shortcuts
• Home Screen Quick Actions 
• Siri voice integration
COMPREHENSIVE STATISTICS 
• All key statistics and graphs on a single page. 
• Cost per day, Cost per km, Moving Average. 
• Maximum distance per tank. 
• Monthly and Yearly distance and cost estimates. 
• Vehicle depreciation statistics.
AUTOMATIC BACKUP AND SYNC 
• Automatically sync between multiple of iOS device using Dropbox or iCloud.
• Automatically backup to Dropbox, including CSV files.
PRIVACY
• Your Road Trip data always remains private. We do not collect data from your iOS device, and we do not have access to the data you store in iCloud or Dropbox.
ADVANCED FEATURES 
• Tripmeter or Odometer distance entry. 
• Partial fill-ups, Same-day fill-ups, and Missed fill-ups. 
• Currency Conversion. 
• Geo-tagging and mapping. 
• Searching and filtering. 
• Jerrycan Fuel Tracking. 
• Trip Cost Calculator. 
• Distance-To-Empty Calculator. 
• Tire log, including support for summer and winter tires. 
• Distance correction for inaccurate odometers. 
• Monthly and Yearly distance and cost estimates. 
• Trip Computer Logging (fuel economy, average speed, temperature)
• Graphs for comparing MPG vs. Fuel Type, Driving Conditions, Average Speed, and Temperature.
• Odometer replacement.
• Vehicle purchase price and depreciation tracking.
• Import and Export CSV 
• Electric vehicle tracking (in kW.h) 
• Home electricity tracking (in kW.h) 
• Motorboat tracking (in Hours) 
_____________________________ 
Lots more information and screen shots on the website: 
https://darrensoft.ca/roadtrip/ 
Questions? Suggestions? We want to hear from you! 
Email us: support@darrensoft.ca

bluejetty:00062182:ios.name: Elmo Calls
bluejetty:00062182:ios.summary:
This is an app full of fun phone calls from Elmo, which will help teach your child about healthy habits, self-confidence, and letters.
Pick up the phone, Elmo’s calling! Receive video calls, audio calls, and voice mail from Sesame Street’s
bluejetty:00062182:ios.description:
This is an app full of fun phone calls from Elmo, which will help teach your child about healthy habits, self-confidence, and letters.
Pick up the phone, Elmo’s calling! Receive video calls, audio calls, and voice mail from Sesame Street’s own furry, red monster. Or, give him a call yourself! With Elmo Calls you can laugh, play, and sing with Elmo! 
FEATURES 
• Receive audio and video calls from Elmo, or dial Elmo yourself. 
• Receive voicemail from Elmo regularly and listen to the messages any time. 
• See live video of yourself in the corner of the screen while you’re chatting with Elmo. 
• Grown-ups can activate calls or schedule calls for a variety of situations, such as time to wake up! (more calls for going to the doctor, bath time and learning to potty available with additional call packs) 
LEARN ABOUT 
"Elmo Calls" encourages children to engage in imaginative play, practice listening skills and sing songs with Elmo! This app also fosters self-confidence by encouraging children to celebrate important life moments, such as visiting the doctor, going to the potty and learning the alphabet! 
CALL PACKS 
Elmo Calls comes with The Sunny Day Sampler Call Pack. This pack includes 13 fun-filled calls for you and your child to enjoy right away! For even more calls, get "Playdate with Elmo" which is ready to download, plus you can buy additional Call Packs easily right within the app: 
• Firsts and Celebrations: Special calls for special days. Elmo calls you during big events, such as your birthday! 
• Elmo is Proud of You: You're proud of your achievements and so is Elmo! 
• Feelings: Everybody has feelings and Elmo can call you to share and talk about those feelings.
• ABCs: Saying your ABCs is fun! It’s even more fun with Elmo! 
• Special Visits: Elmo wants to talk about your special plans for today. 
• Holidays: Holidays are fun to celebrate and Elmo wants to celebrate with you! 
• You Can Do It!: No matter what you're learning, whether its your ABCs or using the potty, Elmo wants to cheer you on. 
• Sing with Elmo!: Elmo sings for you! You can sing along or just listen. 
• Happy Habits: Healthy habits are more fun when you do them with Elmo. 
• Laugh with Elmo: Elmo just wants to say hi! 
• Playdate with Elmo: Play and pretend with Elmo! Ready to download!
TIPS 
• Please allow Notifications to receive scheduled calls from Elmo! 
ABOUT US
Sesame Workshop’s mission is to use the educational power of media to help kids everywhere grow smarter, stronger, and kinder. Delivered through a variety of platforms, including television programs, digital experiences, books and community engagement, its research-based programs are tailored to the needs of the communities and countries they serve. Learn more at www.sesameworkshop.org.
ABOUT IDEO
IDEO is a human-centered design and innovation firm ranked independently among the ten most innovative companies in the world. Learn how our team of child-development experts, veteran toy designers and interaction designers approach the creation of award-winning kid apps at www.ideotoylab.com. 
PRIVACY POLICY 
The Privacy Policy can be found here: 
https://www.sesameworkshop.org/privacy-policy/
CONTACT US
Your input is very important to us. If you have any questions, comments or need help, please contact us at: sesameworkshopapps@sesame.org.

bluejetty:00118795:ios.description:
The reference app in the financial market, trusted by over 8 million customers. Manage your personal finances, bank accounts, cards, savings, and investments quickly, easily, and 100% securely.
MORE SPEED AND PERSONALIZATION
We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to optimize every banking operation. Make your online purchases or routine bank transfers with a single click. Plus, forget about searching for the same contact to send a Bizum; the app automatically organizes your favorite operations, payments, and financial products directly on the home menu so you don't waste time.
WHAT'S NEW AND FEATURED SERVICES AT BBVA
AQUA CARDS WITH AI AND COMMISSION-FREE PURCHASES ABROAD
Your Aqua Card is a pioneer in banking security: no printed numbers and a dynamic CVV that changes with every online purchase. Now it goes a step further:
• Unique design generated with AI: Personalize your Aqua Debit or Credit Card with exclusive images created by Artificial Intelligence.
• Travel abroad without commissions: With the Travel Pack, pay at merchants worldwide in another currency (dollars, pounds...) without currency exchange fees (up to €300/month free on the Essential Plan). Plus, withdraw cash at international ATMs. If you are under 30, the Superior Pack is included!
• Digital turn off and on: If you lose it, turn it off and on instantly from the app.
FAST TRACK MORTGAGE: YOUR AMOUNT IN LESS THAN 8 HOURS
Forget about simple mortgage simulators. With the Fast Track service, find out the real viability and exact amount to finance your future home.
• No paperwork or waiting: Connect your official data in a 100% secure way (Tax Agency and Social Security) via Cl@ve Móvil.
• In less than 8 business hours, you will get your personalized proposal with no obligation and without being a prior customer.
YOUR FINANCIAL COACH AND EXPENSE CONTROL
We help you improve your financial health with an automatic diagnosis of your monthly savings capacity.
• AI analyzes your income and expenses to offer you a personalized plan.
• Detect subscriptions and small recurring expenses, build an emergency financial cushion, and track the evolution of your money month by month.
ALL FINANCIAL TOOLS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
• Bank Accounts and Bizum: Open your Fee-Free Online Account in 10 minutes. Pay or request money via Bizum instantly. Also available for minors (Kids' Online Account with adapted app and Bizum from age 12).
• Financial Health and Bank Aggregation: Connect your other banks to see all your accounts, cards, and loans on a single screen.
• Smart Discrete Mode: Automatically hide balances and transactions in public places to protect your privacy.
• Blue Virtual Assistant: Resolve doubts 24/7 about transfers, bills, and operations with our AI chatbot.
• Personal Loans: Simulate your monthly installment and apply for your personal loan 100% online.
• Insurance: Apply for and manage your car, home, life, or health insurance directly from the app.
• Investments, Funds, and Stock Market: Invest in the stock market, investment funds tailored to your profile, and trade with BBVA Trader. If you have negative returns on your funds in your first year, BBVA refunds you up to €300.
• Pension Plans: Plan your retirement with periodic contributions and fee-free transfers.
• Freelancers and Businesses: Invoicing management, mobile POS collection, and financing for your business.
• BBVA Friend Plan: Invite your friends to open an online account and earn money.
Additionally, the app is compatible with smartwatches and Wear OS.
SUPPORT AND CUSTOMER SERVICE
Do you have any questions or suggestions about the app?
Write to us at bbvabancamovil@bbva.com
If your terminal is not compatible, access your finances on BBVA Mobile Banking from bbva.es in your browser.

bluejetty:00145265:ios.description:
Learn a language from the YouTube videos and podcasts you already love.
Trancy adds AI dual subtitles to what you watch and listen to. Tap any word to translate it, practice line by line, get your pronunciation scored, and talk with an AI tutor. Every word you save becomes part of your own knowledge base, built from real content.
DUAL SUBTITLES, EVERY LINE CLEAR
• See the original and the translation together on YouTube videos
• No subtitles? AI generates them for videos and podcasts
• Follow your favorite channels in the app and learn from every new upload
PODCASTS, NOW WITH SUBTITLES
• AI turns podcasts into bilingual transcripts
• Read along as you listen, and catch every word you missed
TAP ANY WORD, KEEP WATCHING
• Definitions, phonetics and pronunciation appear instantly
• AI explains meaning and usage in context
• Save new words and great sentences in one tap
YOUR OWN LANGUAGE KNOWLEDGE BASE
• Every word and sentence you save comes from videos and podcasts you actually watched
• Saved words are highlighted the next time they appear in a video, a podcast or a lookup
• Your collection grows with expressions you really met, not lists someone else picked
INTENSIVE LISTENING AND SHADOWING
• Line-by-line listening: playback pauses after each sentence, with loop and blind listening
• Shadowing with AI pronunciation scores that point out the words you missed
• Adjustable speed, so you can train your ear from slow to native pace
FLASHCARDS THAT STICK
• Example sentences are the exact lines you heard, so every word keeps its context
• Spaced repetition reminds you right before you forget
• Hear the original sentence read aloud while you review
SPEAK WITH AN AI TUTOR
• Role-play real situations: shopping, work, travel and more
• Practice speaking anytime, without the pressure
A LITTLE PROGRESS EVERY DAY
• Daily goals, streaks and study time
• Designed for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo
WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE TRANCY
• Learn from content you love instead of dull textbooks
• 11 languages to learn, including English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and French
• Trusted by 600,000 learners
SUPPORT
Questions? Visit https://www.trancy.org/chat
Terms of Service: https://manual.trancy.org/en/legal/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://manual.trancy.org/en/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00187320:ios.description:
Your messages, calls, and emails belong to you, not your carrier, not advertisers, not governments.
Pryvate is the only all-in-one encrypted messenger with military-grade security and post-quantum encryption, trusted by professionals, journalists, and privacy-conscious individuals across 100+ countries.
Download free. No phone number required.
WHY PRYVATE?
Most "secure" apps protect one thing. Pryvate protects everything, calls, messages, email, video, and browsing, in a single app, without storing your data on central servers.
- Military-grade RSA-4096 + AES-256 encryption
- Post-quantum ZRTP for voice and video calls
- OS-proof privacy — your phone's operating system cannot access in-app data

bluejetty:00078867:ios.description:

HOW OVIL WORKS
Using cutting edge AI, Ovil automatically removes the background of your little one’s photos and composes them into beautiful themed backdrops. No photoshop skills, stressful setups or expensive photoshoots required!
- Choose a backdrop you love! Select from 500+ professionally styled backdrops at your fingertips
- Magically remove the background of your photo with one tap 
- Effortlessly add finishing touches for a polished look
- TA DA! Your photo is transformed 
- Safely save, show it off to the world, share or print to create lasting keepsakes!
- Treasure the precious moment in time forever
WHY YOU WILL LOVE OVIL
- Easily transform photos into studio quality photography in seconds
- Themed backdrops to celebrate every occasion (Holidays, Birth announcements, Birthdays, Gender reveals)
- Access to photographers best kept secret, the wonderful world of backdrops
- No need to pay hundreds of $ for professional photoshoots
- No need to leave home or set up props.
- New styled backdrops delivered to your fingertips every month 
USE OVIL THROUGHOUT YOUR ENTIRE JOURNEY FOR:
Newborn photography
Baby photography
Pregnancy photography / Maternity photography
Child photography 
Milestone photos
Holiday photos / Holiday cards
Gender Reveal
Birth Announcement
Pregnancy Announcement
Birthdays
Party invitation maker
FEATURES
Magic Cut
Instantly remove the background from your baby photo, child’s photo or pregnancy photo with one tap using smart AI.
Styled Backdrops
Choose from over 500 gorgeous, professionally styled backdrops at your fingertips. 
Newborn Face Replace 
Insert your newborns face into beautiful layered backdrops to instantly create studio quality portraits.
New Backdrops Monthly
Celebrate every occasion! New themed backdrops, delivered to your fingertips every month.
Shadows
Change the light source by adding shadows for a realistic professional look.
Adjust Lighting Effects
Seamlessly match the lighting of your Magic Cut to your backdrops using the easy adjust slider. Explore vibrance, exposure, warmth, brightness + more
Refine Magic Cuts
Fine tune Magic Cuts with our manual Erase / Restore tools, for ultimate background removal precision
Save to Memories
Safely save Creations and Magic Cuts to your private memory jar to treasure forever.
Share
Share directly via social media, text, email or print to create lasting keepsakes.
OVIL PRO AI – Magical Creations in One Tap
Turn your baby’s photo into a storybook star, superhero, animated plush toy, or the face of a movie poster — all with one tap.
With Ovil PRO AI, you can create:
• Illustrated storybook scenes
• Collectable keepsakes
• Cinematic poster adventures
• Cute character animations
• Printable coloring book pages
New seasonal content drops all year round — think Halloween costumes, Christmas magic, Valentine’s sweetness, Easter fun and more.

Our next-gen security and extensive support for various blockchains make it a versatile and comprehensive solution for all your crypto needs.
Next-Gen Security
Our wallet prioritizes cutting-edge security measures, ensuring you retain complete control over your private keys. AliceBob Wallet is a self-custodial wallet that adheres to industry standards such as OWASP MASVS. We implement advanced cryptographic methods including BIP32, BIP39, and BIP44 to protect your digital assets like Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) from security risks.
1,000+ Coins and Tokens
Exchange and manage over 1,000 cryptocurrencies with AliceBob Wallet. You can buy Bitcoin and trade it for popular options like Ethereum, Binance Coin (BNB), Cardano, Dogecoin, Monero, and many others. Our wallet’s versatility ensures you have access to a wide array of digital assets.
Comprehensive Crypto Management
AliceBob Wallet allows you to effortlessly create and manage your cryptocurrency portfolio. Securely store your Bitcoin and other coins in one place, conduct seamless transactions, and trade among over 1,000 different assets. Additionally, choose between fixed or floating exchange rates on centralized exchanges (CEX) or opt for a decentralized exchange (DEX) experience.
Easy Crypto Purchases
Buying Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies is simplified with AliceBob Wallet. Choose from trusted fiat providers like MoonPay, Banxa, Simplex, and Wert to purchase crypto using credit cards, bank transfers, or other methods. You can buy Bitcoin with a bank account in over 200 different fiat currencies, including EUR, USD, GBP, AUD, and many more. The process is straightforward and quick, allowing you to buy and send Bitcoin instantly.
Portfolio Manager and Price Alerts
Stay informed with AliceBob Wallet’s portfolio manager. Access detailed insights into your holdings and customize real-time alerts for Bitcoin price and other market data. Make informed decisions and buy Bitcoin when the timing is right.
Access Leading DApps
Connect to top decentralized applications directly from AliceBob Wallet. Manage your DeFi activity with AAVE, Sushi, PancakeSwap, 1inch, Tornado Cash, and Compound — lend, borrow, swap, and stake crypto securely while keeping full control of your assets.

- Near real-time updates on winter road conditions, traffic incidents, and road closures

- Electronic roadway sign messages

The MnDOT privacy policy can be found at http://www.dot.state.mn.us/information/disclaimer.html#privacy
Drive safely!
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00036882:ios.name: CV Maker – Job Resume Creator
bluejetty:00036882:ios.summary: CV Maker is an iOS app for creating a professional resume or CV and exporting it as a PDF for a job application. Use this app to build a job resume on iPhone or iPad when you need a polished document to send. It is for students, graduates,
bluejetty:00036882:ios.description:
CV Maker is an iOS app for creating a professional resume or CV and exporting it as a PDF for a job application. Use this app to build a job resume on iPhone or iPad when you need a polished document to send. It is for students, graduates, career changers, professionals, and executives who want a finished resume without design skills or a computer.
Job seekers need a clear resume they can email, upload, or print. Layout work and desktop software slow that down. CV Maker walks you through each section and formats the document, so you leave with a PDF ready to apply.
What CV Maker does
• Build a resume step by step: summary, work history, education, skills, languages, certifications, references, links, and custom sections.
• Choose from 100+ resume and CV templates, including ATS-friendly and Europass layouts, and recolor a template you like.
• Export the finished resume as a PDF you can email, upload to an application, or print.
• Write a cover letter that matches the resume and export that letter as a PDF.
• Keep several resume versions and tailor each one to a different job.
• Add a photo and a signature to the resume.
• Edit in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, German, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Russian.
CV Maker is a resume and CV builder for job applications. You write the text. The app formats the document. It does not search for jobs or score your resume.
Who it is for
• Students and graduates building a first resume from education, internships, and skills.
• Career changers who need a work history that shows transferable skills.
• Experienced professionals presenting achievements and progression.
• Executives choosing a senior layout for leadership roles.
How to use
Enter your information, pick a template, preview the resume, and export a PDF. Update it anytime and keep more than one version for different applications.
Privacy
Your resume content stays on your device. CV Maker does not upload it to a server.
Pricing
CV Maker uses in-app purchases. A limited try covers one saved resume, one custom section, and one PDF download after a 24-hour wait. Premium unlocks instant PDF export, cover letters, and multiple resume versions.
Download CV Maker and create your professional resume on iPhone or iPad.
Terms of Use: https://cvbuilderapp.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://cvbuilderapp.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00135714:ios.description:
Welcome to Timpy Town World: Kids Games, a fun and exciting virtual playground for kids and toddlers! It's like a magical world where kids can play lots of different mini kids games that are super cool and help your kids and toddlers 2-5 year olds learn new things about the world too.
Imagine being at a kids airport and getting to fly airplanes, direct traffic, and take care of everything to ensure the airplanes land safely. Or you can go to a supermarket and be a shopper or a store worker, picking out groceries and being a cashier.
And guess what? You can also become a little chef in the kitchen! You'll cook yummy food like cupcakes and pizzas, and it's so much fun! You'll learn about ingredients and cooking while having a great time.
Do you like helping others? In the Kids Hospital Games, you get to be a doctor, nurse, or even a patient. You'll take care of people and learn about being kind and helpful.
But if you're brave, the Firefighter Games for Kids are perfect! You'll wear a firefighter helmet and put out virtual fires to save the day. It's exciting and teaches you about bravery and helping others in emergencies.
And there's even a Birthday Party Games section, where you can plan your own special party! You'll invite guests, decorate, and have a blast celebrating with your virtual friends. It's all about being creative and having fun!
Timpy Town World: Kids Games is a safe and friendly place where kids can play and learn together. It's like a big community where everyone can have a great time growing and learning new things.
Parents don't have to worry because Timpy Town ensures everything is suitable for kids and has special controls to keep things safe.
Subscription Details:
-Payment will be charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
-Cancel subscription renewal anytime under Subscriptions in your App Store Settings.
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.timpygames.com/privacypolicy.php 
Terms of Service: https://www.idzdigital.com/terms_of_service.php
So join us in Timpy Town: Kids World Games, and have an awesome time exploring, learning, and playing with your friends! It's a fantastic adventure that you won't want to miss!

bluejetty:00014411:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform for buying and selling new and used heavy equipment on a global scale. Whether you're looking for farm machinery, construction equipment, commercial trucks, utility trailers, parts, attachments, and so much more, MarketBook makes connecting with buyers and sellers across the world fast, easy, and secure. 
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
With just one app, you can tap into equipment markets in Canada, Central and Latin America, South Africa, as well as New Zealand, and Indonesia, just to name a few. Select your location and language in the app and access thousands of quality listings with just one tap. Browse a wide inventory of listings for various types of heavy equipment, including tractors, excavators, loaders, and trailers. Find the perfect machinery to meet your operational needs.
Once you've narrowed your search by location and category, view detailed specifications, photos, and videos of your desired equipment. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal before someone else beats you to it.
The MarketBook app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, manufacturer, year, price range, condition, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters to find exactly what you need.
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite listings or post a "Want-to-Buy" ad to let sellers know what you're searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email while browsing category pages that are updated daily with fresh inventory.
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you're a dealer or an independent seller, MarketBook connects you with thousands of qualified buyers across the world actively searching for heavy machinery and vehicles.
Consign your inventory with MarketBook to reach a global audience. Click the “My Inventory” button in your MarketBook app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app—your trusted and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go—right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE MARKETBOOK APP FOR ALL YOUR EQUIPMENT NEEDS 
Whether you're upgrading your fleet or selling machinery, MarketBook connects you with a vast inventory of heavy equipment along with a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, MarketBook links you to a network of trusted equipment marketplaces, including Machinery Trader, TractorHouse, Truck Paper, and others serving the agricultural, trucking, construction, and other heavy-duty industries across the world.
GET THE MARKETBOOK APP NOW 
Thousands of dealers and single equipment owners trust MarketBook to manage their operations. Download the app today to find your next piece of equipment or sell it with ease!

bluejetty:00028681:ios.description:
Welcome to Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon, an engaging restaurant business and management simulation game!
As the owner of a restaurant, you're about to embark on a journey to become a skilled manager and build a thriving culinary establishment. Join us now and immerse yourself in this exciting and delightful adventure in Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon!
1. Take customer orders.
Your staff will handle orders, cook, and serve food to your guests. Sit back and relax, as this game is perfect for idle gaming enthusiasts like you!
2. Prepare delectable dishes.
Your restaurant can whip up a wide variety of dishes, from soups, coffees, and lemonades to hot dogs, burgers, pizzas, and more! Don't forget to hire special characters to expedite your business operations.
3. Earn revenue from food sales.
Satisfy all your customers with your outstanding cuisine, and they'll happily pay for their meals, often leaving an extra tip!
4. Upgrade and decorate your restaurant.
Use the money earned from food sales to purchase equipment and furnishings, ranging from basic to modern. Personalize your dream restaurant according to your preferences.
5. Expand your restaurant.
Begin with a small establishment and gradually expand it into a spacious restaurant equipped with all the amenities to serve your customers better.
Demonstrate your exceptional management skills!
As long as you put in the effort, customers will flock to your restaurant. With your creativity and managerial acumen, there are no limits to what you can achieve in Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon.
This game is a perfect fit for the following individuals:
- Enthusiasts of cute games, food market tycoon game!
- Food lovers who crave dishes like pizza, burgers, hot dogs, gimbap, sushi, pasta, and more...
- Fans of relaxing games, idle games, and simulation games!
- Players who prefer offline and idle gaming experiences!
- Those who enjoy single-player and free games!
Play Mini Restaurant: Food Tycoon and become the most successful restaurant boss! Showcase your talent in restaurant management, craft delightful dishes, and provide an exceptional dining experience for every customer. The culinary world eagerly awaits your expertise!
By downloading this food market tycoon game, you agree to receive future updates through your app store or social network. You can choose to update the game, but opting out may affect your game experience and functionality.
Need assistance? Reach out to us via email: support@unimobgame.com
Visit our Facebook fanpage:
https://www.facebook.com/mini.restaurant.unimob

■■■　基本機能　■■■
1．クレジットカードの利用状況確認
・ご利用明細の確認
・次回のお支払い金額の確認
・ポイントの確認、及び景品交換
2．SMBC ID、ログイン設定機能
・SMBC IDの登録をすることで、普段お使いのメールアドレス1つで、
Vpassアプリ・三井住友銀行アプリどちらのアプリにもログインができます。
・ログイン設定を行うことで、次回以降のID・パスワード入力を省略できます。
Touch ID / Face ID でのログインも設定でき、簡単・安心です。
3．口座残高表示、口座・サービスおまとめ管理機能
・三井住友銀行はもちろん、様々な銀行の口座残高確認が可能
・複数のカードや銀行口座、ポイント、電子マネー等の情報をまとめて管理できる「口座・サービスおまとめ管理機能」を搭載
・三井住友プリペイドカードと連携することで、利用明細やチャージが可能
・SBI証券口座と連携し、資産状況も簡単に確認可能
・PayPayと連携し、PayPay残高の確認が可能
・SMBCモビットと連携し、利用可能額等の確認が可能
4．ご利用通知、使いすぎ防止サービス等の各種通知機能
・カードを使うたびにアプリに通知が届く、『ご利用通知サービス』
・設定したご利用金額を超えるとプッシュ通知でお知らせ、『使いすぎ防止サービス』
5．モバイルVカード
・モバイルVカードの提示でポイントが貯まります。
・貯めたポイントを利用して全国のVポイント提携先でお買い物に使えます。
（利用可能店舗先については、Vポイントサイトをご確認ください）
※ 一部機能をご利用いただけないカードがございます。
■■■　主な特長　■■■
●日常のお金の情報をまとめて管理
様々なカード、銀行口座、証券口座、電子マネー、ポイントカード、プリペイドなどの情報が一目でご確認いただけます。
複数のアプリを立ち上げることなく、このアプリ1つで、日常のお金の情報をまとめて管理することができます。
●ワンランク上の利便性・安心の実現
・ご利用通知サービス
カードを使うたびにアプリに通知が来るので、万が一不正利用やお店のミスがあってもすぐ気付くことができます。
・あんしん利用制限サービス
海外利用、インターネットショッピングなどで利用したくない場面に、ご自身で利用停止の設定が可能です。
・使いすぎ防止サービス
任意に設定した月のご利用上限金額を超えるとプッシュ通知でお知らせいたします。
・口座残高不足アラート
カード引き落とし額と銀行口座の残高を比較して、残高が不足しているとアプリ上に表示いたします。
ついうっかり、といった入金忘れを未然に防ぐことができます。
上記の他、快適なキャッシュレスライフに役立つコンテンツを豊富にご用意。より便利に、より安心・安全になった「三井住友カード Vpassアプリ」を是非お試しください。
※ 本アプリは三井住友カード発行のカード会員様かつ、インターネットサービス「Vpass」にご登録されている会員様であればどなたでもご利用可能です。
※ モバイルVカードはVポイントマーケティングが提供するサービスです。
※ モバイルVカード機能をお使いいただくには、お手続きが必要です。
※ 口座情報表示、口座・サービスおまとめ管理機能は三井住友銀行の口座またはマネーフォワード MEのアカウントをお持ちいただくことで、ご利用いただけます。
※ 画像はすべてイメージです。
※ 本アプリより提供する懸賞について、Apple Inc.、Apple Japan Inc.（アップルジャパン合同会社）は、スポンサーではなく、一切関係がありません。

bluejetty:00140832:ios.description:
Get the latest news and information, weather coverage and traffic updates in the Lake Charles area with the Gator 99.5 app! Listen to the station live and interact with the hosts – you can direct message and call the show directly from the app. Receive alerts about breaking news, contests, and more before anyone else. Save articles and viral stories for reading later, and share on Facebook and Twitter.
Key Features:
• Listen to our shows, plus receive weather and traffic updates live from Gator 99.5 Radio
• Read the latest news, watch videos, view photo galleries & listen to audio content
• Submit Photos/Videos directly from the app
• Participate in contests and giveaways, plus get exclusive access to station scavenger hunts
• Apple CarPlay lets you to stay focused on the road while listening
• Get the latest weather for your area plus a 5-day forecast
• Do not disturb modes for alerts (weekend and after hours)
• Save articles for reading later (supports offline viewing)
• Instant Alerts for breaking news, weather, contests, shows and more
• Featured full multi-tasking with background audio and controls
• Share the latest news on Facebook & Twitter
• Supports AirPlay for wireless streaming to your compatible devices
• 3D Touch for iOS Devices
This is the latest version of the Gator 99.5 app, and many more features are already planned. Please share your feedback from within the Gator 99.5 app by clicking the “Send App Feedback” link in the menu.

bluejetty:00162721:ios.description:
DAIMOKU PRO is an application which enables you to efficiently manage your chanting records and cheering up with world SGI members.
- Basic Function-
1: Record Chanting
You can record your Daimoku chanting by stopwatch.
It is also enable to record your past Daimoku individualy and multiply at the same time.
2: Prayers management
flexibly manage your prayers.
If you want other users to chant your prayers, you can make it public.
You can also "Prayed", "comment", and "share" which you want to cheer up.
3: Target management
You make the target of your Daimoku.
Check your progress against your targets.
4: Check your records.
By three different views(Daily, Monthly, and flexible period), you can check your Daimoku Records.
5: Friend Function
You can be friends with world wide SGI members on this application.
Then, cheer up each other, and spread your determinations.
6: Daimoku Group Function (Domei Daimoku)
You can simultaneously chant Daimoku with world wide SGI members together.
With more than thousands members, you can chant Daimoku together.
It is also enable you to create private Daimoku groups.
7: Timeline Function
You can post your activities, Taiken, or benefits from Daimoku. Your post can cheer others up.
8: Showing currently chanting users and groups
This application show always the currently chanting users and groups.
You can notice the fact that every seconds someone is chanting.
You are not alone.
※ What is "Prayed"?
You can deliver your Daimoku to others prayers or users themselves by tapping and "Prayed" icon.
Users who received "Prayed" can feel someones cheering by app notification.
Please refer more detail information "How to Use" within app.

bluejetty:00133168:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00133168:ios.description:
■ Hand in hand, let's walk as far as we can.
In a world where civilization has ended and no one is left,
two robots hold hands and walk on, ever onward, across an empty wasteland.
What you do is simple.
Pick up the trash lying around, gently pet a buddy whose heart has broken,
and hunt the "wild microwaves" that turn up now and then, as the quiet journey goes on.
There are no lines of dialogue.
And so the story comes to life, quietly, only within your own heart.
■ Features
[1] Just tap. A simple post-apocalyptic stroll
No difficult controls at all. Tap the screen, walk, and pick things up.
A calm, atmospheric game for wandering the wasteland in your spare moments.
[2] A wordless story that stays with you
The characters never speak a single word.
The "Memories" you collect gradually light up the story of this dying world.
Why are the two of them traveling? Who is the "Executioner" blocking their path?
And what waits at their destination—?
[3] Quiet, gentle, and strangely addictive
No flashy effects, no timers rushing you.
And yet you can't help wondering about the next step.
Soak in a gentle post-apocalyptic world that's funny and a little bittersweet.
■ Things to do
・Collect "Memories" to unravel the story of the dying world
・Pet your downhearted buddy to draw out all kinds of reactions
・Hunt the wild microwaves
■ Recommended for
・Anyone who loves atmospheric games or quiet walking games
・Anyone who loves wordless stories and novels you fill in with imagination
・Anyone who loves post-apocalyptic, dystopian sci-fi worlds
・Anyone after a heartwarming story that's funny and a little sad
・Anyone who wants to play all the way through without spending money
Free to play to the end (contains ads; optional in-app purchases).
Optional purchases: Ad Off Plus / Sunset Skies / Donation.
Our titles share a world, but there's no story connection between them.
You can enjoy this one no matter which title you start from.
So take their hand.
Let's walk a quiet apocalypse, as far as we can go.

bluejetty:00040882:ios.description:
อยาก ดูดวง แต่ไม่รู้จะดูกับใคร หรือไม่รู้หาหมอที่ไหน เราขอแนะนำ แอพพลิเคชั่น "ดวง Live" (ดวงไลฟ์) ดูดวงออนไลน์ ทำนายโชคชะตาชีวิต กับหมอดูแม่นๆ ผ่านหน้าจอมือถือ ไม่ยุ่งยาก สะดวกสบายดูได้ทุกที่ ที่มีเน็ต ดูดวงได้หลากหลายรูปแบบ
- ดูดวง แบบวิดีโอคอล แบบส่วนตัว
- ดูดวง แบบโทรศัพท์ แบบส่วนตัว
- ดูดวง แบบแชทคำถาม (พิมพ์ข้อความแชท, ข้อความเสียง, รูปภาพ)
- ดูฤกษ์ยาม, ฤกษ์มงคล, เบอร์มงคล, เลขมงคล และฤกษ์ยามต่างๆ
แอพดูดวงที่รวบรวมหมอดู และนักโหราศาสตร์มากประสบการณ์กว่า 2000+ คน มีครบทุกศาสตร์การพยากรณ์ ทั้ง ดูดวงโหราศาสตร์ไทย ดูดวงไพ่ยิปซี ไพ่ทาโรต์ ไพ่ออราเคิล โหราศาสตร์จีน ดูเบอร์มงคล ดูฤกษ์ยามมงคล ดูดวงความรัก ดูดวงมือถือ ทะเบียนรถ ทะเบียนบ้าน ฯลฯ
แอปพลิเคชั่นดูดวงสุดเจ๋ง! คัดหมอดูทั่วฟ้าเมืองไทย ทั้งแม่น และหลากหลาย มาให้กับคุณ ใช้งานง่ายไม่ยุ่งยาก สนุก และน่ารักด้วยตัวการ์ตูนสุดแนว! บอกลาการดูดวงแบบเก่าๆโบราณๆไปได้เลย
นอกจากดูดวงสดๆกับหมอดูแล้ว เรายังมีบทความดูดวงรายวันแม่นๆให้อ่านทุกวัน หรือจะดูเบอร์โทรศัพท์ หรือดูดวงฟรีจากการจับยาม ก็มีให้ดูแบบฟรีๆ
หากคุณยังไม่แน่ใจ เรามีระบบ คุณภาพตามดาวของหมอดู และรีวิวจากลูกค้าจริงกว่าแสนราย ว่ามีความน่าเชื่อถือมากน้อยแค่ไหน เพื่อความสบายใจของตัวท่านเอง!!!
สามารถเลือกดูดวงตามงบประมาณของท่านได้ มีทั้งหมอดูที่รับ ดูดวงฟรี และหมอดูที่รับดูในราคาย่อมเยาว์ ไปจนถึงหมอดูระดับปรมาจารย์
การันตีความแม่น คุ้มค่า แน่นอน!
----------------------------------------
(สำหรับหมอดู ที่ต้องการร่วมงานกับดวง live)
ท่านสามารถโหลดแอพแล้วสมัคร โดยเลือกที่ปุ่ม “หมอดูเข้าสู่ระบบ”
เมื่อทำการตรวจสอบแล้วทางทีมงานจะอนุมัติบัญชีของท่าน ท่านจึงจะสามารถเข้าสู่ระบบ และรับลูกค้าได้ 
ทีมงานจะติดต่อกลับทางช่องทางติดต่อที่ท่านให้ไว้

Perfect
bluejetty:00159536:ios.description:
The all-in-one PDF editor and file converter to scan, convert, edit, and manage your documents in seconds. Whether for work, school, or personal projects, this app offers professional tools to handle PDFs effortlessly.
WHO IT'S FOR
Perfect for professionals, students, and anyone who needs to edit, convert, or manage PDF documents quickly and easily.
WHAT YOU'LL GET
PDF Editor: Edit text, fill out forms, and adjust your document’s font, size, and color in just a few taps.
File Converter: Convert a wide variety of file types to and from PDF—perfect for converting image to PDF, JPG to PDF, photos to PDF, and even converting PDF to Word.
PDF Scanner: Scan paper documents and instantly convert them into high-quality PDFs.
PDF Filler: Fill out and sign PDF forms, customize text, and save your progress.
PDF Editor and Rotator: Rotate, delete, or rearrange pages within your PDF files.
Merge PDF Files: Combine multiple PDFs into one document for easy management.
PDF Signer: Add your digital signature or watermark to any PDF document for security and authenticity.
PDF Compressor: Compress large PDFs while maintaining visual quality, ideal for email sharing.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Convert files to PDF, including JPG to PDF, photos to PDF, and PDF to Word, with just a tap.
2. Scan paper documents and instantly turn them into high-quality PDFs.
3. Edit, fill out forms, rotate, delete, and sign PDFs with ease.
KEY FEATURES
PDF Editor: Effortlessly edit PDFs—fill out forms, change text, and adjust document design.
File Converter: Convert a variety of file types to PDF with one tap, including JPG to PDF, image to PDF, photos to PDF, and convert PDF to Word.
PDF Scanner: Instantly scan paper documents and turn them into high-quality PDFs with just a photo.
PDF Filler: Complete forms and save your data within your PDFs for quick and easy document management.
PDF Signer: Secure your documents by adding your signature or watermark, ensuring authenticity and privacy.
Compress PDFs: Reduce file sizes without sacrificing quality, making PDFs easier to share.
Rotate, Delete, and Merge PDFs: Organize and edit your PDF pages easily, combining or removing pages as needed.
PROOF & OUTCOMES
Thousands of users rely on this all-in-one PDF solution for seamless document editing, conversion, scanning, and signing. Whether you’re managing work documents or personal forms, this app delivers fast, reliable results.
FAQ
Q: How do I convert my files to PDF?
A: Simply choose your file (JPG, image, Word, etc.), and the app will convert it into PDF format instantly. You can also convert PDF to Word with ease.
Q: Can I sign PDFs with this app?
A: Yes, the app allows you to digitally sign your PDF documents and add your signature to any page.
Q: Can I scan paper documents into PDFs?
A: Yes, just take a photo of your paper document, and it will be converted to a PDF automatically.
Q: How do I fill out PDF forms?
A: Use the PDF filler feature to complete forms, adjust text, and save your work directly in the document.
Q: How do I convert images like JPG to PDF?
A: Simply upload your image or photo, and the app will quickly convert it into a high-quality PDF.
GET STARTED NOW
Start editing, converting, scanning, and signing PDFs today with the ultimate PDF editor and file converter!
PRIVACY AND TERMS
Privacy Policy: https://editor-pdf.app/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://editor-pdf.app/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00133516:ios.description:
Pass your Pharmacy Technician exam with flying colors! Boost your confidence in passing the first time with our mobile app and a personal study plan based on your current skill and requirements.
The pharmacy Technician Certification Exam (PTCE) is used by The Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) as one of the four requirements for certification as a Pharmacy Technician. The test was designed as a result of a job analysis study conducted by the PTCB that determined the knowledge and skills needed to work as a pharmacy technician. It consists of multiple-choice questions with four answer choices.
Our app trains you in the required “knowledge domains” in the area of pharmacy:
– Medications (40%)
– Federal Requirements (12.5%)
– Patient Safety and Quality Assurance (26.25%)
– Order Entry and Processing (21.25%)
Key features:
- Choose from different topics required to become a certified pharmacist
- Practice with 500+ questions
- Track your strengths and weaknesses within Stats section of the app
- Study detailed statistics of every test you take
- Compare your score to the community average for almost any type of exam
PTCB Certified Pharmacy Technician™, PTCB™, PTCE™, Pharmacy Technician Certification Exam™ and CPhT™ are registered trademarks of the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board™ (PTCB®) and are administered exclusively by the PTCB®. This material is not endorsed or approved by the PTCB®.
- - - -
Purchases, subscriptions and terms
You need to buy a lifetime access or subscribe to get access to all features, courses and questions. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions are auto-renewable and are billed at the rate and period selected depending on the subscription plan. Users’ accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal can be turned off in Account Settings in iTunes after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00134503:ios.description:
Boss, your gym is overcrowded, so come build a unique luxury gym!
"Slimming Club" is a casual simulation game with exquisite graphics. In the game, you will play the role of a slimming club's boss, annd run slimming boot camps, help customers who need to slim down exercise to lose weight and help them regain their perfect figure. As the boss, your task is to set up a team of excellent trainers, turn this place into a first-class gym and launch a chain full of stores all over the world! (oﾟ▽ﾟ)
========Game Highlight========
•Build your very own gym
Huge map scenarios where you're free to expand anywhere! Like the Hawaiian style beach theme? Or do you prefer the forest theme of the Amazon rainforest? Or do you want to cover the outside of your gym with super cool rides? All you need to do is flick your fingers and it'll be right in front of you without having to wait!
•Immersive Realistic Gym Experience
There are treadmills, battle ropes, swimming, calisthenics, boxing and a wealth of other sports, each with a unique and interesting visual animations. Watch the guests working out hard in each gym and feel the fat burning!! You'll even move along with the poses of the customers to the upbeat music!
•Recruit employees with unique personalities.
Have you ever seen a tricky employee who comes to work with a bombastic hairdo? Ever seen an NBA player come out of retirement to teach you how to train with a battle rope? A chef who comes to apply for a job in order to lose weight, whom you even have to watch out for him sneaking out the food prepared for the customers! But our professional trainers will keep an eye on those lazy customers for you, so you just need to enjoy the beauty of it all in front of your screen!
•Fun interaction with customers
They need to be pushed during the weight loss process! Quickly encourage those customers who want to give up halfway and keep them going. In the end, your customers will successfully slim down, have a noticeable change in their bodies, and become handsome and beautiful while having better health. Also, when exercising they need energy! Don't forget to provide them with food, drinks, and even leisure services such as spa and private cinema, they will love it here and you will be one step closer to global fame!
Whichever of the following players you are, be sure to download and play!
•Fitness enthusiasts who often go to the gym
•Handsome men and women who want to slim down and have a perfect body
•Newcomers to fitness who want to lose weight and love restaurant food
•Casual players who want to play anytime, anywhere and collect idle earnings
•People who are looking for a idle or simulation game worth their time
•Management professionals who enjoy building and tapping to upgrade in simulation games

bluejetty:00170987:ios.description:
Help DU agents save the world from rebooting and defeat the enemy in this mystery detective!
Play the hidden object game, find lost items and find out what the Keeper’s is up to!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to uncover the mysteries of Detectives United 6: Beyond Time? Immerse yourself in a mystery detective, find hidden objects and solve puzzles. Explore unusual locations and learn all secrets of the Time Keeper.
The team of detectives receive a mysterious parcel. Its spell splits up the team. The agents find out about a mysterious creature that can change timelines. The detectives don’t have much time to stop the chaos created by this creature. They find the last heir of a family that has been protecting us all from the Time Keeper, and they set off to save the world from being reset in this paranormal investigation.
HOW TO PREVENT THE APOCALYPSE?
DU agents always manage to deal with anything on their own, but what to do if a powerful spell splits up your team, and all the documents you find indicate that we need to find an heir of an ancient family? An exciting plot that will be enjoyed by fans of hidden adventure games!
WHO IS THE TIME KEEPER?
Find clues, solve unsolved mysteries and complete fun mini-games to find out why the past changes and how to stop it in this mystery detective.
WILL DU AGENTS SAVE THE WORLD THIS TIME?
Complete engaging hidden objects scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO THE EWAN FLORENCE AND ANNA GRAY IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Ewan and Anna and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! Earn a variety of unique achievements! Tons of collectibles and puzzle pieces to find!
Detectives United 6: Beyond Time is a hidden object game where you need to seek and find missing objects like Sherlock. Stop the Time Keeper and solve the unsolved mysteries and puzzles.
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more! Zoom in on the scenes to help find all hidden objects, and use clues if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00169809:ios.description:
Teleprompter Pro is yet another video teleprompter app that allows you to display your text script on your phone’s video recording screen, so you can always be sure of what you’re going to say.
Whether you’re an influencer who wants to share your trip journey or makeup routine with your followers or are a teacher who is recording lessons for their students or needs a prompter for your public speaking sessions. The Teleprompter Pro app helps you look more confident and professional in your videos.
Some salient features of Teleprompter Pro:
• Record videos in multiple sizes: Teleprompter Pro supports the following aspect ratios: 16:9, 9:6, 4:5, 1:1, 9:4 which almost work for different social media platforms.
• Optimize Teleprompt Text: Unlike other Teleprompter apps that just display the text on the recording screen, Teleprompter Pro actually allows you to change text alignment, style (bold, italic, underline) & increase/decrease font-size as per requirements.
• Trim video: No video is perfect, in case you’ve made a blunder at a certain part, then you can actually trim your video and remove the unwanted part.
• Multiple scripts: You can as many scripts as you want. However, adding more than 1 script is available for the Teleprompter Premium subscribers only.
• Add Captions: Once your video is recorded and is finally ready, you can add captions for users who have hearing issues or anyone who prefers captions.
Benefits of using Teleprompter Pro:
• You’ll look more confident and your videos will feel professional.
• You’ll know what you’re going to say.
• People won’t feel like you’re reading text from elsewhere (which shall make you feel even more trustworthy and knowledgeable)
• You’ll be able to avoid mistakes.
• Your video will look live and engaging.
• You'll be able to speak clearly and articulately.
• You’ll be able to add captions to your videos and even optimize them as per the timing.
If you're looking to improve your video presentations, a teleprompter for video is a great option. It's easy to use and can make a big difference in the quality of your videos.
Here are some tips for using a teleprompter app:
• Practice reading from the teleprompter before you record your video.
• Make sure the text is large enough for you to read easily.
• Use a slow and steady pace.
• Look directly into the camera.
• Keep practicing until you get it all right.
With a little practice, you'll be able to use a Teleprompter app like a pro. And your videos will look and sound great!
Here are some examples of how you can use a teleprompter app:
• For business presentations: Use a teleprompter app to give presentations that are clear, concise, and professional.
• For educational videos: Use a teleprompter app to create engaging and informative videos for your students.
• For product demonstrations: Use a teleprompter app to create videos that show off your products in a clear and concise way.
• For interviews: Use a teleprompter app to give interviews that are well-prepared and polished.
• For vlogs: Use a teleprompter app to create vlogs that are interesting and engaging.
No matter what you use it for, a Teleprompter Pro is a great way to improve the quality of your videos. The app is compatible with iPhone as well as iPad. So what are you waiting for? Start using one today.

bluejetty:00186667:ios.description:
This app is designed to work with Filament-enabled print Bibles. It is not a Bible app—it is a unique print + digital Bible experience.
Filament enhances your print Bible with the powerful capabilities of your iPhone or iPad. You get the comfortable reading experience a print Bible can offer along with instant access to more meaningful content than you’ll find in any one study Bible or devotional Bible. Native digital content like streaming audio, informative videos, and interactive maps are directly connected to your Bible reading experience in a way never before possible!
With your physical Bible open, use the Filament Bible app to simply scan the page you are reading with your device’s camera. Your iPhone or iPad recognizes the page and instantly connects you to content centered around that passage. You'll get access to in-depth study notes, profiles of key people mentioned on the page, articles about important themes, devotionals, streaming audio, videos, and interactive maps that will help you really get a feel for the world of the Bible.
Filament also includes the opportunity to build your daily Bible reading habit with reading plans, designed to give you a simple list of the pages you need to read to keep on track with your Bible reading goals, whether it is to read through the entire Bible or just to get a sense for what the Bible says about a key topic.
Our prayer is that Filament will be a faithful companion as you engage with God through the Bible!

bluejetty:00132153:ios.description:
Build better habits. Track your streaks. Reach your goals.
Habit Tracker is the daily habit and goal tracker that helps you build healthy routines and stick with them. Whether you want to work out more, read every day, drink enough water, meditate, or improve your productivity, you can turn small daily actions into lasting habits. Set your goals, track your streaks, and watch your self-improvement journey unfold.
Why Habit Tracker?
Every great change starts with a single step. Habit Tracker makes that step effortless. Instead of relying on willpower alone, you get a simple, beautiful habit building system that keeps you accountable and motivated, day after day. Build your routine, stay consistent, and let your streak do the talking.
What you can track:
- Health and wellness: workouts, steps, water intake, sleep, nutrition
- Mindfulness and self-care: meditation, journaling, gratitude, breathing exercises
- Productivity and focus: reading, studying, deep work sessions, daily planning
- Lifestyle goals: screen time limits, meal prep, budgeting, morning routines
- Or create any custom habit that matters to you
Your habits, on every device:
Habit Tracker syncs seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. Create a habit on your phone, log your progress from your watch, and review your stats on your Mac. Your data stays perfectly in sync across all your Apple devices.
Widgets that keep you on track:
Add your habits to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, or Mac Desktop with beautiful widgets. Update your progress with a single tap, no need to open the app. Your daily habits are always one glance away.
Stay motivated with powerful stats:
Track your current and longest streaks, view your progress on a calendar, and see how consistent you have been over weeks and months. Share your milestones with friends to stay accountable and celebrate your wins.
Works with Siri and Shortcuts:
Log your habits hands-free with Siri or automate your routine with Shortcuts. Just say "Log my workout" and you are done. Build habits without breaking your flow.
Your data stays private:
Habit Tracker does not collect your personal information or track you in any way. Your habits are your business, and no one else's. No ads, no tracking, just your goals.
Start building better habits today, one day at a time.
The free version lets you create one habit. Unlock unlimited habits and the full experience with Habit Tracker Pro.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://habittrack.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00134092:ios.description:
אתר הכרויות DATELAND קיים משנת 2006 מה שהופך אותו לאחד האתרי הכרויות הוותיקים בישראל. יש בו מעל חצי מיליון משתמשים רשומים. היום יותר ויותר אנשים מעדיפים להשתמש באפליקציה בכל זמן ובכל מקום במקום לשבת מול המחשב ולכן השקנו אפליקציה מאוד מושקעת ואיכותית עבור האייפון והאייפאד שלכם. בעצם, עדיף שתורידו אותה ותחליטו בעצמכם כמה היא טובה :)
אם אתם תוהים למה אנחנו נקראים "רשת אתרי הכרויות" אז התשובה היא שדייטלאנד מאחדת הרבה אתרי הכרויות ובעזרת האפליקציה וחשבון אחד ב DATELAND אתם מקבלים גישה למאגר המשותף דבר שמאפשר לכם לחפש בכל האתרים האלה וכך מגדיל את הסיכוי להיכרות מהירה יותר ומגוון אפשרויות רחב יותר. בין האתרים האלה DATELAND עצמו וגם BLIND DATE (בליינד דייט), לאבקליק (LoveClick), אתר הכרויות "מכירים" (makirim), אתרים LoveCity, Valentines, capiyot, LOV.CO.IL כפיות ועוד רבים.
הינה על קצה המזלג היכולות (פיצ'רים) של האפליקציה: חיפוש אנשים שקרובים אליכם ,חיפוש לפי רמת ההשכלה, אפשרות להעלאות עד 30 תמונות באיכות גבוהה, אפשרות לקבוע תמונה ראשית,
בדיקה ידנית של התמונות, אימות פרופיל בחינם, סינון תוצאות חיפוש כדי לראות רק משתמשים מחוברים או פעילים, אפשרות לעשות "לייק" למשתמשים אחרים כדי להביע התעניינות, מסנון הודעות נכנסות שעוזר לחסום פניות לא רלוונטיות, רשימות מועדפים ועוד.
אם יש לכם שאלות או רעיונות, תשלחו לנו בבקשה למייל info@datesupport.net ונגיב במהירות ובשמחה!
_________
התקנת האפליקציה וההרשמה הם בחינם. אפשר ליצור כרטיס ללא תשלום, להעלאות תמונות, לצפות בתמונות בגודל מלא של משתמשים אחרים, לשלוח להם "לייק", להוסיף אותם לרשימת מועדפים ולשלוח משפט פתיחה. לפעמים, אפליקציה עלולה לבקש לשלם מנוי כדי להתכתב ללא הגבלות באופן חופשי. ניתן לרכוש מנוי לתקופות של חודש, 3 חודשים, חצי שנה ושנה. ככל שהתקופה יותר ארוכה, כך מחיר לחודש יוצא יותר זול. תנאים ספצפיים יכולים להיות תלויים במדינת המשתמש, המחירים והתעריפים מופיעים בצורה ברורה וחד משמעית במסך רכישת מנוי בתוך האפליקציה. אחרי 
 אישור שלכם ותשלום מוצלח הסכום הנקוב ירד מחשבון iTunes שלכם. אם מדובר ברכישת מנוי הוא יתחדש אוטומטית בתום התקופה. ניתן לבטל את המנוי בכל עת עד כדי 24 שעות לפני תקופת החידוש. התשלום עבור חידוש ירד מחשבון iTunes שלכם תוך 24 שעות לפני תום תקופת המנוי הנוכחי. אחרי רכישת מנוי תוכלו לשלוט בהגדרות שלו וגם לבטלו. כל הנתונים האישיים נשמרים בהתאם לתנאי שימוש. מידע נוסף פה: https://dateland.co.il/agreement

bluejetty:00023285:ios.summary:
Build a full suit from King to Ace. Clear the run. Do it eight times and the board is yours.
Spider Solitaire: Suit Master is the classic, dealt clean and playable anywhere. No connection, no timers you did not ask for, nothing between you
bluejetty:00023285:ios.description:
Build a full suit from King to Ace. Clear the run. Do it eight times and the board is yours.
Spider Solitaire: Suit Master is the classic, dealt clean and playable anywhere. No connection, no timers you did not ask for, nothing between you and the next deal.
CHOOSE HOW HARD YOU WANT IT
- 1 suit: welcoming, forgiving, a good place to learn the rhythm
- 2 suits: the balanced version most players settle into
- 4 suits: the real test, where every column matters
- Spiderette: a faster single-deck variant when you have five minutes
HOW IT WORKS
Stack cards in descending order. When you assemble a full King-to-Ace run in one suit, it clears. Out of moves? Deal a new row across the tableau and keep going.
A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
One fresh deal daily, the same for everyone. Keep the streak or skip a day. Nothing here punishes you for stopping.
UNLIMITED UNDO AND SMART HINTS
Try a line, back out, try another. You are not being graded. Stuck at midnight on a 4-suit board? Take the hint.
PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No Wi-Fi, no data, no interruptions. On a plane, on the train, in a waiting room, or anywhere the signal drops.
BUILT TO BE COMFORTABLE
- Large, high-contrast cards that are actually readable
- Portrait and landscape, whichever suits you
- Left-handed mode for genuine one-hand play
- Drag and drop or tap to move, your choice
- Auto-complete when the win is already decided
- Auto-save, so a half-finished board waits exactly as you left it
KEEP SCORE IF YOU WANT TO
Games won, best times, longest winning streaks, detailed stats per difficulty. Or ignore all of it and just deal.
Free to download and play.
Deal your first board in about five seconds.

Ever wished someone could read between your lines?
Welcome to Him — an immersive romance experience where you're not just reading a love story. You're living one. Every word you send shifts the tension, and every choice pulls you deeper.
Choose Who Stays
From slow-burn encounters to dark, consuming romances — Him offers a world of characters built to leave a mark.
A cold CEO who only softens for you. A dangerous stranger with a voice that lingers. A best friend who's been wanting you in silence.
Pick the one who haunts you — and let the first chapter begin.
Your Words Change Everything
Every message is a moment. Your choices shape how he looks at you, what he says next, and where the story goes.
Will it be tender and breathless, or intense and unraveling? The story bends to you — no two encounters are the same.
He Feels Real
He remembers what you said last night. He notices when you pull away. He reacts, he waits, he stays.
This isn't a chatbot. This is someone who exists only when you're here.
Stories That Leave a Mark
From the first glance to the moment you can't look away — Him turns romance into something you feel in your chest.
Every story is yours. Every scene stays with you.
Features
Real-time interactive chat with deeply responsive characters
A curated collection of complex personalities and storylines
Multiple romance settings — from modern to dark fantasy
Story-driven narrative that adapts to your every move
Relationship depth that builds with every conversation
Step into a story that was always waiting for you — one message at a time.
Your next obsession starts here, only on Him.
