bluejetty:00168076:ios.description:
Bíblia Sagrada Offline na versão atualizada de João Ferreira de Almeida (JFA)
A Bíblia João Ferreira Almeida é considerada a tradução mais importante da Bíblia em língua portuguesa. Foi realizada pelo pastor protestante português João Ferreira de Almeida a partir dos idiomas originais.
Nesse aplicativo você tem a possibilidade de fazer o download da Bíblia João Ferreira Almeida no seu telefone.
Leia uma passagem da Bíblia Sagrada todos os dias, ouça os seus capítulos favoritos, memorize milhares de versículos, desfrute e compartilhe a palavra de Deus no seu telefone.
Este aplicativo lhe oferece a Bíblia versão de João Ferreira Almeida completa, com o Antigo e o Novo Testamento:
Antigo Testamento:
Gênesis, Êxodo, Levítico, Números, Deuteronômio, Josué, Juízes, Rute, 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Reis, 2 Reis, 1 Crônicas, 2 Crônicas, Esdras, Neemias, Ester, Jó, Salmos, Provérbios, Eclesiastes, Cântico de Salomão, Isaías, Jeremias, Lamentações, Ezequiel, Daniel, Oséias, Joel, Amós, Obadias, Jonas, Miquéias, Naum, Habacuque, Sofonias, Ageu, Zacarias e Malaquias
Novo Testamento:
Mateus, Marcos, Lucas, João, Atos, Romanos, 1 Coríntios, 2 Coríntios, Gálatas, Efésios, Filipenses, Colossenses, 1 Tessalonicenses, 2 Tessalonicenses, 1 Timóteo, 2 Timóteo, Tito, Filemom, Hebreus, Tiago, 1 Pedro, 2 Pedro, 1 João, 2 João, 3 João, Judas, Apocalipse
A Palavra de Deus é muito mais que um registro histórico de documentos da antiguidade. Contém nada menos que a vontade revelada de Deus para todos os seus filhos. Bíblia Sagrada Almeida Atualizada em Português , sua palavra se torna mais clara que nunca.
Você vai quebrar com todo o mal que está ao seu redor com esses versos de Deus
Saiba todos os dias um pouco mais sobre a Bíblia e seguir o seu caminho e nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
Além disso, o aplicativo inclui um melhor estudo e compreensão da Bíblia:
- Estudo da Bíblia: Nós fornecemos uma compreensão básica de cada livro da Bíblia. Em cada guia o autor, data, finalidade da escrita, versos-chave, prenúncios e escreveu um breve resumo será incluído. Esta ferramenta irá ajudá-lo a entender melhor a Bíblia e vai encorajá-lo a estudar de maneira mais profunda.
- 140 Temas bíblicos para pregar como: Admiração, Adoração, Amor, Aprender, Batismo, Compreensão, Crianças, Deus, Espírito Santo, Evangelização, Jesus, Liberdade, Misericórdia, Paciência, Pecadom, Proteção, Purificação, Ressurreição, Sabedoria, Salvação, Transformação, Tristeza, Valioso, Verdade, Vício, Vida, Vida eterna, Viúvas ....
- Devocionais Diários: leituras breves de versos bíblicos relacionados, ajudassem você a estar mais de para perto de Deus todos os dias.
- Podcast Cristãos
- Versículos Bíblicos en audio
BENEFÍCIOS:
- Acesso aos livros da Bíblia João Ferreira Almeida em Português totalmente de graça
- Você pode gostar do texto ao seu gosto
- Você pode copiar os textos da App e compartilhá-los
- Fácil de ser usada, com a sua cara e ainda podendo utilizá-la sem precisar de acesso à internet.
- Disponível para todos os seus dispositivos celulares e tablets.
- Permite que você se movimente entre os capítulos.
- Possibilidade de aumentar ou diminuir o tamanho da letra do texto

Neste aplicativo você encontrará tudo o que precisa para sua alma !!!

bluejetty:00132054:ios.description:
PointClickCare's Point of Care (POC) application is an easy-to-use application that seamlessly integrates with PointClickCare's EHR. It enables front-line clinical care staff to capture and distribute timely, accurate, and complete documentation at the resident bedside. Task lists, schedules, complete documentation, and the ability to receive alerts and messaging all become easily available to your care staff at the bedside.
This app is intended to integrate with the PointClickCare EHR platform. If you are not a current PointClickCare client, but would like this solution, we suggest you contact PointClickCare.
Key benefits include:       
-Anytime, anywhere access for front line clinical care staff to key resident information, and with complete documentation at your fingertips care decisions are more easily made    
-Ability to view task lists and schedules thereby making sure nothing is overlooked and no staff overwhelmed                                                          
-The ability to receive alerts and messaging all within close proximity to a resident enabling you to quickly take action
-Real-time access to information to support better decisions

bluejetty:00128634:ios.summary: Children love playing with marble ball race toys and enjoy watching the balls roll along the track, over and over again. Our app aims to teach kids how to build marble ball tracks in a simple way, so they can naturally understand the mechan
bluejetty:00128634:ios.description:
Children love playing with marble ball race toys and enjoy watching the balls roll along the track, over and over again. Our app aims to teach kids how to build marble ball tracks in a simple way, so they can naturally understand the mechanics and logic behind how the tracks work. With our app, children can learn to build marble ball tracks step by step through imitation and practice, or they can freely create their own tracks. We provide a wide range of tutorials that enable children to quickly learn how to build various fun marble ball race tracks.
This app combines physics, mechanics, and programming to provide a fun and educational experience for children. By stimulating their creativity, it encourages children to explore and create mechanical devices, fostering an interest in STEM fields from a young age. This app is suitable for children aged 6 and above.
Features:
1. Provides over 40 tutorials for building marble ball tracks.
2. Children can learn to build marble ball tracks through imitation and practice.
3. Provides a large number of parts, including gears, springs, ropes, motors, axles, cams, basic shape parts, pistons, and other parts.
4. Offers combinations of parts to simplify and make the track-building process more interesting.
5. Provides a variety of material parts, including wood, steel, rubber, stone, and more.
6. Children can create their own marble ball track without any restrictions.
7. Provides 9 background themes.
8. Children can share their own mechanical creations online and download the marble ball tracks created by others.

bluejetty:00077916:ios.description:
Shop with ease and save more; whether at home or in store! Make the most out of your shopping experience with Meijer's app using the following features:
GROCERY DELIVERY and PICKUP
– Shop online & place an order for pickup or home delivery to skip the trip inside the store!
– To get started, select pickup or delivery from your home screen and use your personalized grocery & shopping lists to start building your cart.
– No membership required, no markup on products, and you can use your mPerks coupons and rewards!
– All your order details are in the Orders section, where you can review, edit, or cancel your order.
IN-STORE SHOPPING
– If you're grocery shopping in-store, remember to scan your mPerks barcode at checkout or link your mPerks to your credit card in the Accounts section so you never have to worry about it.
– Use Shop & Scan to scan items to add them to your cart, clip associated coupons, and skip the checkout line!
– Get organized for making a trip to the store by using the shopping list.
FIND YOUR FAVORITE PRODUCTS
– Explore our selection of grocery products, such as fresh produce, meats, dairy and more.
– Shop our seasonal and holiday collections.
– Stock up on everyday essentials including household items, snacks and more!
REWARDS
– Creating an account automatically signs you up for our mPerks rewards program!
– If you qualify for a reward, we'll start it for you!
– Track your reward progress in the Rewards section and stay up-to-date by opting in to email or push notifications.
COUPONS
– Browse coupons in the coupons section or easily find them as you're building your cart. Find deals in our weekly ad and apply coupons.
– Clip coupons to redeem in store when you enter your mPerks ID at checkout or to have them apply to your pickup/delivery order.

bluejetty:00120351:ios.description:
PLEASE NOTE! While Mightier is free to download, a Mightier Membership is required. Find out more at Mightier.com
Mightier helps children (ages 6 - 12) who struggle with their emotions. This includes kids who have a tough time with tantrums, feelings of frustration, anxiety, or even a diagnosis like ADHD.
Our program was developed by clinicians from Boston Children’s Hospital and Harvard Medical School and is designed to create a fun and engaging way for kids to practice emotional regulation through play….and become Mightier!
Players wear a heart rate monitor while they play, which allows them to see their emotions and connect with them directly. As they play, your child reacts to their heart rate. As their heart rates go up, the game gets harder to play and they practice how to bring their heart rate down (take a pause) in order to earn rewards in the games. Over time and with routine practice/play, this creates “Mightier moments” where your child breathes, pauses, or uses one of their practiced cool down strategies automatically when facing real world challenges.
Mightier includes:
A WORLD OF GAMES
Over 25 games on the platform and 6 worlds to conquer, so your child will never get bored!
THE GIZMO
Your child’s visual representation of their heart rate. This will allow them to see their emotions and connect with them directly. Gizmo will also teach your child emotional management skills when they find themselves in extreme duress.
LAVALINGS
Collectable creatures that represent big emotions. These will help your child connect with their range of emotions in a fun, new way.
PLUS…..for Parents
● An online hub to access a dashboard of your child’s progress
● Customer support from licensed clinicians
● Tools and resources to help navigate your Mightier parenting journey.

bluejetty:00120715:ios.name: Voice Analyst: Pitch & Volume
bluejetty:00120715:ios.summary:
See your pitch and volume live as you speak — record, measure, and track your voice for speech therapy, voice training, and singing.
Voice Analyst is used in speech pathology clinics, research centers, universities and homes in more than 1
bluejetty:00120715:ios.description:
See your pitch and volume live as you speak — record, measure, and track your voice for speech therapy, voice training, and singing.
Voice Analyst is used in speech pathology clinics, research centers, universities and homes in more than 180 countries, with over 12 million recordings made.
Winner of the Digital Health Award (Medilink SW Healthcare Innovation).
Listed in the Parkinson's UK tech guide:
https://techguide.parkinsons.org.uk/catalogue/voice-analyst
One purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscriptions.
MEASURE YOUR VOICE
• Watch live graphs of your pitch (in hertz or musical notes) and volume as you speak or sing.
• Record your voice and play it back alongside its pitch and volume traces.
• See statistics for any recording, or any part of it: minimum, maximum, average and range for both pitch and volume.
• Set pitch and volume targets and see instantly when your voice is inside them.
• Zoom in on any part of a recording to analyze it in detail, and save any portion.
• Split View and multitasking support on iPad.
MADE FOR SPEECH THERAPY
• Practice between appointments with the targets your speech-language pathologist sets — including the loudness targets used in programs such as LSVT LOUD for Parkinson's.
• Track progress over time with saved recordings and statistics.
• Use it in clinic, at home, or in remote telehealth sessions.
SHARE WITH YOUR THERAPIST
• Email recordings and statistics to your speech-language pathologist, or share by messaging and AirDrop.
• Save recordings to your device, or to iCloud, Dropbox and other cloud storage.
• Copy statistics into spreadsheets for records, reports and research.
WHO USES VOICE ANALYST
• Speech-language pathologists (SLPs) and therapists measuring clients' pitch and loudness, in clinic and via telehealth.
• People in voice therapy — for Parkinson's disease, stroke, brain injury, dysarthria, vocal fold palsy, muscle tension dysphonia and other voice difficulties.
• Transgender and non-binary people training their voice with clear pitch feedback.
• Singers, actors, teachers and presenters monitoring and developing their voice.
• Researchers and students measuring voice objectively.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your recordings stay on your device unless you choose to share them.
• Nothing is uploaded to our servers — clinicians stay in control of client recordings.
• GDPR compliant — no personal data is collected.
• Works offline — record and analyze anywhere.
WHAT USERS SAY
"Fantastically easy to see where your pitch is, to set target ranges, to make and analyze recordings, and to export and import recordings. I can't imagine working on my voice without this app."
"I've been using Voice Analyst with my transgender clients. It is incredibly user friendly and provides great visual readings of frequency as well as an instant analysis of pitch range and mean. My clients can use it in session and some have downloaded it to work with at home."
"Love this app. So simple to use yet it packs all the technology needed to make it easy for me to monitor and motivate myself."
Voice Analyst is not a medical device — it measures and records your voice; it does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you are concerned about the quality of your voice, see your doctor and ask for a referral to an Ear, Nose and Throat (ENT) specialist.
Questions or ideas? Email support@speechtools.co — we would be delighted to hear from you.

Struggling to fall asleep or stay asleep?
Remly makes bedtime simple with calming sounds, soothing white noise, guided meditation, and an easy sleep tracker & recorder. Drift off faster, sleep deeper, and wake up refreshed every morning.
Relax Instantly with Sounds & Meditation
Unwind with peaceful sounds, meditation tracks, and white noise designed to quiet your mind. Choose from nature sounds, soft music, or classic white noise — all crafted to help you relax, meditate, and sleep better.
Create Your Own Perfect Sound Mix
Don’t just listen — design your sleep environment. Combine sounds like rain, ocean waves, or birdsong with white noise and meditation music to build your personal soundscape. Every sound helps you find calm, focus, and rest.
Track & Record Your Nights
Remly is more than a sleep tracker. It’s also a powerful recorder that captures nighttime sounds like snoring, talking, or yawning. Together, the sleep tracker and recorder reveal how you sleep, while meditation and white noise help you improve it.
Discover Insights That Matter
With Remly’s sleep tracker, see how long you slept, view your patterns, and check what the recorder picked up during the night. Use these insights along with calming sounds, meditation, and white noise to build healthier sleep habits.
Simple, Sound-Centered Design
Remly keeps everything easy. Browse the sound library, enjoy meditation sessions, mix soothing sounds with white noise, and access your sleep tracker & recorder — all in a clean and intuitive interface.
Sleep Notes & Sleep Factors: Keep a mini journal before bed and log factors that may affect your sleep — like coffee, alcohol, stress, or light exposure. Combine your notes with Remly’s sleep tracker and recorder to see how these factors impact your nights.
Wake-Up Mood Log & Graphs: Track how you feel each morning. Record your wake-up mood and follow your patterns over time with simple, easy-to-read graphs. Pair this with meditation and calming sounds to improve both sleep and mornings.
Breathwork & Heart Rate Tracking: Remly links breathwork directly to your heart rate tracker. If your heart rate is elevated, the app guides you through calming breathing exercises. With sound therapy, meditation, and white noise, you’ll lower stress and prepare for deeper sleep.
With Remly, you can:
Sleep better with meditation, calming sounds, and white noise.
Personalize your experience using unique sound mixes.
Use the sleep tracker & recorder to understand your nights.
Improve your overall health with deeper, restorative sleep.
Download Remly today and unlock better nights with meditation, sound therapy, white noise, and the most intuitive sleep tracker & recorder.

bluejetty:00087783:ios.description:
Este NÃO É um simples aplicativo de exercícios ou fisioterapia.
É uma nova forma de entender sobre competência e eficiência física por meio da biomecânica funcional.
O conceito 3DGym possibilita a você usar abordagens de mobilidade e controle neuromuscular aplicados aos vetores biomecânicos do movimento humano para otimizar a reabilitação neuromotora, melhorar o condicionamento funcional e extrapolar o desempenho esportivo.
Isto não é fácil, mas criamos esta ferramenta para agilizar e potencializar sua eficiência e aplicabilidade cotidiana.
O conceito 3DGym não visa substituir uma rotina de exercícios, esportes ou de condicionamento cardiorrespiratórios, mas aprimorá-los e extrapolar sua eficiência. 
Para reabilitar, condicionar ou potencializar o desempenho de um indivíduo, não adianta aumentar a carga ou a intensidade dos exercícios progressivamente se não houver um comando neuromuscular para controlar essas ações e perpetuar seus benefícios.
A eficiência funcional é um equilíbrio da mobilidade articular adequada com o sinergismo de músculos estabilizadores, músculos de força agonistas e músculos antagonistas, como em uma orquestra. Esta convergência não é adquirida com ‘comandos voluntários’, mas criando-se uma necessidade neurofuncional e ativação sincrônica do movimento. O movimento fica mais fluido, a força se transforma em potência, economiza energia e aumenta o desempenho. Tudo fica mais fácil e os resultados aparecem mais rápido.
Neste aplicativo você vai encontrar:
- Centenas de abordagens para melhoria da mobilidade, do condicionamento funcional e do desempenho físico, de maneira progressiva e seguindo os conceitos 3DGym e da Biomecânica Funcional;
- Vídeos e orientações detalhadas para a realização adequada de cada exercício;
- Estratégias eficientes desde a reabilitação física neuromuscular, retorno ao esporte, condicionamento funcional e aumento de desempenho esportivo;
- Abordagens ultra-atualizadas, baseadas em evidências científicas e testadas em laboratórios biocinéticos 3D;
- Criação de treinos personalizados para seus clientes;
- Definição de exercícios favoritos para agilizar sua rotina; 
- Aulas explicativas com a fundamentação científica das abordagens e sobre como personalizá-las para seus interesses e objetivos;
- Acesso gratuito a seus clientes das rotinas de exercícios elaboradas por você, com todos os vídeos explicativos e número de séries e repetições.
O 3DGym App é uma ferramenta criada, desenvolvida e testada pelos mais conceituados pesquisadores brasileiros:
Gustavo Leporace
Fisioterapeuta e Educador Físico
Mestre e Doutor em Biomecânica Humana – UERJ/UFRJ
Diretor da Biocinética Laboratório do Movimento Humano
Leonardo Metsavaht
Médico Especialista em Ortopedia e Fisiatria
Mestre em Ortopedia - UFRJ
Diretor Científico do Instituto Brasil de Tecnologias da Saúde – IBTS
Além disso, conta com a colaboração de alguns dos principais profissionais do Brasil:
Fabio Arcanjo
Fisioterapeuta
Mestre e Doutor em Fisioterapia - UFBA
Diretor da AF Reabilitação
Rafael Winicki
Educador Físico
Especialista em Ciência do Esporte de Alto Rendimento
Preparador Físico da equipe de futebol do Clube de Regatas do Flamengo
IMPORTANTE:
As abordagens sugeridas neste aplicativo podem ser úteis na sua prática diária. No entanto, toda intervenção deve ser baseada em uma avaliação individualizada do cliente e indicada, prescrita, orientada e realizada por profissionais responsáveis e capacitados.

https://www.3dgym.app/termos-de-uso-do-app-3dgym
Política de privacidade:
https://www.3dgym.app/politicas-de-privacidade-do-app-3dgym

Kicksy gives expectant mothers the peace of mind that comes from staying connected to their baby's daily activity. Our beautifully designed app makes it simple to monitor kicks, track development, and create lasting memories of this special time.

STAY CONNECTED TO YOUR BABY

Count and time your baby's movements with our intuitive kick counter. Get reassurance from tracking patterns and see how your little one is growing more active each week.

FOLLOW YOUR BABY'S AMAZING GROWTH

Discover what's happening each week with detailed development milestones. See how your baby compares in size to everyday objects and learn about their incredible progress from tiny seed to full-term baby.

MONITOR YOUR WELLNESS

Log daily feelings, track weight changes, and record symptoms to maintain a complete picture of your pregnancy health. Generate comprehensive reports to share with your healthcare provider.

CREATE BEAUTIFUL MEMORIES

Visualize your pregnancy progress with stunning circular displays showing your journey's completion percentage. Share milestone moments with family and friends through beautifully designed progress images.

PREMIUM FEATURES

Unlock unlimited tracking sessions, detailed analytics, comprehensive health reports, and advanced sharing options with Kicksy Premium.

1
bluejetty:00095201:ios.description:
Add some fun to your iPhone with Mooshi, a shimeji-style app that brings adorable animated characters to your screen! Mooshi lets you enjoy playful companions right within the app or on your home screen through widgets.
**Key Features**
1. Playful In-App Shimeji
Inside the Mooshi app, pick up to six shimeji characters to hang out on your screen. They’ll walk, sit, climb, sleep, fly, or even tumble around. Tap or drag them to interact and watch their cute reactions!
2. Home Screen Widgets
Add Mooshi widgets to your iPhone’s home screen. Your shimeji character will appear in the widget, bringing charm to your device without affecting other apps.
3. Live Activity on Dynamic Island
For supported iPhone models, Mooshi offers a Live Activity feature on the Dynamic Island. Your shimeji characters will appear and move dynamically in this space, adding a fun and interactive element to your iPhone’s interface.
Mooshi is simple, fun, and built for iOS, following Apple’s guidelines for a smooth and private experience. Perfect for anyone who loves a bit of whimsy!
Download Mooshi today and let these lovable shimeji brighten your iPhone!
Note:
- Live Activity requires iOS 16.0 or later.
- Widgets require iOS 15.0 or later.
**Subscription**
- Weekly Access: $1.99
- Monthly Access: $3.99
- Yearly Access: $6.99
Subscriptions will be automatically renewed unless you cancel it before the next renewal day, within 24 hours.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. If you subscribe before a free trial ends, the remainder of the trial period will be forfeited. You can manage and cancel your subscription by going to your account settings in the App Store.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/terms/site.html

bluejetty:00017007:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017007:ios.description:
Pyramid Solitaire Saga, from the makers of Candy Crush Saga & Farm Heroes Saga!
Deal with the magic!
Challenge awaits you in this magical Solitaire game.
Join Helena and her loyal companion Kingsley on their journey to reveal the wonders of the Ancient World.
Find the clues by catching the Scarabs hidden beneath the Cards. You can match a Card that is one greater or lower than the one on your deck. 
Catch the running Scarabs and uncover clues to help you on your journey and reveal the long-hidden treasures and magic of the Ancients. 
Complete each episode to reveal a hidden treasure and transport to magical new worlds on a quest to reignite Khepri's prophecy.
Explore the lost places of the world where epic adventures await you in The Hidden Tomb, The Emerald Dream and beyond! 
Take on this Saga alone or play with friends to see who can get the highest score! 
Pyramid Solitaire Saga is completely free to play but some in-game items such as extra moves or lives will require payment.
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Pyramid Solitaire Saga features:
• Experience a new way of playing Solitaire with rich and exotic graphics set in Ancient Times
• Transport to magical new worlds with Helena the Treasure Hunter and Kingsley the cunning gerbil
• Powerful boosters to help with challenging levels
• Journey through exciting levels to unlock boosters and hidden treasures!
• Easy and fun to play, challenging to master 
• Hundreds of adventurous levels to complete – more to come!
• Leaderboards to watch your friends and competitors!
• Easily sync the game between devices and unlock full game features when connected to the Internet
• Available to play on mobile and tablet devices 
Already a fan of Pyramid Solitaire Saga? Like us on Facebook or follow us on Twitter for the latest news: 
facebook.com/PyramidSolitaireSaga
twitter.com/PyramidSaga
Do not sell my data: King shares your personal information with advertising partners to personalize ads. Learn more at https://king.com/privacyPolicy. If you wish to exercise your Do Not Sell My Data rights, you can do so by contacting us via the in game help centre or by going to https://soporto.king.com/
Last but not least, a big THANK YOU goes out to everyone who has played Pyramid Solitaire Saga!
IARC rating: 3+

• Moatheni – Your Daily Companion for Prayer and Worship
Moatheni is designed to be with you every moment of the day, helping you pray on time, recite the Quran, and remember Allah, it combines precision with a modern, fast, and intuitive design, all in a completely ad-free experience.
• Prayer Times & Qibla
Automatically detect accurate prayer times anywhere in the world, with a precise Qibla direction and an interactive map to help you find the correct direction with ease.
• Daily Athkar
Keep your daily remembrance close at hand with a complete collection of authentic athkar, including morning and evening athkar, before and after sleep, and much more. Enjoy beautiful audio recitations and supplications from the Quran and Sunnah.
• The Quran, Always With You
Read the entire Quran, listen to your favorite reciters in the background, start your Khatmah with a clear reading plan, and stay consistent with daily reminders for your assigned portion.
• Smart Prayer Notifications
Never miss a prayer with highly customizable notifications, before, on, and after athan, featuring beautiful sounds and flexible notification options. Receive additional notifications for the last third of the night, Duha prayer, fasting days, and Friday hour.
• Full Athan 
Listen to full athan for every prayer, even when your device is locked.
• Beautiful Widgets
A variety of widgets display prayer times, countdowns to the next prayer, supplications, the Hijri date, and more on your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island.
• Elegant Modern Design
Inspired by Apple’s design language, Moatheni offers a smooth, refined, and elegant experience with exceptional performance and attention to detail.
• Athkar Notifications
Receive notifications for Tasbeeh, Istighfar, Salah, and other athkar at any time you choose throughout the day.
• Islamic Events
Stay informed about important Islamic occasions with accurate dates and countdowns to upcoming events.
• Apple Watch Integration
View prayer times and athkar directly on your wrist with beautifully designed watch faces for every style.
• Daily Worship Tracker
Monitor your daily acts of worship and stay motivated with an elegant interface and dedicated widget.
• Day & Night Sunnah Guide
Know the time for Sunnah prayers, Duha, Qiyam Al-Layl, prohibited prayer times, Surah Al-Kahf, and more, all presented at the appropriate time.
• Nearby Mosques & Eqamah Times
Quickly find nearby mosques and set accurate eqamah times for every prayer.
• Dedicated Support
Access a comprehensive help center, frequently asked questions, and contact our support team directly via email or WhatsApp.
• Share anything

bluejetty:00072910:ios.description:
Ten Match! The classic logic game has come back!
This classic puzzle game is the best brain teaser for puzzle lovers also known as Make Ten, Take Ten. This game is perfect for you to exercise your brain in the spare time. With soft music and nice graphic, you will feel relaxing and calming down.
HOW TO PLAY
- Cross out the pairs of the same numbers (6-6, 3-3, 8-8) or those which add up to 10 (2-8, 3-7 etc). Two numbers can be removed by tapping on them one by one.
- The pairs must be located side by side, and you can cross out them vertically, horizontally and also, if one number stands on the last cell in the line and another stands on the first cell in the following line of the grid. There can also be empty cells between the 2 numbers.
- When there are no more numbers to remove, the remaining numbers can be added to the end.
- The goal is to cross out all the numbers and empty the board.
FEATURES
- Easy to learn and quite addictive
- Special boosters like Hints, Bombs and Undos
- Free to play and no wifi needed
- Complete Daily challenges or seasonal events to get unique trophies
- Customize your board with beautiful skins
Are you ready for a relaxing way to clear your mind and complete the free Ten Match Game? Take the challenge, and train your brain NOW! This entertaining mind game will bring you hours of fun!

bluejetty:00179737:ios.name: OLD: Pile - Collect Bookmarks
bluejetty:00179737:ios.summary: Keep your things beautifully in one place. The award-winning Pile app helps you having your things organised, ready to use whenever you need. Whether you like saving loads of links, taking notes or keeping your files tidy, Pile is for you.
bluejetty:00179737:ios.description:
Keep your things beautifully in one place. The award-winning Pile app helps you having your things organised, ready to use whenever you need. Whether you like saving loads of links, taking notes or keeping your files tidy, Pile is for you. 
Best of all, it's Privacy protected. We've built Pile from the ground up with Privacy in mind. You own your data, in a way we can't even access it! Because your data is stored in your iCloud, you still have the peace in mind your data is safely backed-up there.
We have an app for iPhone, iPad and Mac... Even Safari for Mac!
Pile offers a free trial of basic functionalities but in order to fully use the app you will need to purchase a lifetime license or a monthly subscription. 
"Great app! Perfect place to dump and organise all my favourite internet finds" 
—E. S.
"This is exactly what I need, a one stop shop for everything I like and need all over the internet, sleek and organised. Such a useful app, no more sticky notes everywhere for me!"
—M. M.
KEY FEATURES
· Links
Save links of blog posts for later, save those very interesting reads to share with your friend or that recipe you want to try. Read them nicely with Reader Mode, even when you have no internet connection. 
· Your Notes
To-Do Lists, shopping lists, quick thoughts or long diaries. You can even invite other people to write or view the note with you!
· Photos (and GIFs)
Memories from your last trip (finally we can travel again!), that beautiful doggie pic from Reddit, or that fun GIF that you can't wait to use in a chat group. 
· Files
PDFs, Word, Pages... Any type of file can be saved in Pile. And you can view them too, of course!
· Folders & Tags
Organise your content using Folders and Tags. As easy as a drag and drop. Then, search through your Folders or filter by Tags. 
MORE PILE TO LOVE
· (NEW) Protect cards and folders with FaceID or TouchID
Protect your content from bystanders by adding this extra layer of privacy - it will blur your cards and folders so no one knows what's in there, unless you unlock it
· Reader Mode
Read your saved articles without distractions in Pile's Reader Mode, which supports Dark Mode and offline, so you can read your links even in the plane. 
· Collaborate
Join your friends and create folders together. Family recipes, important blog posts for your business or keeping the best photos accessible to you all. 
· Offline
It's your content, so why shouldn't you be able to see it even when you have no internet?
· Search
Navigate through your content easily with a quick search.
· Activity
Sometimes you know you added a very interesting link last week but can't find it with all that other stuff... Just go to Activity, and you'll find exactly what you did last day. 
· Drag & Drop, Long Press
Adding, organising and viewing your content should be easy. So we've made it easy! Use the gestures you are used to in your iPhone. 
· Share
You choose what to do with your stuff. Share it with anyone, or don't - it's your choice!
· Multi-select
Manage a lot of items with ease.
· Import/Export Bookmarks
Bring your bookmarks from other apps or browsers into Pile in a moment!
· And much more!
MADE FOR IPHONE
Pile is tailored to the iPhone with deep system integrations as well. A great example is the Share Extension, which allows you to add anything from other apps, such as a link to a website you want to get back to. 
GET PILE TODAY
Whatever you want to keep, Pile can help you. Install the app today and see how beautiful your things are!
If you have any questions, please get in touch. We provide professional support and will be glad to help you!
For subscription support, please use https://pile.ie/contact
For subscription Terms & Conditions, please go to https://pile.ie/terms
For Privacy Policy, please go to https://pile.ie/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00131253:ios.description:
Step into a brand new fantasy world in Overmortal, a captivating text-based adventure Card RPG.
Born as a nobody? This world will show you that anything is possible! Immerse yourself in the extraordinary journey of transforming from a mortal to an immortal, unraveling the secrets behind your seemingly ordinary origin.
A vivid tapestry unfurls before you: exploring countless Realms, engaging in story-driven dialogs with NPCs, challenging bosses from different Worlds, evolving your pets into human-like companions, combining your skills, and soaring to the top on your server.
Each choice leads you towards an unknown branch...
[PICK YOUR OWN PATH]
On the path to power, choices abound. Will you embrace darkness or brightness? Each decision carries its own price, and in turn, bestows upon you a unique gift of fate.
Of course, you can just go with the flow and enjoy your adventure in the fantasy world without making tough decisions!
[MASTER YOUR SKILLS AND PATHS]
Will you enhance your physical form, practice magic, or become a master of the sword? Choose your skills and paths to unleash the ultimate combat prowess!
[EFFORTLESS IDLE GAINs]
Only want to enjoy text adventures? Our auto-play feature frees your from toils and grinding!
[SOLO OR X-SERVER BATTLES?]
Seeking to immerse yourself in the enchanting world alone? Absolutely possible.
Craving to break free from the traditional single-player mode of Card RPGs and engage in PvP battles with adventurers from around the globe? Here, your dreams can come true!
[PETS IN HUMAN FORMS?]
Pets here are more than just pets! Turn your pets into human-like companions to get on the adventure with you!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/V9vn3fCyK7

MBLEx Test Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry exam experts. With more than 1,500 high-quality test questions and answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system, it helps you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, making it more likely that you will pass the MBLEx certification exam on your first try!
MBLEx Test Prep 2026 now supports The Massage and Bodywork Licensing Examination (MBLEx) exam preparation. Our exam experts will update and revise the content based on the latest exam syllabus provided by the Federation of State Massage Therapy Boards (FSMTB).
MBLEx Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the exam with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,500 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the MBLEx certification exam can be difficult, but with the help of MBLEx Test Prep 2026, if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals!
Don't feel confused or frustrated about preparing for the MBLEx exam, effective changes take time and effort, follow in the footsteps of MBLEx Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.

bluejetty:00186538:ios.description:
The most powerful and feature rich mobile Kakuro game available. (Smartphone Magazine - Best Number Puzzle Game Winner 2007, 2008)
Ready for a new challenge? Kakuro, also known as cross sums, is similar to Sudoku but with an additional twist. It is the latest craze to come from the land of the rising sun. Infact it's a bigger hit in Japan than SuDoku !
Similar rules and just as addictive...
V3 Features a Brand New Puzzle Generator -
All puzzles guaranteed to be solvable by logic alone.
Kakuro is our mathematics and logic puzzle game that includes many unique features. Ideal for daily brain training or relaxation. 
"As the Kakuro puzzles get more advanced, the Mastersoft tools supplied are extremely clever and really help. If you like logic puzzles, I recommend Mastersoft’s ingenious implementation of this game." - Smartphone Magazine 
Features:
Unlimited kakuros.
* Many Unique Mastersoft Features including the ability to set bookmarks (or flags) during the game, which allows you to explore possible solutions and quickly get back to a known starting point if it doesn't work out using the 'Ball of String' function. Includes a uniques 'combo calcuator' which quickly shows you potential number combinations for each sequence in the puzzle. Ball of String, Flag Trail, combo calc and more ...
Work your way up from Beginner to Kakuro Master ! 
Cool scoring system. 
Easily the most powerful Kakuro / Cross Sums game for iPhone. 
Enter your working out.
Choose from a full pallette to color code your entries which with multiple undos makes it easy to try different solution strategies.. 
Various types of hint such including:
 1. Naked Singles
 2. Unique Combos
 3. Suggest a Cell
 4. Suggest a value
 and many more ...
Six levels of difficulty from 'Simple' to "Kakuro Master" .
Six board sizes.
Unique gameplay with increasing difficulty.
Designed with the help of over 100 Kakuro Players. Plays the way you want it to ! 
Built in timer. 
Rating.
Advanced statistics.
and Lots, lots more!
>-
EULA Agreement:
http://www.mastersoftmobilesolutions.com/eula.htm
Privacy policy:
http://www.mastersoftmobilesolutions.com/privacy.htm
About our auto-renewal subscriptions:
All subscriptions are related to our Kakuro Pro service. See "What's Included" for more details. Service prices depend on the length of service purchased as shown on the purchase buttons. You can currently subscribe for 1 month. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will be automatically renewed unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period and the cost of renewal will be shown. You can manage your subscriptions, and auto-renewal can be turned off if you go to your account settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00015750:ios.description:
The Steer Clear® app is part of a comprehensive program that helps young drivers reinforce positive driving behavior. Young drivers, under age 25, who complete the Steer Clear® Safe Driver Program, may be eligible for an adjustment to the premium on their State Farm® auto insurance. The Steer Clear mobile application tracks a driver's progress through pre-set learning modules of updated content including topics such as Bluetooth, distracted driving (texting/games), and special driving situations. Drivers will no longer need to manually record their trips if the program is conducted through this app. Throughout their trips, drivers will be scored and given feedback on their braking, acceleration, and cornering. Once a driver completes the program, they will receive a program completion certificate that they can text, email, or bring into the agent's office. Badges have been added to Steer Clear to recognize and reward a variety of specific driving accomplishments. The badges will help align users to shared goals of the app, such as scoring a certain percentage on a specific driving behavior, while acting as virtual, motivational status symbols.
Feel free to leave comments on the App Store or on our Facebook Teen Driver Safety page: www.facebook.com/sfteendriving
*The Steer Clear® Safe Driver Program is not available in all states.

bluejetty:00086739:ios.description:
Our chatbot is built on the robust and powerful artificial intelligence infrastructure, making it one of the most advanced chatbots available on the market today.
G-CHAT App is designed to be user-friendly and easy to use. With its advanced language processing capabilities, it can understand and respond to a wide variety of user inputs, making it perfect for both personal and business use. Whether you're looking for a way to automate customer service, or you need a chatbot that can handle more complex interactions, G-CHAT has you covered.
One of the most unique features of G-CHAT is its ability to automatically detect and translate more than 49 languages. This makes it perfect for businesses or individuals who need to communicate with customers or partners in different languages. 
With G-CHAT, you'll never have to worry about language barriers again!
With G-CHAT, users can easily download the application from the Apple Store and start using it on their iPhones right away. This chatbot is designed to be intuitive and easy to use, so users can quickly get started with their tasks and start learning new things from it.
G-CHAT is also designed to be highly customizable, so users can tailor it to their specific needs. If You need a chatbot that can help you learn a new language, G-CHAT can be easily configured to meet your needs.
So if you're looking for a powerful and versatile chatbot for your iOS device, look no further than G-CHAT. Download it today from the Apple Store and experience the power of AI-powered chatbot for yourself! 
With its advanced language detection and translation capabilities, G-CHAT is the perfect open source ai app to help you break down language barriers and expand your reach.
All of These Features Require Auto-renewable Paid Subscription
Voice Over Texts
It is the feature that allows our artificial intelligence-supported chatbot to voice the answers and content. Users will now be able to listen to the answers they get from the AI in human voice by pressing the "Voiceover" icon. In this way, visually impaired people will be able to use the chat bot easily.
Language Translation
It is a feature that allows to translate more than 90 languages. In this way, our users will be able to easily translate texts, sentences and articles into many languages thanks to artificial intelligence. They will be able to share the translated texts with other applications.
AI ART
Artificial intelligence, one of the powerful symbols of technological evolution, continues to advance rapidly in line with current developments in the field of deep learning. Our company is also developing rapidly in the field of data visualization day by day.
Our AI ART feature is an artificial intelligence product that transforms texts expressed in natural language into images.
Our artificial intelligence recognizes the meaning of around 2 billion parameters. Then he transforms it into images that have never been done before, using the sentences given to him. In fact, you do what you dream of. If you want your image to be suitable for a certain art movement or to resemble the works of an artist, you can specify this in the description section. In this way, we enable our users to create unique artworks and paintings beyond their imagination. Our users can save these images or easily share them with other applications.

Supported Game Systems

bluejetty:00079796:ios.description:
Delta is an all-in-one emulator for iOS and iPadOS. Delta builds upon the strengths of its predecessor, GBA4iOS, while expanding to include support for more game systems such as NES, SNES, N64, and DS.
FEATURES
Supported Game Systems
• Nintendo Entertainment System
• Super Nintendo Entertainment System
• Nintendo 64
• Game Boy (Color)
• Game Boy Advance
• Nintendo DS
• And plenty more to come!
Online Multiplayer
• Play online-compatible Nintendo DS games with friends around the world!
• Connect via community Nintendo WFC servers
• Choose one of the default servers, or provide a custom DNS
Controller Support
• Nintendo Switch Pro controllers, Joy-Cons
• Nintendo Switch Online controllers (NES, SNES, N64)
• PS4, PS5
• Xbox One S, Xbox Series X
• MFi game controllers
• Bluetooth & wired keyboards
Save States
• Save and load save states for any game from the pause menu.
• Lock save states to prevent them from being accidentally overwritten.
• Automatically makes backup save states to ensure you never lose your progress.
• Support for “Quick Saves,” save states that can be quickly saved/loaded with a single button press (requires external controller).
Cheats
• Supports various types of cheat codes for each supported system:
• NES: Game Genie
• SNES: Game Genie, Pro Action Replay
• N64: GameShark
• GBC: Game Genie, GameShark
• GBA: Action Replay, Code Breaker, GameShark
• DS: Action Replay
Delta Sync
• Sync your games, game saves, save states, cheats, controller skins, and controller mappings between devices.
• View version histories of everything you sync and optionally restore them to earlier versions.
• Supports both Google Drive and Dropbox.
Custom Controller Skins
• Beautiful built-in controller skins for all systems.
• Import controller skins made by others, or even make your own to share with the world!
Hold Button
• Choose buttons for Delta to hold down on your behalf, freeing up your thumbs to press other buttons instead.
• Perfect for games that typically require one button be held down constantly (e.g. run button in Mario games, or the A button in Mario Kart).
Fast Forward
• Speed through slower parts of games by running the game much faster than normal.
• Easily enable or disable from the pause menu, or optionally with a mapped button on an external controller.
3D/Haptic Touch
• Use 3D or Haptic Touch to “peek” at games, save states, and cheat codes.
• App icon shortcuts allow quick access to your most recently played games, or optionally customize the shortcuts to always include certain games.
Game Artwork
• Automatically displays appropriate box art for imported games.
• Change a game’s artwork to anything you want, or select from the built-in game artwork database.
Misc.
• Gyroscope support (WarioWare: Twisted! only)
• Microphone support (DS only)
• Support for delta:// URL scheme to jump directly into a specific game.
Delta Terms of Use: https://altstore.io/terms
**Delta is in no way affiliated with Nintendo. The name "Nintendo" and all associated game console names are registered trademarks of Nintendo Co., Ltd.**

bluejetty:00115676:ios.description:
Remember the days of playing Spin the Bottle? Well it's time to do play again - with style! 
Visually attractive, with lots of options and different themes, including sound effects, bottles, surfaces, statistics and all the stuff you can think of.
Spin my Bottle lets you play with friends or alone, while providing great atmosphere thanks to beautiful themes like “beach”, “campfire”, “picnic” or “party”, all with suitable sound effects and music to accompany the unique behaviour of the bottle.
All play modes offer advanced statistics for the geek in you.
Truth or dare: training camp
Let's be frank: the main objective of playing truth or dare with a bottle is to do the wrong things to the right people! That’s why you need a training camp to master your bottle-spinning skills. Become a pro who always hits the (human) target, no matter what the chosen surface! No messing with chance, this is (physically) the real thing!
But be careful: you could crash the bottle! (A nice way to play tricks on your friends, though.)
Features:
- 6 preset themes ("beach”, “party”, “picnic”, etc.)
- hidden bonus themes
- advanced physical features (bottle weight, surface friction, etc.) 
- sound effects (adjustable music fitting each theme perfectly)
- training camp (hit the angle by pressing the middle of the bottle to activate)
- crash bottle (on/off)
- statistics for spins and acceleration
- highscore
- smooth animations
- fast-paced
Additional attractions: your five minutes of worldwide fame
This version also enables you to add custom backgrounds by selecting a photo from your photo roll.
In the forthcoming update you will even be able to use the built-in camera and to move and scale your own pictures.
Please send us suggestions for backgrounds/themes. Chances are your picture
(with credits) will be implemented in the next update! Send the picture (320x480 pixels) to: neeedapps@googlemail.com

bluejetty:00178675:ios.summary:
Keep Your Tasks and Schedule Organized — Easy and Quick!

bluejetty:00178675:ios.description:
Keep Your Tasks and Schedule Organized — Easy and Quick!
This is a full digital equivalent of a classic pocket paper planner with a weekly view and traditional page-flipping, turning any number of tasks into a clear plan for your day, week, month, or year.
It lets you plan all your personal and work-related tasks with maximum ease, simplicity, and speed, giving you an instant overview of how busy your time is.
The planner combines a notebook, scheduler, calendar, habit tracker, and to-do list—all in one app. It replaces your familiar paper organizer with a perfectly identical, high-tech version so you can effortlessly create plans, track their progress, and achieve your goals.
Remember: a dream written down alongside a date becomes a goal!
Millions of people worldwide already use our planner. It helps create schedules, take notes, manage client lists, keep track of tasks and shopping lists, build habits, stay productive, and never forget anything.
The interface mimics the classic paper notebook with page-flipping that people have used for centuries. It’s the simplest and most intuitive way to plan—like a school diary or a minimalist paper planner.
On the main screen, you see all your plans for the week—the most manageable timeframe for convenient planning. You can easily flip forward or backward through as many weeks, months, or years as you want.
Any tasks, plans, habits, or lists are easy to add, edit, or delete. No complicated data entry systems, no filling out forms—just type or speak your notes as you would in any regular memo.
Key planner features:
• Smooth page-flipping just like a paper calendar (planner, organizer). No need to carry a paper notebook anymore.
• Full-week view plus an expanded single-day view for more notes. All your plans at your fingertips.
• A variety of background designs to suit even the most discerning taste. Change them as many times as you want.
• Calendar for easy navigation to any date, past or future.
• Highlight notes with color, underline, strikethrough, bold, or italic font—all to prioritize tasks and mark completed ones.
• A separate notes page (to-do list) not tied to any date. Use it for shopping lists or jotting down valuable thoughts.
• Week numbers displayed and one-tap return to the current date anytime.
• Customizable color and font size for entries and events.
• Language selection.
• Choice of the first day of the week.
• Voice input for adding entries, plus Apple Pencil support on iPads.
• iCloud backup and restore—your data is always safe.
By popular demand, we also added:
• Recurring events (daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly, etc.) Perfect for birthdays, workouts, schedules.
• Automatic reminders (notifications you requested).
• Checkboxes to mark completed tasks.
• Hourly breakdown for days, making it easier to plan consistent schedules.
• Ability to share your schedule with colleagues, friends, and family.
• Word search function.
• Integration with calendars like Google Calendar and iPhone Calendar.
• And much, much more.
The basic planner features are always FREE. You can also upgrade to Premium with a one-time purchase or subscription.
E-mail: appweeklyplanner@gmail.com
This app is subject to Apple’s standard End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Enjoy using it!

bluejetty:00151356:ios.description:
Study the Bible with WordGo
Scripture, questions, study notes, and audio teaching delivered to your phone daily. 
WordGo by Bible Study Fellowship is a free Bible study resource, designed to help you get into the Bible, and stay in it. Our content, created by Bible Study Fellowship’s network of trusted scholars, can help you establish a daily rhythm of verse-by-verse Bible study. 
Our Bible courses range from 1 to 6 weeks and our growing course library includes studies in Genesis, Joshua, Ruth, 1 Kings, John, Acts, 1 Corinthians, Thessalonians, Hebrews, James, 1 Peter, Revelations and many more. 
HOW WORDGO WORKS
To get started simply pick a short-course and choose if you want to study solo or invite your friends to join your group Bible study. Then:
Read the Scripture
Answer guiding questions
Dive deeper with study notes
Listen to trusted audio teaching
WordGo has members in over 150 countries and is used in many contexts; personal Bible study, church small groups, college ministry, worship teams, family Bible study and friends gathering together around God’s Word. 
SOLO USERS
Customize your Bible study experience; select how long you want to study for each day and set daily study reminders
Write and save your private notes in the app
Change your course at anytime
GROUPS
Invite family and friends to join your group Bible study
Meet in person or online
Share your group guide role with another member in your group
Access resources and training to help you guide your group
CHURCHES
Designed with small groups in mind 
Supports discipleship and fosters community 
Content written by Bible Study Fellowship’s network of trusted scholars
Church resources available to promote WordGo groups in your church 
CONNECT WITH WORDGO
Join the WordGo community on Instagram, Facebook and Twitter
Visit wordgo.org to learn more. 
“...we think we’ve found a way for you to get into the Bible...and stay in it...”

bluejetty:00164050:ios.description:
‣ Manage multiple email accounts in one secure inbox, including IMAP and POP3. 
‣ Smart inbox, fast search, customizable tools, and intuitive email management for maximum productivity.
‣ Reliable, responsive user support when you need it most. 
■ ONE PLACE FOR ALL YOUR EMAILS
Manage your entire email communication: Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail, iCloud, Outlook, or Exchange. Aqua Mail supports most of the major email providers and any other IMAP or POP3-enabled email account.
■ BOOST EMAIL PRODUCTIVITY
Get more done with an intuitive email UI that eliminates inbox distractions, helping you focus on the most important messages.
■ PRIVACY & SECURITY FIRST 
‣ Security and Privacy are our core values. Aqua Mail does not collect and store your passwords, emails, or private message content.
‣ Touch & Face ID to unlock the app 
■ EASY ACCOUNT SETUP
The app will apply presets or recognize incoming and outgoing server names based on your email address. It provides automatic or manual setup, depending on the type of email provider and service.
■ SMART INBOX
Sync all your email inboxes from different providers in one unified Smart inbox. 
■ CONVERSATIONS
Aqua Mail organizes your related messages into conversations, which outline all messages on one screen, so you can check everything at a glance, or take quick action on the message that concerns you the most.
■ CUSTOM INBOX MANAGEMENT
‣ Easily manage your custom inboxes - Create, Rename, and Delete folders.
‣ Color-code your email accounts for better clarity in the Smart Inbox. 
‣ Get instant email delivery with Push mail 
■ UNSUBSCRIBE 
Easily unsubscribe from unwanted newsletters with just one tap. 
■ FAST SEARCH
Find the message you need through a fast search by Sender, Header, Body, and All.
■ BULK ACTIONS
‣ Quick Select, or Select all, mark as Read, or Delete as many email messages as you wish.
‣ Filter your inbox by Unread, Read, Starred, or Attachment. 
■ COMPOSE MESSAGE
Switch between accounts when in Smart Inbox. Compose and send messages with simplicity. Attach photos, files, or documents directly from your device’s gallery or iCloud Drive. Save the message to Drafts to update them later.
■ PRODUCTIVE OPERATIONS & SETTINGS
‣ Swipe actions 
‣ Undo Actions
‣ Manage contact images in the message list
‣ Edit Sender & Account name 
‣ Set preferred language
‣ Autocompleting contacts from your address book 
‣ Manage notifications 
‣ Manage the content preview 
‣ Break up emails by date
■ CREATE CUSTOM EMAIL SIGNATURE
■ DARK THEME
Rest your eyes with a dark alternative of your inbox.
◉ GO PREMIUM and GET FULL ACCESS to:
- Managing unlimited accounts from any email provider
- Remove ads
- Unsubscribe 
- Push for Exchange
- Remove promo signature in sent emails
- First-Rate support 
Your subscription fuels ongoing app updates and continuous improvement by our dedicated developers, bringing new and helpful features with each App Store release. 
CONTACT: If you have any questions, please contact us directly at support@aqua-mail.com

bluejetty:00036612:ios.description:
«Find Differences - Spot It» is a puzzle game of attentiveness and concentration, in which you have to find 10 differences in pictures. This game develops observation skills, visual thinking, improves memory, reduces stress and increases concentration. The game has no time limit and is suitable for all ages.
How to play?
1. Look closely at two similar pictures.
2. Find an obvious difference and click on it.
3. If you have difficulties, use the hint.
4. Do not overuse them - they are limited!
5. After passing one image, move on to the next.
Game features:
- No time limit
- Content suitable for all ages
- Different difficulty levels and a smooth entry threshold
- Various image themes
- Hints and zoom function
- Ability to play offline
- Dark theme and much more inside!
If you encounter a bug or have any suggestions, please send us an email at support@bytecore.studio. We appreciate your feedback and will definitely take it into account in future updates. Thank you for playing our game!
We now have our own community on Discord, join us and participate in the development of our application: https://discord.gg/yhmBTQ8YtC

bluejetty:00017299:ios.summary:
- Unrestricted character creations!

- Sword? Magic? Anything you like!
"Profession", which is often the case with RPG, does not exist
bluejetty:00017299:ios.description:
- Unrestricted character creations!
With more than 500 billion combinations available, feel free to create your own character to your liking!
- Sword? Magic? Anything you like!
"Profession", which is often the case with RPG, does not exist in Toram. Sword? (Magic) Staff? Bow? Halberd? Feel free to decide your own fighting style!
- Build & Train your character to your heart's content!
Equipped with a "Skill Tree" system enabling players to enhance and strengthen their characters as they wish.
Create combos and discover your own battle style!
- Changeable weapons and equipment color! 
You can color your favorite weapon with the color you like when you obtain equipment with a "Color Info"!
Moreover, you can freely create the abilities of your equipment as you proceed further with the game...!
- Go on an adventure with your friends across the country!
RPG (MMORPG) that can be played and connects you with your friends online across the country!
The powerful monster that you fail to beat on your own could possibly be knocked down by forming a party with your friends! Let's explore the vast and beautiful 3D world with many friends!
- Party play even by yourself!
You can even enjoy party play when you are playing alone by borrowing and battling together with other player's character known as "mercenary" or by summoning a "partner" from your own sub-characters!
【Story Setting】
Decades ago, the world was hit by a devastating catastrophe, crumbling the ground into pieces. The gods quickly gathered the pieces scattered in all directions and hurriedly put them together. The result, a bizarre looking world resembling a mosaic.
The nation that was originally there had ceased to exist. As a result of repeated clashes of principles and interests among the 4 tribes, the people split into 4 factions.
At such times, an adventurer (you) came to this peculiar world.
The adventurer (you) goes through a series of adventures while meeting various people belonging to the 4 factions in the world to confront the secretly proliferating mysteries behind it....
【Game Details】
Title: Toram Online - Departure from Iruna -
Category: MMORPG with complete freedom
[Recommended Requirements]
OS : iOS 16 or later & iPadOS 16 or later
SoC : Apple A14 / M1 or higher
RAM : 4GB or more

bluejetty:00131386:ios.summary: Reverse Lookup is a FREE reverse phone lookup app for iOS devices that retrieves all available information associated with a phone number. It also displays spam likeliness of any phone number. This app is a handy tool to quickly locate more
bluejetty:00131386:ios.description:
Reverse Lookup is a FREE reverse phone lookup app for iOS devices that retrieves all available information associated with a phone number. It also displays spam likeliness of any phone number. This app is a handy tool to quickly locate more information on unknown callers before you answer their calls. Currently, it works for cell, landline, toll-free, and fax phone numbers from the United States and Canada.
FEATURES:
- Find information on phone numbers
- Copy/paste numbers from the call log
- Report suspected scammers
- Block callers based on number prefix
- Completely free
To use this app, you must enter a valid 10-digit phone number, then lookup that number. The phone number you lookup can be a number issued by any carrier, including AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, etc. Reverse Lookup will retrieve information associated with that phone number instantly. This app also ensures that it has the most recent and reliable data for that number before displaying the result. If the phone number you search is a business phone number, the app will present the identity of that business.
We hope that you will find this phone number information finder tool useful. Please help this app grow by sharing it with your friends and family.

bluejetty:00180079:ios.summary:
The ADAC Pannenhilfe App offers you quick and intuitive help with reporting accidents or breakdowns to the ADAC worldwide. It is easy to use and always ready for use.
To save time in an emergency, you can create your profile and your vehic
bluejetty:00180079:ios.description:
The ADAC Pannenhilfe App offers you quick and intuitive help with reporting accidents or breakdowns to the ADAC worldwide. It is easy to use and always ready for use.
To save time in an emergency, you can create your profile and your vehicles in advance in the app and/or have your data synchronized by registering (login) on adac.de.
Thanks to the location function, the ADAC Pannenhilfe App automatically determines the location of your breakdown. In an emergency, all important information can be transmitted to our helpers quickly and easily. Once you have requested help, you will be kept up to date on the current order status via push and status messages. You will also be informed of the expected waiting time and you will have the opportunity to track the driver's location live shortly before arrival.
The ADAC Pannenhilfe App is available to all users free of charge - including non-members. However, the assistance provided by ADAC roadside assistance is only free for members within the scope of the membership conditions.
This is what the ADAC Pannenhilfe App offers:
• quick help in the event of a breakdown and accident worldwide
• uncomplicated breakdown reporting without a phone call
• roadside assistance for cars, motorcycles and bicycles
• location determination worldwide
• status updates including live tracking
• immediate help or appointment request
• automatic language recognition German / English
• digital membership card always available
• barrier-free for people with impairments
• accident checklist

bluejetty:00136837:ios.summary: ●"I've always used the app mostly to check my favorite fictional characters and their MBTI types. Over time, I made some new friends with similar interests. The app feels really safe to use, and I'm truly grateful for it because I met my bo
bluejetty:00136837:ios.description:
●"I've always used the app mostly to check my favorite fictional characters and their MBTI types. Over time, I made some new friends with similar interests. The app feels really safe to use, and I'm truly grateful for it because I met my boyfriend here." 
●"Great app for connecting with others and learning about your own and others' personalities. You also get to explore the MBTI theory of cognitive functions."
●"I downloaded this to see my personality stuff and who else has the same one. Honestly, it's so fun! Premium features are totally worth it. Overall, the app is easy to use and feels amazing for introverted people like me."
●"Pdb has quietly changed how I see myself. I've learned so many new things about typology here and got to know lots of new people. You can customize your profile so nicely, and everything feels very inclusive."
---
Find your people — the ones who actually get you.
Pdb is where introverts, deep thinkers, and personality nerds come together. Type your favorite character, discover your cognitive functions, and meet real friends who share your wavelength. Whether you're an INFP looking for someone who understands your inner world, or an ENTP ready to debate character typings at 2am — this is your place.
---
What makes Pdb different
● Personality Database: Over 2 million profiles of characters, celebrities, theme songs, and real people — all typed by the community. From anime protagonists to your favorite musicians, discover who resonates with your essence and find your type twins.
● Friends who get you: Not another swipe app. Pdb matches you through shared personality, interests, and the conversations that actually matter. Send thought bubbles, react to profiles, and let friendships grow naturally from real connection — not forced small talk.
● Go deep on typology: MBTI, cognitive functions, Big 5, Enneagram, Socionics, Attitudinal Psyche — explore the frameworks that help you understand yourself and others on a deeper level. Our compatibility tools show you how different types connect, clash, and complement each other.
● Post-movie deep dives: Just watched something? Look up the characters on Pdb, debate their personality types with fellow fans, and connect with people who love analyzing stories the way you do. Every movie, show, book, and game becomes a conversation starter.
● Safe space for introverts: A community built around depth over small talk. No pressure to be "on" all the time. Share thought bubbles at your own pace, react quietly to things that resonate, and ease into friendships without the anxiety of traditional social apps.
● Self-discovery tools: Understand yourself through multiple personality frameworks. See how your type shows up in different systems, explore your cognitive function stack, and discover patterns in how you relate to the world and the people around you.

Safe Privacy Vault is a photo vault application used to save important private information such as private photos, videos, phone numbers and files in mobile phone albums. It provides password encryption and camouflage functions to protect your privacy and leave you no worries!
=======================
This photo vault application has following features:
- Master password protection
- Fake album space by setting fake password
- Face ID/Touch ID unlock
- Photo hide
- Video hide
- Phone hide
- file hiding
- Direct call function
- Create unlimited number of folders
- Mobile phone transfer: one-click migration of private photos and secret videos in PV encrypted albums
- One-click import from the system album sharing menu: directly hide the file in the private album from the sharing interface of the system album
- Change app icon
- Break-In Alert: Automatically capture photos of voyeurs who enter wrong passwords
- View photos and videos in full screen
- Simple and easy-to-use interface, supports mobile phones and tablets
=======================
Detailed introduction of essence function
- Data backup & restore from cloud service
- Master vault password and fake vault password. 
Only by entering the correct login password can you see the photos/videos in the private album. After logging in with a fake password, you will see the fake private space, instead of seeing the real hidden private album photos and videos, creating real concealment for you Private space. When others want to view your album, log in with a fake password to prevent others from seeing your real private information.
- Complete support for conventional file management functions, copy, move, create folder, share and other operations, simple and convenient.
- Perfectly support the browsing function of massive formats of photos/videos, not only compatible with the iOS system's own format, but also playing rm, rmvb, avi, wmv, 3gp, asf, mkv, flv, f4v, divx, mpeg1-mpeg4, vob, VCD/SVCD, dat, mts...... (continuous update)
note:
• All third-party software is not allowed to delete pictures and videos in the local album, so you need to manually delete them after hiding
=======================
If you have any questions, suggestions or comments, please send an email to markluckystar@gmail.com. We will work hard to do better!
=======================
Professional Edition
- Remove ads
- More cloud storage quota
- Use all functions for free
- One purchase for Multi-device

-Permanent membership: $4.99/permanent, one-time purchase of part of the benefits, permanently valid (only for some participating users).

bluejetty:00064710:ios.description:
The City National Bank Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact City National Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the City National Bank Mobile Banking App, you must be enrolled as a City National Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00158281:ios.description:
Meet & Right is an app built to make Orthodox Christian dating a little less weird! Created for the Orthodox community and with our cultures in mind, to help our community connect anytime, anywhere. 
Since our launch in 2018, our diverse, pan-orthodox community has exchanged over 1.2 million messages and made over 60,000 matches. Numerous couples have been married through Christ, which is exactly why we do what we do! 
You won’t find unlimited swipes on Meet & Right, and there’s a good reason for that! We want every profile review to be as meaningful as possible. So, take your time on your bio to give your potential matches an opportunity to really get to know you. Once you match with someone, you'll be able to message each other within the app.
With Meet & Right Premium, you’ll be able to see more profiles each day, get notified when somebody likes your profile, and have access to special settings. Each package is free to try for a week.
Meet & Right does not tolerate harassment of any kind and our team works diligently to review profiles that have been reported for behaviors that cross the line. For more information, please see our code of conduct below. 
Code of Conduct
- Be Yourself. Don’t misrepresent any part of yourself, post photos of other people, or otherwise be dishonest. All photos will be verified by our back-end selfie verification functionality.
- Be Respectful. You’re here to find love after all! We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination, or threatening behavior. Any illegal activity can and will be reported to authorities.
- Be Careful. You should only disclose personal information with those you trust. e will never show your last name, exact location, or email address in the app but that may be possible if you share your phone number, social media handles, etc. 
You must be 18+ to use Meet & Right.
Have questions or want to get in contact with us? Check out our website at www.meetandright.com, follow us on Instagram @meetandright, or send us an email at hello@meetandright.com. We’d love to hear from you!

Since our launch in 2018, our diverse, pan-orthodox community has exchanged over 1.2 million messages and made over 60,000 matches. Numerous couples have been married through Christ, which is exactly why we do what we do! 

You won’t find unlimited swipes on Meet & Right, and there’s a good reason for that! We want every profile review to be as meaningful as possible. So, take your time on your bio to give your potential matches an opportunity to really get to know you. Once you match with someone, you'll be able to message each other within the app.

With Meet & Right Premium, you’ll be able to see more profiles each day, get notified when somebody likes your profile, and have access to special settings. Each package is free to try for a week.

Meet & Right does not tolerate harassment of any kind and our team works diligently to review profiles that have been reported for behaviors that cross the line. For more information, please see our code of conduct below. 

Code of Conduct
- Be Yourself. Don’t misrepresent any part of yourself, post photos of other people, or otherwise be dishonest. All photos will be verified by our back-end selfie verification functionality.
- Be Respectful. You’re here to find love after all! We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination, or threatening behavior. Any illegal activity can and will be reported to authorities.
- Be Careful. You should only disclose personal information with those you trust. e will never show your last name, exact location, or email address in the app but that may be possible if you share your phone number, social media handles, etc. 

You must be 18+ to use Meet & Right.

Have questions or want to get in contact with us? Check out our website at www.meetandright.com, follow us on Instagram @meetandright, or send us an email at hello@meetandright.com. We’d love to hear from you!
