bluejetty:00179613:ios.name: DLYM - Chorus & Flanger
bluejetty:00179613:ios.summary: DLYM is a powerful audio effect designed to deliver rich chorus and flanger effects with advanced processing technology. Inspired by the classic chorus of the DRC synth, DLYM elevates this signature sound, bringing it to all compatible AUv3
bluejetty:00179613:ios.description:
DLYM is a powerful audio effect designed to deliver rich chorus and flanger effects with advanced processing technology. Inspired by the classic chorus of the DRC synth, DLYM elevates this signature sound, bringing it to all compatible AUv3 hosts.
Transform any mono sound into immersive stereo, adding subtle depth or creating bold, transformative effects. With 40 presets to ignite your creativity, you’ll be shaping unique sounds in no time.
DLYM’s intuitive interface features large, precision knobs for effortless, fine-tuned control, designed to enhance workflow with a focus on simplicity and functionality.
Key Features:
- 2 Distinct Processing Modes: Analog emulation and Dimension style
- 6 Time-Syncable Modulation Waveforms: Sine, Square, Saw, Triangle, Sample & Hold, and Filtered Sample & Hold
- Adjustable Stereo Spread for flexible width control
- Frequency Crossover/Filter for tailored effect range
- Preset Manager with 40 patches for instant inspiration
"This is one of the best AU effects available on iOS, hands down. The sounds you can create are just incredible, and the controls give you so much flexibility. Highly recommended for anyone looking to add unique effects to their mixes!”
"This is a fantastic AUv3 with huge sonic possibilities. I’ve tried a lot of delay-based effects, but this one offers more options and control. A must-have for sound designers and musicians who want to experiment."
"This is one of the best fx plugins on iOS. And the fact that it supports AUv3 just makes it so much more flexible. Great for both subtle and wild effects!"
"DLYM is brilliant. I use it to add chorus effects to a range of instruments, and the stereo spread function is incredibly effective. The interface is super user-friendly too."
"Absolutely love this modulator! It offers great flexibility and depth in sound manipulation. I’ve even used it on vocals, and the results are fantastic. Must try!"
"This app has really improved the quality of my projects! I don’t know what I’d do without it at this point. Highly customizable and always reliable."
"One of my go-to effects plugins. I appreciate how responsive the controls are and the wide range of waveforms. The preset manager is also very handy for saving my settings."
"Fantastic sound quality and creative options. I can spend hours just exploring different configurations with this. It’s now an essential part of my workflow."

If your preschool kids like jigsaw puzzles, they will LOVE Super Puzzle!
Super Puzzle works almost like real jigsaw puzzles for kids. Once you pick a piece it stays on the board even if you place it incorrectly, and you can nudge pieces around until it snaps to the right slot. 
Each puzzle features a different beautiful scene drawn by a professional cartoon artist, and a unique reward when the jigsaw puzzle is completed. Scenes include things like cute animals, dragons, or dinosaurs, and the rewards can be to pop balloons, fruits, snowflakes or many more!
You can choose whether to use 6, 9, 12, 16, 30, 56 or 72 pieces, adjusting the difficulty to your child's skill level.
Features:
- 140+ different kids jigsaw puzzles with gorgeous HD graphics (18 free)
- Unique rewards for each puzzle
- Play with 6, 9, 12, 16, 30, 56 or 72 pieces
- Natural jigsaw puzzle dynamics
- No third party advertisements, only in-house cross-promotion
- Intuitive navigation
- Child-safe in-app purchase 
18 puzzles are available for free and all 140+ can be downloaded by purchasing the game.
For more fun check out our other cool, fun and educational kids games for babies, toddlers, boys and girls!

bluejetty:00038955:ios.description:
Quabble: Daily Mental Health
Ease anxiety & lift mood
Reduce stress, anxiety, and depression with joyful daily self-care routines. Quabble offers a wide range of therapist-backed mental health practices to support your well-being. With your Quabble Duck by your side, caring for your mental health becomes a natural and uplifting part of every day.
All-in-One Mental Health App
Developed by people who understand real-life challenges, Quabble brings evidence-based practices and mindfulness training into one easy-to-use app. No more juggling multiple apps for meditation, journaling, sleep, or emotional support, Quabble helps you manage it all in one calming place.
Why users love Quabble
98% say it helps manage mental health
87% report improved well-being
10 million+ wellness routines completed
What You’ll Find Inside
Therapist-Backed Workouts
Practice CBT-inspired grounding, positive affirmations, gratitude reflection, and mindfulness meditation to strengthen six key areas of wellness: Emotional Regulation, Physical Health, Sleep, Mindfulness, Social Support, and Personal Growth.
Daily Mini-Routines & Habit Tracker
Start mornings with intention and end with reflection. The First Bloom Journey 15-day program helps you build sustainable self-care habits, track progress, and celebrate growth with small rewards.
Your Virtual Park
Design a calm sanctuary that mirrors your journey. Decorate with flowers and cozy decos, dress your Duck in cute outfits, and invite friendly animal companions.
Support for Anxiety & Depression
Use science-based tools like 54321 Grounding, 1-Minute Breathing, Pleasant Activities, Safe Place, Tai Chi, and the Calm-Down Kit to ease panic, stress, and racing thoughts between therapy sessions.
A Caring Community
Share thoughts in the Bamboo Forest and connect with others who truly understand—judgment-free. Write letters to your past or future self, or create a personal Safe Place for reflection.
Track Your Progress
Visual insights across six pillars of mental health help you understand patterns in mood, sleep, mindfulness, and overall wellness.
Beautiful & Relaxing Design
Praised for its soothing visuals, Quabble makes practicing mindfulness, relaxation, and emotional balance feel easy and aesthetic.
Some of Quabble’s Most Loved Workouts
Gratitude Jar
Boost resilience and positivity with daily gratitude reflections.
Mood Diary
Track emotions and notice patterns to strengthen emotional regulation.
Moonlight
Drift into better sleep with soothing sounds and mindful relaxation.
Safe Place
Create a calm mental sanctuary for stress relief and anxiety support.
54321 Grounding
A therapist-recommended tool to ease panic and racing thoughts.
Proud Dandelion
Build confidence and self-esteem by celebrating daily victories.
Treasure Box
Capture joyful memories to balance mood and boost optimism.
Worry Box
Let go of what’s beyond your control and create emotional calm.
Mindful Meditation
A three-minute mindfulness reset for clarity and focus.
Watermelon Tai Chi
Gentle movement and deep breathing for mind-body balance.
…and more. Quabble offers 18 unique therapist-backed workouts across six key areas of wellness, with new ones added regularly to keep your self-care journey fresh.

• Expanded community support in Bamboo Forest
• Automatic weather and day/night sync
• 300 free hearts each month
Plans: $8.99/month or $49.99/year ($4.16/month).
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled 24 hours before renewal in Account Settings.

bluejetty:00083386:ios.description:
Prepare to leap into action as the ultimate teenage superhero in Electra Rope Superhero Fighter! Step into the shoes of a young hero blessed with extraordinary spider-like abilities, charged with safeguarding the bustling city from the clutches of ruthless gangsters and criminals.
Embark on a thrilling open-world adventure, immersing yourself in the vibrant streets of the metropolis as you combat crime, protect citizens, and thwart the plans of nefarious villains. With your agility, strength, and mastery of web-slinging, navigate through towering skyscrapers and narrow alleyways to pursue criminals and deliver justice.

bluejetty:00200122:ios.name: ECHOCAT - Ham Radio Remote
bluejetty:00200122:ios.summary:
ECHOCAT is the iPhone and iPad companion for POTACAT, the desktop app for amateur radio operators chasing Parks on the Air (POTA), Summits on the Air (SOTA), Worldwide Bunkers on the Air (WWBOTA), Tiles on the Air and DX. 
Connect your iPa
bluejetty:00200122:ios.description:
ECHOCAT is the iPhone and iPad companion for POTACAT, the desktop app for amateur radio operators chasing Parks on the Air (POTA), Summits on the Air (SOTA), Worldwide Bunkers on the Air (WWBOTA), Tiles on the Air and DX. 
Connect your iPad or iPhone to your shack computer from anywhere in the world. POTACAT Cloud Tunnel (optional subscription) handles the remote connection with no router config, no port forwarding, and no VPN setup — it’s the easiest path. If you prefer to bring your own networking, ECHOCAT also works over Tailscale, WireGuard, or 44NetConnect. On your local network, ECHOCAT works out of the box for free. From any of these paths you have comprehensive remote control of your shack, allowing you to work all your favorite modes.
Remote SSB, CW, FT8 and SSTV! Imagine you're stuck in that long line at the supermarket and you get a notification your buddy is on a summit. Just open up ECHOCAT, QSY to their frequency and call them on single side band with the Push to Talk button. Or send a CW Macro. Or connect your TinyMIDI from N6ARA and send them your fist. Snap a photo and mock up a quick SSTV and bounce it off the ionosphere. Or my most used mode - chase rare DX on FT8 (and FT4 and FT2) when you wake up in the middle of the night for a quick run to the powder room. It's really that easy -- then log it all with one click. Slick!
Select the entities you want to chase (POTA, SOTA, DX Clusters, WWFF, LLOTA, Tiles on the Air) and the region you want to see (North America, South America, Europe, etc), and enjoy two views: 
SPOTS View - See all the spots in a nice, large view showcasing the operator's callsign, name, distance from your QTH, mode and park/summit
MAP View - See a beautiful map with pins at all the activating spots. Click a spot to see their callsign, 1-click tune to them by pressing "QSY" and work the contact on SSB or CW. 
DIRECTORY view shows a list of current and upcoming HF nets, as well as Short Wave Listening (SWL) stations. Now you can tune into a net on a long drive and chat with your buddies, or catch the latest from Voice of Turkey.
By utilizing the SDR connection, you can connect ECHOCAT to your favorite KiwiSDR or WebSDR so you can listen to spots and nets even when your shack rig is unavailable. 
POTACAT CLOUD (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Subscribe to POTACAT Cloud to back up your logbook and sync QSOs between your phone and every desktop you operate from. Built for activators in the field, contesters with portable stations, and anyone with more than one shack.
+ POTACAT Cloud Tunnel — remote rig control from anywhere on the internet, no VPN required
+ Guest Pass — issue a time-limited, owner-revocable code that lets another licensed operator drive your station for a contest, a club session, or remote help. Server-enforced TX power and band limits
+ Cross-device QSO sync — log on mobile when your desktop is offline, watch it appear when you get home
+ Cloud backup with full ADIF export
+ Settings sync between devices
+ Multiple computers, one canonical log
+ Widgets to embed on QRZ that show your latest activation, total QSOs and more
73s,
K3SBP
Subscriptions: POTACAT Cloud is an auto-renewable subscription. Monthly and annual plans are available; pricing is shown at purchase. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation. Manage your subscription in your Apple ID account settings. Free trial converts to a paid subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial ends.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://api.potacat.com/privacy-terms.html
Support: https://api.potacat.com/support

bluejetty:00126768:ios.description:
KEV is the #1 White Balance app.
KEV app turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional and easy-to-use light meter. Using KEV app is as easy as pie, no sensor required, the in-built camera already got you covered. 
Minimalist KEV uses AI to analyze live previews and provide accurate white balance data in Kelvin, making it a valuable tool for photographers and videographers.
Trying to get the perfect White Balance on your DSLR can be annoying. KEV helps you by letting you know what the White Balance should be. You can measure the colour temperature of a light source in Kelvin without having to spend hundreds of dollars on professional devices.
We calibrated KEV using Sekonic C-700R-U SpectroMaster Colour Meter, and we guarantee from fair to almost 100% accuracy. Just open the KEV app and point the camera on surface or scene.
The white balance is a correction of color rendition to make the picture from the camera sensor as similar to the perception by human eyes as possible.
Functions and Capabilities:
• Gets you Color Temperature in Kelvin in real-time.
• Ability to compensate and calculate the white balance readings.
• Capture a snapshot with color temperature reading and location.
• Ability to manually focus on the scene and objects.
• Minimal yet integral point and shoot capability.
• A go-to spectrometer for photographers, videographers, cinematographers, gaffers, drones and action cameras.
• Save time in post-processing.
• Mount your iPhone using hot-shoe over the camera or on a tripod stand and get colour temperature data on the KEV Watch app.
• Zoom in to get colour temperature data of a close-range.
• Balance Color Temperature of the Ambient Light and Your Light Source.
Override the Auto-White Balance and choose settings yourself.
Check out these videos shared by KEV users:
Karl Weinreich - https://youtu.be/sT78ajMQ4Iw
rileyphotos - https://youtu.be/C4oihcY7Dh4
We care about your privacy:
https://kevwb.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00069146:ios.description:
Pill Reminder - Never forget to take your medications again with this app. It's easy to use and reliable, allowing you to set up any recurring reminders you need (every X hours, specific times, daily, weekly, specific days of the week, every X days, etc).
It has everything you need:
• Mark Medications as Taken or Missed
• Snooze or Reschedule Medications
• Refill Reminders
• Suspend and Resume Medications
• Add PRN (as needed) Medications
• Reminders for Medical Appointments
• Send Reports to your Doctor
• Multiple User Support
• Calendar
• Time Zone Support
• Critical Alerts Support
You can also create custom images with AI for your medications and user profiles (Available on iOS 26 and later).
By remembering to take all your medications at the right time, you are taking control of your own health.
RECURRING REMINDERS
• Repeat every X hours (e.g. From 8 AM to 8 PM, every 4 hours)
• Repeat at specific times (e.g. 9:15 AM, 1:30 PM, 8:50 PM)
• Repeat every half hour (e.g. From 10 AM to 2 PM, every 30 minutes)
• Repeat on selected days of the week (e.g. Every week only on Mondays and Fridays)
• Repeat every X days or weeks (e.g. Every 3 days, Every 2 weeks)
• Repeat daily for 21 days and then take 7 days off (Birth Control)
MAIN FEATURES
• User friendly interface
• Get reminders for all your medications
• If you took your medication early or late, you can reschedule the next doses for that day
• Get alerts to refill your prescriptions before they run out
• Suspend and resume medications
• Can be used with any medication, supplement, vitamin, pill or birth control that follows a regular schedule
• Mark a medication as "Taken" directly from the lock screen or notification banner
• Ability to add PRN (as needed) medications
• Keep track of the medications you have to take throughout the day
• Auto-Snooze: Automatically repeat the alarm up to 5 times at regular intervals (e.g. 1 min, 10 mins, 30 mins) until you take action
• Add notes for reference
• Mark medications as Taken or Missed to avoid double doses
• Email your medication list or administration history to your doctor
• Add reminders for medical appointments
• Add photos to each medication for easy identification, or create custom images with AI (Available on iOS 26 and later)
• Multiple user support. Add medications for yourself, family members, or others you care for
• Ability to search the FDA Drug Database for your medications (Available in the US only)
• Has a calendar to view all reminders by month
• Backup and restore all data on the same device or multiple devices
• 33 built-in alarm sounds
GENERAL
• Critical Alerts support
• VoiceOver accessibility support
• Dark Mode
• Automatically adjusts to the font size selected on the device
• Notifications are local. No internet connection required
• App doesn't need to be open to receive notifications
• Universal App, full native support for iPhone and iPad
FREE VERSION
• In the free version you can only add 3 medications
• Full version with unlimited medications is available as an In-App Purchase
• One-Time payment. No monthly or annual fees

bluejetty:00027772:ios.name: Jibi Land : Princess Castle
bluejetty:00027772:ios.summary: Jibi Land Princess Castle is a dollhouse game with an open-ended style of play. It allows you to delve into a world of imagination set in a land of magic and fantasies. In this land, you will find many surprises and amazing characters such
bluejetty:00027772:ios.description:
Jibi Land Princess Castle is a dollhouse game with an open-ended style of play. It allows you to delve into a world of imagination set in a land of magic and fantasies. In this land, you will find many surprises and amazing characters such as little princesses, pretty princes, dragons, unicorns, little fairies, and many other cute pets. If you are a fan of dollhouse games, don't miss out!
This is the first game in the Jibi Land series, coming with the enchanted princess castle theme.
How to play:
The way we play is similar to pretend play or playing with a dollhouse. There are no rules to follow. Our game provides a free space where children can let their imagination run wild. Simply select a favorite character and use your imagination to craft your own story.
What will the story in this castle be like next?
You decide !!
Game features:
- 9 fantastic scenes, with tons of secrets and treasure puzzles to surprise you in this castle.
- Many cute characters such as little princess, handsome prince, king, queen, maid, chef, let you create your own story freely.
- More than 100 animal characters for you to raise and take care of such as little unicorn, little fairy, mischievous cat, cute dog.
- Many gorgeous princess dresses to give You dress up princess.
- Dragon eggs and unicorn eggs waiting for you to find and hatch.
- Some pets can grow such as horse, unicorn, dragon. Take care him and watch it grow.
- More than 100 food and beverage menus for you to cook. Let's cook delicious food for princess.
- A magic magnifying glass system that will help you find secret items and solve puzzle.
- Sticker system for you to find and collect over 100 types.
Advice for parents:
This game is designed for children between the ages of 6-12, so they can be played by themselves or with friends. Children under 6 years of age should be accompanied by a parents.
We believe in the power of pretend play It will help develop children's imagination and creativity. So we strive to develop independent space in format dollhouse that is a part for children to play and enjoy with their imagination. And we would appreciate it if parents can take the time to join this game with your child. Because that means our games can play a part in building a good relationship in the your family. 
We hope you enjoy with this game.

bluejetty:00184609:ios.description:
Truco Uruguayo is one of the most popular card games in Uruguay. It is a multiplayer game where you can play 1 against 1, or in 2 teams of 2 or 3 players.
The first to reach the agreed number of points wins the match. Each player is dealt 3 cards, and a card is turned over ("muestra"). The one who throws the highest card wins the round, the best of three rounds wins the hand and the points it is worth.
Value of the cards and their names (from lowest to highest value):
• Common: 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3
• "Matas": 7 gold, 7 spades, 1 clubs, 1 spades
• "Piezas": 10, 11, 5, 4 or 2 of the muestra suit
Play on your iPhone or iPad wherever you are with the Truco Uruguayo app from ConectaGames!
Enjoy:
• Daily and Weekly Ranking
• Exciting Tournaments
• Play against real people or bots
• Spectator Mode: watch your friends or the pros play live!
You can find more information on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/trucouruguayo.
Terms and conditions of use: https://conectagames.com/terms_policies/

bluejetty:00036702:ios.description:
Our PDF Merger app makes it effortless to merge PDF files or combine two or more PDFs into a single, neatly organized document. With its fast merging speed, you can confidently combine PDF files into one file, knowing that all your PDFs will be seamlessly merged without losing any content or quality. Plus, it’s secure, allowing you to keep your merged PDFs safe and private.
In addition, This Merge PDF app offers a complete suite of tools for managing your documents. You can split PDF files into smaller, manageable sections or extract specific pages with ease. The app also lets you lock and unlock PDFs, giving you full control over document access while protecting sensitive information.
How to Use?
Choose PDF files directly from your gallery or create a new text-based PDF. Use the PDF Merger & PDF Combiner to effortlessly join PDF files with just a few taps.
- Key Features of the PDF Merger App:
* Combine PDF Files into One
Easily combine multiple PDF files into one. Import PDFs from your gallery or create a new text-based PDF to merge PDF files seamlessly into a single document.
* Split PDF Files
Need to divide a large document? Use the PDF Splitter feature to break your PDF into smaller sections or extract specific pages to suit your needs.
* Lock and Unlock PDFs
Secure your files by locking them with a password, or remove restrictions to unlock PDFs when needed. Safeguard your sensitive information with ease.
* Delete Pages from PDFs
Remove unnecessary pages from your document effortlessly to streamline your PDF.
* Share Across Platforms
Quickly share your merged PDFs using the PDF Joiner via email, messaging apps, or cloud services.
* Unlimited Merging
Merge as many files as you want, whenever you want, with no limitations.
- Why Choose Us?
The Merge PDF app is built for simplicity and efficiency, making it easy to combine PDF files, manage documents, and save time. Whether you're organizing work files, creating presentations, or consolidating class notes, this app is the perfect tool. Our PDF combiner is ideal for professionals, students, and anyone dealing with multiple PDFs. Plus, it works seamlessly offline or online.
- Who Can Use It?
* Teachers & Educators
Merge lesson plans and materials into a single document with the PDF Merger.
* Business Professionals
Use the app to combine PDF files like reports and presentations into polished documents.
* Legal Professionals
Consolidate contracts and legal filings using the PDF Joiner for secure submissions.
* Real Estate Agents
Create a comprehensive property profile by merging listings and contracts.
* Healthcare Professionals
Organize and share patient records securely with the PDF Combiner app.
* Freelancers
Send invoices, contracts, and project deliverables as organized, professional PDFs using the Join PDF feature.
Take control of your documents today! Download Merge PDF - Combine PDF Files now and simplify your PDF management tasks for free. With its intuitive tools, including PDF Splitter, PDF Joiner, and security features, this app is your all-in-one solution for managing PDFs efficiently.

bluejetty:00016813:ios.description:
World’s healthiest game!
Cure your way through the quirkiest and funniest diseases in My Hospital - the ultimate simulation game where you design, manage and maintain your very own medical centre! 
Create elixirs, farm and harvest your own medical plants and produce cures for hundreds of patients that need your help. It’s a world where Panacea rules and every treatment is available at your fingertips! 
◉ BUILD YOUR HOSPITAL
Construct and manage your own hospital. Build doctor’s offices, diagnostic rooms, the treatment centre and laboratories. Expand and upgrade your hospital and share it with friends! 
◉ CREATE UNIQUE CURES
Farm and harvest plants with healing properties, produce dozens of elixirs, and blend syrups to treat more than 80 funny diseases. Whether it’s a chilli throat condition, frozen hands or slimey lungs, you’ll be sure to find the cure! Unlock new remedies, treatment rooms and new conditions with every level and complete fun challenges!
◉ DECORATE YOUR HOSPITAL
Customize each area of your health center to make your patients feel at home. You have tons of decorations to choose from and when you finally manage to make it look as pretty as a picture, show it off in front of your friends! 
◉ PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Connect with your Facebook account to access your friends’ Hospitals around the world. Buy, sell cures and compete with other Hospital managers. Tell them about your achievements via Game Center, and Facebook. 
Please note that My Hospital is free to download and play. However, some in-game items are available and can be purchased for real money. 
Like us on Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/myhospital
Having problems? Got any suggestion? We’d love to hear your feedback! Reach us at: myhospital@kuuhubb.com

*Magic breeding
To make it even more exciting you can breed magical new birds by spinning the breeding wheel and getting new, unique birds with different new colors. this will help you have aviaries filled with exotic and colorful birds unlike anybody else’s.

*Easy to play
Colorful and very beautiful design makes birdland paradise a very easy game to play. Everything is simple, well explained and accessible for everybody.
If you love animals, Bird Land Paradise is the best simulation and pet rescue game ever!. 
Download now and start having fun with cute pets!

bluejetty:00115002:ios.name: Farm Craze: Traffic Jam Puzzle
bluejetty:00115002:ios.summary: Get ready for a farmyard twist on the parking lot craze! Farm Craze: Traffic Jam Puzzle combines the fun of classic parking games, bus games, and car puzzle games with a fresh farm theme. Instead of cars and buses stuck in a parking lot gam
bluejetty:00115002:ios.description:
Get ready for a farmyard twist on the parking lot craze! Farm Craze: Traffic Jam Puzzle combines the fun of classic parking games, bus games, and car puzzle games with a fresh farm theme. Instead of cars and buses stuck in a parking lot game, you’ll guide colorful horse carriages loaded with fruits across busy farm paths. Match each carriage with the right fruit, clear the road, and watch the farm come alive with action!
This is not just another parking game—it’s a whole new adventure! Inspired by fan-favorite hits like Bus Craze, car parking games, and traffic jam fever, Farm Craze introduces unique farm-themed puzzles where strategy meets speed. Each level is like solving a tricky car jam escape puzzle or a clever traffic puzzle, but instead of a car out scenario, you’ll be managing vibrant fruit carts and horse-drawn wagons.
Farm Craze Features:
 - Match fruits with the correct horse carriage to clear the stage.
 - Solve challenging car puzzle and traffic jam style levels with a farm twist.
 - Experience endless farm traffic fun, like bus escape traffic jam and car jam solver challenges.
 - Compete with friends on the leaderboard in this addictive farm-themed traffic game.
 - Enjoy the excitement of parking car, bus parking, and car traffic games, now reimagined with horse carriages!
Whether you love bus parking games, bus driving games, or quirky jelly car style adventures, Farm Craze has something for you. The gameplay captures the addictive feel of parking jam puzzles, where your goal is always to untangle the mess and let the passenger bus or in this case, horse wagons, move freely.
Each level is carefully designed like a parking lot challenge, where precision, timing, and logic matter. It’s as satisfying as seeing a bus out or a car escape after solving a tricky bus jam or car jam setup. From short carts to long bus-style wagons, you’ll face every kind of obstacle.
The fun doesn’t stop there—Farm Craze takes inspiration from bus mania, bus sort, and traffic run mechanics to deliver competitive features. Play solo to sharpen your skills, or challenge others in events, climbing up the global leaderboard to prove you’re the ultimate farm traffic master.
Plus, with new daily quests, seasonal events, and exciting challenges, there’s always a reason to return to the farm. Take part in time-limited competitions, earn rewards, and test yourself against players worldwide. Just like a classic car jam or bus traffic jam game, the levels get trickier the more you play, keeping your brain sharp and your reflexes quick. Can you become the top car jam solver in this farm-themed puzzle world?
Best of all, Farm Craze is completely free to play! If you’ve enjoyed free car games, addictive bus apps, or the chaotic charm of a bus traffic jam, you’ll love how this farm-themed spin captures the same energy while adding fresh new mechanics.
So, can you untangle the farm traffic and keep the harvest moving? Download Farm Craze: Traffic Jam Puzzle today and join the craze that’s sweeping the world of parking lot games and traffic jam puzzles. The farm is waiting for its traffic hero—you!

bluejetty:00144086:ios.summary: Are you a fan of interactive slime play and nurturing virtual companions? Get ready to embark on a delightful journey with our latest creation - the Super Slime Buddy! This charming digital friend is eagerly awaiting your care and attention
bluejetty:00144086:ios.description:
Are you a fan of interactive slime play and nurturing virtual companions? Get ready to embark on a delightful journey with our latest creation - the Super Slime Buddy! This charming digital friend is eagerly awaiting your care and attention to thrive and shine brightly.
Your Super Slime Buddy craves affection and engagement, relying on you to ensure its happiness and well-being. Spend quality time with your slimy pal, engaging in playful activities and showering it with love to become the ultimate companion. Keep a close eye on its needs, ensuring it remains content and cheerful, never experiencing hunger, fatigue, grime, or boredom.
Indulge your Super Slime Buddy's voracious appetite by treating it to an array of delectable snacks and treats available in the food emporium. From scrumptious cakes and candies to fresh fruits and savory delights like pizza and burgers, the options are endless! Explore its preferences through amusing reactions, discovering the perfect culinary delights to satisfy its cravings.
Unleash your creativity by personalizing your slime companion with an array of customization options. Experiment with different slime types, vibrant colors, and quirky decorations to craft a truly unique and endearing companion. Each variation offers a distinct sensory experience, culminating in a delightful ASMR sensation that's as soothing as it is satisfying.
Discover the therapeutic benefits of bonding with your slime pet, as you knead, stretch, and mold it to your heart's content. Experience the relaxing ASMR effects as you engage in tactile play, reveling in the whimsical reactions and amusing sounds emanating from your pet.

bluejetty:00079523:ios.description:
Something strange is happening in Enchanted Crossroads.
Doors that weren't there yesterday. Whispers in empty rooms. A rune etched into a mirror that no one remembers hanging. When Detective Greystone calls for your help, it becomes clear — this charming little town is hiding more than it shows.
Search hand-painted scenes for hidden objects, spot subtle differences, and solve puzzles that guard the town's oldest secrets. Each clue you find pulls you deeper into a mystery woven through 15+ beautifully illustrated chapters.
But the closer you look, the more questions arise. Who — or what — is watching from the crossroads?
WHAT AWAITS YOU
A Mystery Worth Solving
Follow Detective Greystone through a twisting storyline filled with enchanted characters, buried secrets, and revelations you won't see coming.
A World Rich in Detail
Wander through 15+ stunning hand-crafted scenes — from moonlit gardens to forgotten libraries — each hiding objects, differences, and surprises.
Puzzles That Reward Curiosity
Hidden object searches, spot-the-difference challenges, and clever brain teasers — 4+ unique puzzle types keep every chapter fresh.
Your Collection Grows
Complete quests to unlock rare magical artifacts and build a personal trove of enchanted items.
Play at Your Own Pace
No timers. No pressure. Helpful hints are always within reach whenever you need a gentle nudge.
Optional in-app purchases are available, but you can complete the full story without spending anything.
The crossroads are calling. Will you answer?

Whether you're working on home improvement, DIY projects, or need quick leveling anywhere, Angl
bluejetty:00095386:ios.description:
Angle Finder is the ultimate level tool for measuring angles, checking surface flatness, and taking real-size measurements—all from your phone.
Whether you're working on home improvement, DIY projects, or need quick leveling anywhere, Angle Finder delivers fast, accurate results without extra equipment.
Key Features
• Measure angles with real-time sensor precision
• Check surface flatness (horizontal and vertical)
• Use the on-screen ruler for real-size measurements
• Both metric (cm) and imperial (feet/inch) units
• Fully offline, no internet connection required
• Clean, intuitive interface with live feedback
Why Angle Finder
-Lightweight and fast with no unnecessary extras
-Works great for DIY, carpentry, and home projects
-Helpful for geometry, trigonometry, and math learning
-Designed for accuracy with minimal setup
-A modern level tool that’s simple yet powerful
Built for DIYers, students, math enthusiasts, and anyone who values accuracy, Angle Finder removes the need for bulky tools or guesswork. It combines simplicity with precision, making it the go-to solution for leveling tasks at home, in the workshop, or out in the field.
From hanging shelves perfectly straight to aligning furniture or verifying slope angles, Angle Finder gives you the accuracy you need in seconds. No more trial and error—just open the app and get precise measurements instantly.
Angle Finder is the smart level tool you can rely on for quick, accurate results. Whether you're checking angles, leveling surfaces, or estimating real-world lengths, it empowers you to work with confidence, right from your phone.

bluejetty:00030854:ios.description:
Suivez toute l’actualité en direct et en continu sur l’application Le Parisien : faits divers, info locale, sport, international, vidéos, podcasts et enquêtes.
Une rédaction de plus de 350 journalistes mobilisés chaque jour sur le terrain.
LE PARISIEN — UNE OFFRE ÉDITORIALE UNIQUE
• Actualité en continu : faits divers, société, pouvoir d'achat, santé, international
• Infos locales en Île-de-France et dans l'Oise
• PSG, football et grands événements sportifs en direct
• Podcasts, vidéos et formats originaux du Parisien
• Culture, séries, cinéma, musique et idées de sorties
L'ESSENTIEL DE VOTRE ACTUALITÉ — EN TEMPS RÉEL
Notifications et journal numérique : accédez rapidement aux informations qui comptent pour vous.
• Notifications personnalisées selon vos centres d'intérêt
• Journal numérique disponible dès 22h30 la veille
PARIS, L'ÎLE-DE-FRANCE ET VOUS
Faits divers, transports, immobilier, environnement, vie pratique : Le Parisien suit l'actualité francilienne avec une couverture terrain dense et ancrée dans le quotidien.
• Actualité locale par département
• Reportages et infos de proximité
• Météo et vie pratique
LE SPORT ET L'ACTUALITÉ DU PSG
Toute l'actualité sportive en direct : résultats, analyses, interviews et coulisses des grandes compétitions nationales et internationales.
• PSG, Paris FC, Ligue 1 et Ligue des Champions
• Équipe de France et compétitions internationales
• Roland-Garros, Tour de France, Jeux olympiques et grands rendez-vous sportifs
• Scores, comptes-rendus et vidéos en temps réel
FAITS DIVERS ET ENQUÊTES
Enquêtes, faits divers et grands récits d'actualité traités par les journalistes du Parisien.
• Décryptages et analyses
• Enquêtes réservées aux abonnés
• Podcasts Code Source, Crime Story et Le Sacre
AU CŒUR DE L'ACTUALITÉ INTERNATIONALE
Guerres, diplomatie, économie mondiale et grands enjeux de société : les événements mondiaux expliqués et suivis en direct.
• Ukraine, Proche-Orient, États-Unis et grands conflits internationaux
• Géopolitique, économie mondiale et politique étrangère
• Analyses, reportages et suivi en direct
LE PARISIEN EN VIDÉO
Retrouvez toute l'actualité en vidéo dans un nouvel espace entièrement dédié.
- Analyses, reportages, décryptages, interviews et podcasts filmés de la rédaction.
- Formats longs, séries exclusives et récits pour vivre l'actualité autrement.
- Politique, sports, économie, société, culture, faits divers et grands événements.
- Suivez les dernières vidéos d'actualité, mises à jour tout au long de la journée.
Accédez à tout moment à l'ensemble de nos contenus vidéo, où que vous soyez.
VOTRE NOUVEL ESPACE JEUX
Mots, logique et défis : chaque jour, de nouveaux défis vous attendent.
- Les mini jeux : Mot du jour, Mini mots croisés, Mini mots fléchés
- Les classiques : Mots croisés, Mots fléchés, Sudoku
- Nos jeux exclusifs : Le mot de l'actu, Dynamics, Alphamo
- Nos jeux rétros : Jeu du serpent, Jeu de briques
- Mais aussi : Mots coupés, Mot mystère, Belote
LE PARISIEN ABONNÉS
Profitez de l'intégralité des contenus du Parisien avec l'abonnement 100% digital et sans engagement.
• Articles exclusifs, enquêtes et analyses
• Lecture sans publicité
• Journal numérique dès 22h30 la veille
• Espace de commentaires abonnés
• Compte unique synchronisé sur l'application et le site
Déjà abonné ? Connectez-vous avec vos identifiants pour accéder à tous les contenus et au journal numérique.
UNE APPLICATION PENSÉE POUR VOUS
• Notifications personnalisées et choix de votre département
• Mode sombre et taille de police ajustable
• Enregistrement de vos articles favoris
L'application évolue en permanence. Une remarque, une suggestion ? Écrivez-nous à mobiles@leparisien.fr
Conditions d'utilisation : leparisien.fr/cgu
Politique de confidentialité : leparisien.fr/politique-confidentialite

bluejetty:00174435:ios.description:
Welcome to the FUNCEF app, the official application of the Fundação dos Economiários Federais. With the FUNCEF app, participants and beneficiaries have all the necessary tools in the palm of their hand to manage their benefits, track contributions, and stay updated on the latest foundation news.
Key Features:
Real-Time Monitoring: Check the status of your account, the history of contributions, and the details of benefit plans.
Notifications: Receive notifications about updates, changes in plans, and important FUNCEF events.
Benefit Simulator: Estimate the value of your retirement based on your contributions and length of service.
Contact Us: Contact FUNCEF directly through the app, whether to ask questions, send documents, or request services.
News and Updates: Stay informed about everything happening in the world of supplementary pensions and the latest news from FUNCEF.
Privacy and Security:
We know how important your privacy is. The FUNCEF Mobile app was designed with the highest security standards, ensuring that your data remains protected.
Download now and always have FUNCEF with you!

bluejetty:00122845:ios.description:
Make the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
● Simply login to the intuitive app using your same health benefits website username and password (or follow alternative instructions if provided) 
● No sensitive account information is ever stored on your mobile device
● Use Touch ID or Face ID to quickly log in to the mobile app
Connects You with the Details 
● Quickly check available balances 24/7 
● View charts summarizing account(s) 
● View existing claims
● Click to call or email customer service
● View your statements and notifications
● Scan product barcodes to determine their eligibility 
Provides Additional Time-Saving Options (if supported or applicable to your account(s)) 
● Reimburse yourself from your FSA or HSA
● Take or upload a picture of a receipt and submit for a new or existing claim
● View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
● Send payment to providers from any account
● Manage your expenses by entering medical expense information and supporting documentation
● View and manage your HSA investments
● Retrieve your forgotten username/password
● Report a debit card as lost or stolen
Powered by WEX©

bluejetty:00187523:ios.description:
Konga – Where Nigeria Shops with Confidence
Everything you need. One platform you can trust.
Welcome to the all-new Konga experience.
Konga is Nigeria's trusted digital commerce platform, designed to make shopping simpler, smarter, and
more rewarding. Whether you're buying everyday essentials, upgrading your technology, refreshing your
wardrobe, furnishing your home, or shopping for your business, Konga brings together authentic
products, trusted sellers, secure payments, and reliable nationwide delivery—all in one seamless
experience.
Built around trust, convenience, and value, Konga helps you discover more, shop with confidence, and
save every day.
Discover Everything You Need
Explore a wide selection of products across electronics, mobile phones, computing, fashion, groceries,
beauty, home and kitchen, appliances, baby products, office essentials, gaming, sports and fitness,
automotive accessories, health and wellness, and so much more.
From everyday essentials to life's biggest purchases, Konga brings the brands and products you love
together in one place.
A Smarter Way to Shop
Designed around the way you shop, the Konga app makes every experience effortless.
Enjoy:
• Fast and intelligent search
• Personalized recommendations
• Smart filters to help you find exactly what you need
• Save your favourites for later
• Secure, simple checkout
• Multiple payment options
• Real-time order tracking
• Easy order management
Every feature is built to help you spend less time searching and more time enjoying what matters.
Shop with Confidence
Trust is at the heart of everything we do.
That's why every shopping experience is supported by:
• Trusted sellers
• Authentic products
• Secure payment experiences
• Verified customer ratings and reviews
• Reliable nationwide delivery
• Responsive customer support
Because every purchase should feel as confident as it is convenient.
More Value, Every Day
Discover new ways to save with:
• Exclusive App-Only Deals
• Daily Deals
• Seasonal Campaigns
• Brand Promotions
• Curated Collections
Great value isn't occasional—it's part of every Konga experience.
Always Getting Better
We're constantly improving the Konga app with faster performance, smarter search, enhanced
personalization, improved navigation, and new features inspired by our customers.
Our goal is simple: to create Nigeria's most trusted and enjoyable digital commerce experience.
Whether you're shopping for yourself, your family, or your business, Konga gives you everything you
need to discover, shop, pay, and track your orders with confidence.
Download Konga today and experience the smarter way to shop.
Konga. Where Nigeria Shops with Confidence.

Bodylura is a fitness and wellness platform that makes living a strong and healthy lifestyle easy!
We specialize in strength and resistance training for women, with over 20 different programs to choose from.
Your first 7 days are FREE!
Join the thousands of women who have transformed their lives with the help of our expert female personal trainers, results-driven workout programs, 300+ delicious recipes, community support, and more!
Anna Victoria:
ON DEMAND PROGRAMS
30 Day FBG (30 mins high impact and intensity strength)
30 Day Tone Round 1 (30 mins high intensity strength)
30 Day Tone Round 2 (30 mins high intensity strength)
30 Day Ignite (20 mins high intensity strength)
Restore Your Core (postpartum recovery)
12 WEEK PROGRAMS:
FitStart (20 mins beginner program)
Tone (30 mins high intensity strength)
Shred (30 mins bodyweight training)
Sculpt (45-60 mins gym training)
Grow + Glow (30 min pregnancy safe strength training)
Ignite (20 mins high intensity strength)
Kasia Galica:
ON DEMAND PROGRAM:
30 Day Rebalancing (30 min mobility and body balance)
Miah Youngblut:
ON DEMAND PROGRAM:
30 Day Flex & Flow (30 min mat pilates)
Maggi Gao:
ON DEMAND PROGRAM:
30 Day Blast (45 min kettlebell training)
12 WEEK PROGRAM:
Blast (50 min kettlebell training)
Alyssa Lombardi:
ON DEMAND PROGRAM:
30 Day Run Strong (25-35 min strength for runners)
12 WEEK PROGRAM:
Run Strong (20-30 min strength for runners)
Brittany Lupton:
12 WEEK PROGRAMS:
Lift (60 mins lifting program)
Revive (20-30 min postpartum strength)
Nicci Robinson:
12 WEEK PROGRAMS:
Strong (90 min bodybuilding program)
Endurance (30 min high intensity strength)
Martina Sergi:
12 WEEK PROGRAMS:
Move (30-45 min yoga flexibility)
Rise (25-35 min yoga strength)
Bodylura App features:
12 week guided workout programs
On Demand Classes
Workouts you can easily fit into your schedule
Alternative move suggestions
As little as 20-30 minutes a day
Daily 5 minute cardio burn workouts
Stretching and foam rolling videos for rehabilitation
Guided cardio workouts
Food Tracker + Meal Plans
72 weeks of meals plans with custom portions according to your daily caloric needs
300+ recipes to mix and match and make your own meal plan
7 eating preferences: Regular, Vegan, Vegetarian, Pescatarian, Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, and Keto
Daily food tracker to track your meals
Easy add features to enter your own macros from meals or ingredients
Barcode scanner for US and Canadian food products
Workout Calendar + Wellness Journal
Keep track of historical workout data in our weekly and monthly calendars
Track your mental and emotional well-being in our wellness journal
Guidance and Education
Educational videos with guidance and dozens of fitness and food topics intended to help you reach your goals of achieving physical, mental, and emotional well-being
Membership, Pricing, and Terms:
Bodylura memberships start with a 7-day free trial. After your 7-day trial, you will be able to choose a membership and will be charged according to that membership plan and schedule. Memberships will auto-renew and payments will be processed on a continual basis unless the subscription is canceled 24 hours prior to the end of the membership period. Membership plan options include and will auto-renew every:
12 months
3 months
1 month

bluejetty:00124278:ios.description:
Epic Heroes in Exciting Pixel Battles.
Create your own superhero identity and beat the evilest supervillains in the universe on your way to becoming a champion. Laugh out loud as you fight with cool and hilarious action heroes from the dynamic worlds of Dinosaurs, Robots, and Zombies. Choose from an absolutely entertaining roster of champions to begin your journey of endless fun.
This wacky arcade-style game has heroic pixel figures of Jungle King Shere Khan, Atom, Zeus, and never-seen-before ZOMBIE super stars – meaning “A Never Ending PIXEL SMASHING Adventure”!
Stomp over opponents, push them against obstacles and even chase them as they try to sneak away from you – It’s all about making your moves look cool and quirky.
COLLECT LEGENDARY HEROES
Unravel legendary super heroes with super-cool abilities and exciting action moves to experience crazy comical action. Unlock cool, funky characters like Dinosaurs, Jungle heroes, Zombies, Sci-fi movie Robots and more.
A QUAD-WORLD OF HEROES & PUNKS
Now, choose your super heroes from 4 vivid and entertaining thematic worlds – DINO, JUNGLE, ZOMBIES and ROBOTS. Punt opponents in the air as you dance and groove to the vintage 8-bit arcade tunes. Go completely BONKERS in this never experienced before contest of pixel smashing.
RETRO-STYLE ARCADE ACTION
Make a swooning entrance into the arena and tease opponents with mischievous gestures. Smash & Bash Pixels! Whether kids or adults; have lots of smashy fun while you experience the thrill of winning fights even with one limb remaining.
UNLEASH HILARIOUS FINISHERS and SPs
Knockout challengers with hilarious finishing moves – smash, dash, bash and even fart - in this amazing pixel smashing game! Chase them, hop on them or squash their bellies using epic abilities of Bleed, Critical Damage, Stun, Force Field, Obstacle Shield, Last Stand & Instant Death special abilities on your road to become the champions of pixel clash.
EXCITING ARENAS, INTUITIVE GAMEPLAY
Escape rolling fireballs, spiked iron and unique obstacles in vintage art-style arenas - Lava River, Helipad and the Dockyard. Know your moves and dodges with the interactive on-screen tips and suggestions.
UNRAVEL POWERFUL CHAMPIONS
Open Rare, Epic and Legendary crates with surprise rewards of amazing hero parts.
JOIN ‘SUPER PIXEL HEROES’ EXCLUSIVE FAN CLUB
Enjoy regular news on game updates, characters, features, views, video tips and more for Free
Like us on facebook: http://www.facebook.com/reliancegames
Follow us on twitter: http://www.twitter.com/reliancegames
Watch us on youtube: http://www.youtube.com/reliancegames

bluejetty:00018909:ios.description:
BETUP is a virtual betting simulator that turns sports prediction into a game, with free bets using virtual Betcoins and no real money involved.
Make your picks, challenge other players, climb the rankings and build your story across Betropolis. Explore real fixtures, realistic odds, Flash Bet, racing and six arcade games—all inside one immersive sports game.
YOUR SPORTS. YOUR PICKS.
Explore 25+ sports and competitions, including football, basketball, tennis, volleyball, ice hockey, baseball, rugby, American football, snooker, badminton and esports.
• Discover live and upcoming fixtures
• Explore leagues, teams and trending matches
• Place quick bets, singles and multi-bets
• Follow scores, results, match history and statistics
• Save your favourite sports, teams, leagues and matches
• Review every pick and track your performance
Build your bets using free virtual currency. No real money is ever wagered or paid out.
MEET ACE, YOUR AI COACH
Ask Ace for match predictions, stats analysis and guidance on your picks. Ace studies form, results and odds to help you plan your next move. AI predictions are for entertainment only.
FLASH BET — INSTANT RESULTS
Think fast and trust your instincts.
Make three predictions while a completed football match unfolds as a lightning-fast simulation. Watch the clock, score, possession and key events, answer under pressure and discover your result in seconds.
PLAY THE STORY OF BETROPOLIS
Your journey is only beginning.
Follow a 15-chapter sports story across the city of Betropolis. Complete betting goals, unlock new chapters, collect stars and earn virtual rewards as you grow into a betting master.
HORSE AND GREYHOUND RACING
Study the field, choose your runners and back your champions across a full selection of racing formats:
• Win and Place
• Exacta and Quinella
• Trifecta
• Head-to-Head
• Favourite vs Field
Explore participant statistics, make ordered selections, follow race results and review your complete racing history—all using virtual Betcoins.
ENTER THE BETUP ARCADE
When you want a quick change of pace, step into an immersive arcade filled with six distinctive games:
• Dice
• Higher or Lower
• War
• Lucky Cells
• Slots
• Roulette
Learn the rules, choose your virtual Betcoin stake and enjoy fast, exciting result moments. Every arcade game uses virtual currency only.
BATTLE OTHER PLAYERS
Turn your sports knowledge into a head-to-head contest.
Create public 1-v-1 Battles, invite a specific player, challenge someone directly from their profile or accept an open challenge. Follow your Battle record and jump straight into a rematch.
CLIMB, COLLECT AND IMPROVE
Every pick adds to your journey:
• Compete on daily, weekly and monthly leaderboards
• Unlock achievements and fill your Trophy Hall
• Analyse detailed profile and Battle statistics
• Track wins, losses, pending bets and winning streaks
• Review your complete balance history
• Claim daily bonuses and campaign rewards
• Study community picks and copy bets you like
PLAY FOR FUN. COMPETE LIKE A PRO.
Whether you are making a quick prediction, building a multi-bet, choosing a racing champion, completing a story mission or challenging another player, BETUP gives every sports fan a new way to play—without risking real money.
DISCLAIMER
• BETUP is a virtual sports betting simulator intended for entertainment
• All bets are placed using virtual Betcoins
• BETUP does not offer real-money betting
• Ace predictions are AI-generated for entertainment only and are not betting advice
• There are no real-money prizes, deposits or withdrawals
• Betcoins have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged
• Optional in-app purchases only add virtual Betcoins or unlock game features

Terms & Conditions: https://betup.org/privacy/terms.html

bluejetty:00197905:android.summary:
KidiConnect™ lets you keep in touch with your child even when you are away from home.
With KidiConnect™ kids can share messages from their compatible VTech system. All contacts must be approved by parents before any communication can take
bluejetty:00197905:android.description:
KidiConnect™ lets you keep in touch with your child even when you are away from home.
With KidiConnect™ kids can share messages from their compatible VTech system. All contacts must be approved by parents before any communication can take place. 
NOTE: KidiConnect™ is meant for communication with compatible VTech toys. You cannot use it to send messages to adults or children who do not have a compatible device.
Why Use KidiConnect™?
• Stay Connected with Your Child Anytime, Anywhere. KidiConnect™ uses an Internet connection to let you communicate with your child even when you are away from home - anywhere in the world. Parents can also add family members and friends to the child's contact list, so grandparents can stay close too.
• Kid-Friendly. All contacts must be approved by parents before communication can take place. Users who are not on a child's contact list cannot contact your child.
• Good For All Ages! Even the youngest kids can use KidiConnect™ to share voice messages, photos, drawings, stickers, and pre-recorded messages. And as children grow, they will be able to share text messages too!
• Group Chat. With Group Chat, your child can communicate and share with multiple family members or friends at the same time. 
• It's Fun! You can customize your KidiConnect™ avatar with your photo, or choose one of several cartoon designs. There are also fun stickers and pre-recorded messages. Your child can even use the voice changer to record a robot voice or a mouse voice!
Using KidiConnect™ 
Parents:
Please register your child's VTech device before downloading this app. This will create a Learning Lodge® Family Account, which one parent can use to log in to this app. That parent will be in charge of the child's contact list and can use this app to send or approve friend requests on their child's behalf.
The other parent will have to sign up for a separate Learning Lodge® account and be added to the family like any other relative.
Relatives:
You must get parental approval before you can contact a child. Once you've signed up for a Learning Lodge® account, send the child's parents a request to join their family.
* KidiConnect™ works with KidiBuzz™ and other VTech devices which support KidiConnect™ or VTech Kid Connect™.
For more details about VTech, please visit our website:

bluejetty:00095587:ios.description:
Yarn Sort Puzzle – Cozy Color Sorting Challenge!
Unwind your mind with Yarn Sort Puzzle, a relaxing and addictive sorting game that brings a warm, handcrafted twist to the classic logic puzzle. Instead of liquids, you’ll be sorting soft, colorful yarn balls onto spools, aiming to group matching colors together. Simple to play, yet challenging to master!
How to Play:
Tap a spool to pick the top yarn ball.
Tap another spool to place it — if the top color matches or the spool is empty.
Keep sorting until every spool holds only one color of yarn.
Use logic and foresight — no timers, just peaceful puzzle solving!
Whether you have a few minutes or want to relax for an hour, Yarn Sort Puzzle is the perfect cozy brain teaser to keep your mind sharp and your heart calm.
Features:
Beautiful Yarn Visuals
Soft and colorful yarn textures that make every move satisfying.
Challenging Levels
Start simple, then test your logic as more colors and spools are added.
Stress-Free Gameplay
No countdowns, no pressure — just soothing puzzle fun.
Custom Themes & Skins
Unlock new yarn styles, spool designs, and cozy backgrounds as you play.
Adorable Helpers
A mischievous cat may appear to lend a paw or cause some chaos!
Undo & Hints
Made a mistake? Use the undo button or ask for a hint to get back on track.
Relaxing Sound Design
Enjoy the soft click of yarn and ambient background music designed to help you unwind.
For Everyone:
From kids to adults, casual gamers to puzzle pros — anyone can enjoy the calm challenge of Yarn Sort Puzzle. It’s a great way to train your brain, improve concentration, and find a moment of peace in your day.
Ready to untangle your thoughts and wrap your mind around a new kind of puzzle?
Download Yarn Sort Puzzle now and dive into a world of colorful threads and cozy logic fun!
Your feedbacks nourish our growth and we greatly appreciate it. Got any questions or ideas - drop us a line to zephyr.support@tripledotstudios.com
Terms of Use: https://tripledotstudios.com/tos/

Play the ultimate fast-paced, high-stakes 13-card showdown! Pig Hunters is the online 13-card shedding game of Tiến Lên Miền Nam (TLMN) — also called Thirteen, Chặt Heo, and Killer 13. Shed your cards, outsmart opponents, and dominate with pure strategy and nerve.

Challenge elite players worldwide or invite friends/family to settle who's the real boss at the table. Ready to claim Grandmaster status?

EPIC GAME MODES
- Ranked Play — Climb global leaderboards through thrilling seasons. Earn the elite Grandmaster title + exclusive rewards!
- Winner Takes All — Pure high-risk glory: First place takes everything. Turn rags to riches... or risk it all. Got the guts?

GENEROUS REWARDS
- Log in daily for free gold!
- Crush daily quests for extra gold, premium currencies, and more.  ENDLESS CUSTOMIZATION
Unlock epic frames, avatars, emoji packs, and killer in-game animations. Celebrate wins your way—because one tomato just won't cut it!

HOW TIẾN LÊN / THIRTEEN WORKS
- Fast "shedding" gameplay with deep tactics:
- Standard 52-card deck
- Card Rank (High to Low): 2 > A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9 > 8 > 7 > 6 > 5 > 4 > 3
- Suit Rank (High to Low): Hearts > Diamonds > Clubs > Spades
- Pigs (2s) rule supreme — especially the powerful 2 of Hearts!

Chop pigs (beat the 2s), block plays, and go out first to win. Easy to learn, impossible to master—perfect for strategy fans who crave skill over luck.  If you love competitive card games like poker or shedding battles, Pig Hunters delivers non-stop thrills. Join the global community that's already hooked!

Download Now — Time to Chop Some Pigs!

bluejetty:00118909:ios.description:
The calendar app for pilots, flight attendants, and ground staff.
CrewLounge CONNECT only supports manual upload of your roster files. We recommend trying the free version of the app to see if this manual upload process suits your needs before purchasing the annual license. 
View your schedule offline and manage your time. Share your schedule with colleagues in the same or different companies. Let your friends and family track your flights.
Works seamlessly on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
CrewLounge CONNECT comes with these great features:
- Export your flight schedule to any calendar (iOS, Google, Outlook, ...)
- Share your roster with colleagues (using the same app)
- Family and friends can view your schedule and track your flights (free web app)
- Chat 1-on-1 and 1-on-Crew (no need to create a group via social media)
- Carpool with colleagues (find nearby crew on your flight)
- Meet people in outstation (to eat, exercise, dance or date)
- Find the crew on another flight
- Airline crew favorite restaurants and activities in outstation
And many other tools, such as:
- passenger headcount
- in-flight rest time calculation
- hotel pick-up time calculation
- currency exchange rate calculator
- hotel room list sharing
- track your car position on the airport parking
- destination briefing (weather, notes, time zone)
Keep track of your duties:
- detailed history (how many weekend days did I get last year)
- export flights and simulator to your pilot logbook (CrewLounge, LogTen Pro)
You can try this app without registration or payment! Download your roster from your airline in the free DEMO mode.
Important Notes:
1) This app does not support airlines integrations. If your airline is does not support a roster file download, you can not use this app.
3) While every effort is made to avoid bugs, we cannot be held responsible for any errors with the app and the results caused by these errors, such as late sign-up or no-show for any duty! You must always consult your official company schedule!
4) This app can be downloaded for free. After registration you can use the app for free for a limited number of roster imports. Unlock all features with in-app purchase. A single payment can be used across multiple devices and different OS platforms.

bluejetty:00119839:ios.description:
Smartkids – Apprendre l’anglais et le français en s’amusant!
Offrez à vos enfants la possibilité d’apprendre le vocabulaire anglais et français grâce à plus de 700 cartes interactives réparties en 18 thèmes amusants : animaux, fruits, légumes, moyens de transport et bien plus encore.
Avec Smartkids, l’apprentissage devient un jeu ! Vos enfants profitent de quiz, jeux de mémoire, puzzles et activités d’ombres pour améliorer leur concentration, développer leur créativité et renforcer la reconnaissance des mots de façon ludique.
Smartkids est conçu pour être le compagnon idéal des tout-petits et enfants d’âge préscolaire, en rendant l’éducation amusante et engageante.
Fonctionnalités principales :
- Apprenez le vocabulaire anglais et français avec plus de 700 images colorées dans 18 catégories sélectionnées avec soin :
- Plus de 1 000 livres et leçons interactives en anglais
- Plus de 200 jeux éducatifs pour apprendre le vocabulaire anglais et exercer vos compétences d'écoute, d'expression orale et d'écriture
- Alphabet, chiffres, couleurs, fruits, légumes, vêtements, école, jardin, animaux, cuisine, sport, outils, transport, musique, etc.
- Des quiz ludiques pour tester et améliorer le vocabulaire.
- Un jeu de mémoire pour stimuler la concentration.
- Un puzzle amusant pour assembler les pièces et reconstituer l’image.
- Un jeu des ombres pour reconnaître les formes et développer l’observation.
- Voix enregistrées par des locuteurs natifs pour une prononciation claire et naturelle.
- Conditions d'utilisation : https://vkidsapp.com/terms
- Politique de confidentialité : https://vkidsapp.com/privacy
Téléchargez dès maintenant et transformez le jeu en une aventure bilingue!
==============
Smartkids – Fun English & French Learning for Kids
Help your children discover English and French vocabulary through more than 700 interactive flashcards across 18 exciting topics like animals, fruits, vegetables, transportation, and more.
With Smartkids, learning becomes play: children enjoy quiz challenges, memory games, puzzles, and shadow-matching activities that improve focus, creativity, and word recognition.
We designed Smartkids to be the perfect learning companion for toddlers and preschoolers, making education joyful and engaging!
Key Features:
- Learn English & French words with 700 colorful images in 18 carefully selected categories:
- Over 1,000 books and interactive lessons in English
- Over 200 educational games to learn English vocabulary and practice listening, speaking, and writing skills
- Alphabet, Numbers, Colors, Fruits, Vegetables, Clothes, School, Garden, Animals, Kitchen, Sports, Tools, Transport, Music, and more.
- Fun quiz games to test and improve vocabulary skills.
- Memory game to boost concentration and attention.
- Puzzle game where kids put pieces together to complete images.
- Shadow-matching game to train shape recognition and observation skills.
- Authentic native speaker audio for perfect pronunciation.
- Terms of use: https://vkidsapp.com/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://vkidsapp.com/privacy
Download now and turn playtime into a bilingual learning adventure!

 -Nines: 2 points each

Game Features:

 -Online multiplayer (with friends or random players)

 -In app purchase to remove ads

bluejetty:00161965:ios.description:
FLY MILITARY AIRCRAFT AND PASSENGER AIRLINERS:
"Turboprop Flight Simulator" is a 3D airplane simulator game, in which you pilot various types of modern turboprop aircraft, and also drive ground vehicles.
THE AIRCRAFT:
* C-400 tactical airlifter - inspired from the real-world Airbus A400M.
* HC-400 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-400.
* MC-400 special operations - variant of C-400.
* RL-42 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-42.
* RL-72 regional airliner - inspired from the real-world ATR-72.
* E-42 military early warning aircraft - derived from RL-42.
* XV-40 concept tilt-wing VTOL cargo.
* PV-40 private luxury VTOL - variant of XV-40.
* MV-40 special operations VTOL - variant of XV-40.
* PS-26 concept private seaplane.
* MS-26 special operations seaplane - variant of PS-26.
* C-130 military cargo - inspired from the legendary Lockheed C-130 Hercules.
* HC-130 coastguard search and rescue - variant of C-130.
* MC-130 special operations - variant of C-130.
HAVE FUN:
* Learn to fly with training missions (teaching the basics of flying, taxiing, takeoff and landing).
* Complete various missions.
* Explore the plane's interior in first-person (in most levels, and free-flight).
* Interact with various items (doors, cargo ramp, strobes, main lights).
* Drive ground vehicles.
* Load, unload, and airdrop supplies and vehicles with the cargo planes.
* Takeoff and land on improvised runways (and airports, for sure).
* Fly without restrictions in free-flight mode, or create flight routes on the map.
* Perform refueling on ground and mid-air refueling.
* Use JATO/L (Jet Assisted Take-Off and Landing).
* Fly in varied time-of-day, fog and wind conditions.
OTHER FEATURES:
* FREE airplane simulator game updated in 2025!
* NO MANDATORY ADS! Only optional, rewarded ones in-between flights.
* Good 3D graphics (with detailed cockpits for all the airplanes).
* Realistic physics for flight simulation.
* Complete pilot controls (including rudder, flaps, spoilers, thrust reversers, auto-brakes, and landing gear).
* Multiple control options (including mixed tilt sensor & stick / yoke).
* Multiple cameras (including cockpit cameras with captain and copilot positions).
* Close to realistic engines' sounds (turbines and propellers noises recorded from real airplanes).
* Partial and total aircraft destruction (clipping wing tips, full wings separation, tail separation, and main fuselage breakage).
* Several islands with many airports.
* Selection of measurement units for air speed, flying altitude, and distance (metric, aviation standard, and imperial).

bluejetty:00075525:ios.description:
Welcome to “Fun Learning Games for Kids”, the interactive and engaging educational game where learning meets playtime! All of our tasks are voiced, so even the youngest players can understand and enjoy the challenges without any reading assistance! Specially designed for kids aged 3-6 years, our app offers a vibrant world where your little one can improve essential skills like math, logic, memory, and attention - all while having a blast!
EDUCATIONAL & FUN WITH VOICE-OVER
Who says education can't be fun? Our carefully designed mini-games are voiced over to provide clear instruction and feedback, offering a playful learning experience that keeps your child engaged and happy.
ADOPT A VIRTUAL PET
Your child's efforts are rewarded with an adorable virtual pet. They can feed, care for, and even customize their pet's room as they solve more problems and complete tasks.
REWARDS & CUSTOMIZATION
Exciting prizes await! As your child completes each educational game, they will earn rewards like food, toys, and furniture to care for their pet. This positive reinforcement will encourage them to keep playing and learning.
SKILL DEVELOPMENT
Sharpen your child’s math, logic, attention and memory skills with our diverse set of challenges, each designed to help them reach important developmental milestones.
KEY FEATURES:
• Wide Range of Fun Games
• Skill-based Challenges
• Personal Virtual Pet
• Customizable Pet Room
• Voiced-Over Tasks
• Track Your Child's Progress
• Safe and Kid-friendly Design
SAFETY & SECURITY:
Designed with your child's safety in mind. No third-party advertisements. Kid-safe and parent-approved!
DOWNLOAD NOW!
Why wait? Embark on a delightful learning journey with “Fun Learning Games for Kids” - where your child learns, earns, and has endless fun!
We would love to hear your feedback. In case you have any questions or comments about the game, please write to us at funlearning@speedymind.net.

bluejetty:00180185:ios.summary:

Mobility has raised business productivity, but it’s brought its share of issues, as well. One of the biggest challenges is the need to provi
bluejetty:00180185:ios.description:
The Zscaler App for iOS includes both Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access modules. 
Mobility has raised business productivity, but it’s brought its share of issues, as well. One of the biggest challenges is the need to provide complete, consistent security across devices that you may not own. The majority of web traffic from mobile devices comes from apps, not from standard browsers, so threats may not even be visible to traditional security appliances.
Note: Zscaler App is used with an active enterprise subscription to Zscaler's Mobile Security service. Please follow instructions from your IT organization to use this app. 
Zscaler App automatically creates a lightweight HTTP tunnel that connects the user’s endpoint to Zscaler’s cloud security platform with no need for PAC files or authentication cookies. The Zscaler Cloud Service delivers one-step enrollment, with multifactor authentication support via SAML.
If you are an end-user and have issues or concerns, please reach out to your organizations support. Client Connector does not collect any personal information about you, or your device, however traffic your device sends to websites and SaaS applications is visible by your company administrators.

Feel free to enjoy the unique atmosphere and design of Royal Solitaire as you immerse yourself in this classic card game!

bluejetty:00083365:ios.description:
Scan - QR Code Scanner App is a data capture tool for high-precision scanning, supporting all major 1D and 2D formats for business, retail, and personal use.
SUPPORTED FORMATS:
* Retail & Logistics: UPC-A, UPC-E, EAN-8, EAN-13, Code 39, Code 128, ITF.
* Industrial & Pro: Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, Codabar.
* Digital & Social: Standard QR, Micro QR, vCard, MeCard.
KEY FEATURES:
* Instant Scanner: Recognition of all QR and Barcode formats via camera.
* Batch Scan Mode: Process multiple codes in a row for retail and inventory management.
* Library & Folders: Group codes into custom folders for structured access.
* QR Creator: Generate codes for URLs, Wi-Fi networks, Contact Cards (vCard), and Text.
* Tagging System: Add custom tags to scans for filtered search.
* Offline Mode: Access your entire library without an internet connection.
* Data Export: Share and export codes via email, messaging, or social media.
USE SCENARIOS:
* Inventory Tracking: Use Batch Mode for warehouse stock and asset management.
* Price Comparison: Scan product barcodes (EAN/UPC) to find info and deals.
* Wi-Fi Sharing: Create or scan QR codes to join networks instantly.
* Business Networking: Generate digital business cards via vCard.
WORKFLOW TOOLS:
* CSV/TXT Support: Export scanned data for Excel or CRM integration.
* Low-Light Scanning: Built-in flashlight toggle for dark environments.
* Management System: Folder-based storage for high-volume data.
------------------------------------

The account will be charged a renewal fee within 24 hours of the end of the current period and will be renewed accordingly.

bluejetty:00069125:ios.summary:

With HTTPBot, you can
 - Make re
bluejetty:00069125:ios.description:
HTTPBot is a powerful API client and debugger that lets you send HTTP/HTTPs requests, connect to WebSockets, browse and invoke remote MCP servers, inspect JSON & HTML responses, and debug APIs on the go.
With HTTPBot, you can
 - Make requests and view responses from anywhere.
 - Debug API issues even while away from your terminal. 
 - Work with JSON, HTML, XML, and raw text responses effortlessly.
 - Collaborate with your team by importing & exporting Postman collections, and by syncing with the Postman API.
FEATURES
 - Powerful request editor provides a GUI for easily editing HTTP, HTTPS & WebSockets requests.
 - Connect to remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to browse and invoke their tools, prompts, and resources.
 - Supports all major HTTP methods, including GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, and OPTIONS.
 - Automatically highlights JSON, HTML, and XML content for better readability. 
 - View detailed metrics for requests and responses, including size, duration, SSL and more. 
 - Support for OpenAPI/Swagger specs as well as Postman collections & environments, including sync with Postman accounts on the cloud 
 - View request documentation for APIs
 - Native support for GraphQL requests - edit queries and variables directly, and view schema.
 - Import & export collections from/to any document storage provider, like iCloud Drive, Dropbox and more.
 - Supports authentication using Basic, Digest, OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2.0, JWT and much more. Securely store auth credentials for frequent use.
 - Save frequently-used variables in environments
 - Filter & query responses using XPath & JSONPath
 - Automate your workflows with Shortcuts integration.
PRICING
HTTPBot is available to download for free, with a risk-free 7-day trial to unlock access to its features. Enjoy full access beyond the trial with a yearly subscription, or a one-time purchase for a lifetime upgrade. All plans unlock the app on all platforms where it is supported.
LEGAL
Duration & price of each subscription is displayed in the app when upgrading to Pro. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is cancelled atleast 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your iTunes account settings. Any unused portion of the free trial period is forfeited as soon as a subscription is purchased.
Terms of use: https://www.httpbot.io/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://www.httpbot.io/privacy.html
