bluejetty:00124322:ios.summary:
Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.
You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to
bluejetty:00124322:ios.description:
Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.
You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.
Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...
MASSIVE OPEN WORLD
Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?
ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM
Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.
Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.
BEAUTIFUL VISUALS
Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.
SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK
Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.
BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM
Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.
JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS
Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards. 
As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!
WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS
Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!
SUPPORT
If you encounter any issues during the game, you can send us feedback via the in-game Customer Service Center.
Customer Service Email: genshin_cs@hoyoverse.com
Official Site: https://genshin.hoyoverse.com/
Forums: https://www.hoyolab.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Genshinimpact/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/genshinimpact/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/GenshinImpact
YouTube: http://www.youtube.com/c/GenshinImpact 
Discord: https://discord.gg/genshinimpact

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards. 

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

bluejetty:00083275:ios.description:
Trendsi is your one-stop fashion supplier that offers fashion dropshipping, open pack wholesale and made to order manufacturing. By simplifying sourcing, production, inventory and logistics, we're striving to become the fashion supply chain infrastructure that takes care of your back-end, so you can focus on doing what you love: your customers and your brand. 
Our Full Services Include:
Dropshipping: Find and add products with ready-to-use product videos, photos, size measurements, and descriptions to your stores with one click. Easily order samples before you sell a product. We conduct quality inspections and ship every order from our US warehouse within 2 - 10 business days, all under your brand's invoice. Plus, we offer a 7-day free return policy for both you and your customers.
Open Pack Wholesale: Say goodbye to predetermined packs. With us, you can choose any quantity of sizes, with a minimum order quantity of just 6 per color variant. Plus, order a sample to try before you buy wholesale. Trendsi also ensures your bestsellers are always in stock to prevent missing sales opportunities. With our rapid 7-14 business day restock capability, you can hold less inventory while growing your business and minimizing risk.
Made to Order: All rights to the design will be owned by you. Send us product details like materials and measurements, and we'll take care of making the sample and manufacturing details. Through our trusted network of manufacturers, we offer a MOQ as low as 60 pieces. With our agile production, reorder lead times only takes 7 business days.
Private Labeling: Add your business logo on high-quality white label products and create customized packaging to set your brand apart.
Source with Trendsi: Can't find a fashion product on Trendsi? Let us know and we can help source it for dropshipping and wholesale.
Live Selling Center: Experience seamless live selling at the Trendsi Los Angeles Live Selling Center with thousands of samples and professional studios at your fingertips.
24/7 Chat Support: Get an answer from us whenever and wherever you need us, 24/7 at support@trendsi.com

bluejetty:00152666:ios.description:
Still driven crazy by losing your TV remote? Or already tired of the clumsiness of old-fashioned remotes? Worry no more—simply install this remote app on your phone, and all your troubles will be easily resolved. 
TV Remote: a brand-new upgrade for your viewing experience! 
This is a practical and minimalist app that turns your iPhone into a control center for your smart TV. 
It perfectly replicates the functions of a traditional handheld remote, allowing you to effortlessly control your TV: switch channels at will, adjust volume with precision, navigate menus smoothly, and access various tools including play, pause, stop, and more. 
It’s extremely simple to use—just connect your iPhone and TV to the same Wi-Fi network, and your phone’s touchscreen instantly becomes a fully functional navigation panel. Every feature of a traditional remote is right at your fingertips. 
It boasts countless highlights: 
• Wi-Fi Connection: Automatically detects TVs on the network, enabling smart control via your phone. 
• User-Friendly: Works as a physical remote anytime, anywhere—no complicated learning required. 
• Haptic Feedback: Delivers realistic vibration responses, mimicking the tactile feel of a real remote. 
• Sensitive Touchpad: Not only sleek and comfortable, but also highly responsive for a top-tier control experience.
• Keyboard Input: Effortlessly perform TV searches—no more tedious button-by-button typing. 
• Screen Mirroring: Cast photos and videos from your phone to the TV with one tap for a more immersive big-screen experience. Simple and hassle-free. 
TV Remote is the perfect replacement for a physical TV remote, bringing convenience and simplicity to your life. It now fully supports Fire TV devices, with more devices to be added soon. With it, you’ll never have to get up from the couch to grab the remote or struggle to find or replace a lost one. Just sync the app with your TV, and easily browse your favorite shows, movies, and series right from your phone. Embrace the power of technology to make life better and smarter!

Upgrade to the VIP version to unlock all features of the app and enjoy the full service experience.

• The subscription fee will be automatically deducted from your iTunes account, and VIP benefits will be activated immediately upon successful payment. 
• The system will automatically renew the subscription 24 hours before the end of the current cycle. The renewal amount will be the same as the current subscription plan until you manually cancel it in your Apple ID account settings. 
• To cancel the subscription, please go to "Apple ID > Subscriptions > Select this app > Cancel Subscription" at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription cycle. VIP benefits for the already paid period will not be affected.

bluejetty:00087377:ios.summary: Diamond Ore Finder for MC is a powerful and convenient tool for Minecraft players who want to efficiently find valuable resources and explore the world more strategically. Designed with a clean interface and advanced calculation logic, the
bluejetty:00087377:ios.description:
Diamond Ore Finder for MC is a powerful and convenient tool for Minecraft players who want to efficiently find valuable resources and explore the world more strategically. Designed with a clean interface and advanced calculation logic, the app helps you save time, optimize mining, and discover important locations faster.
How the app works:
Enter your Seed and coordinates — Input your Minecraft world Seed along with your current coordinates. The app analyzes world-generation rules, including biomes, height levels, and terrain features, to calculate the most promising locations.
Choose what you’re looking for — Select the ore you want to find, such as diamonds, redstone, emeralds, or other resources. The app shows the optimal Y-levels and probable zones for each material.
Find structures — In addition to ores, the app supports more than 25 Minecraft structures, including villages, strongholds, mineshafts, temples, bastions, fortresses, and many others. This makes exploration, survival gameplay, and speedruns much more efficient.
Get smart suggestions — Based on your Seed, depth, and biome, the app highlights areas with the highest chance of success. Due to the procedural nature of Minecraft world generation, results may vary.
Mine and explore more efficiently — Spend less time digging randomly and more time gathering resources and discovering important locations.
Use the Seed library — Browse a built-in library of unique Seeds to generate new worlds with interesting terrain, structures, and mining opportunities.
• Supports all current Minecraft versions, including Java and Bedrock Editions.
• Finds 10+ ore types and 25+ structures in one app.
• Automatically updated to match the latest world-generation and mining mechanics.
• Simple, interactive, and beginner-friendly interface.
• Built-in Seed library for experimenting with different worlds and playstyles.
Diamond Ore Finder for MC is a third-party application and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. This is an unofficial tool created to enhance your Minecraft experience. All rights to Minecraft belong to Mojang AB.
Make your Minecraft adventures more productive, strategic, and exciting with Diamond Ore Finder for MC.

bluejetty:00037273:ios.description:
This app is developed exclusively for use with the Fujifilm instax WIDE Evo camera. Simply, connect your instax WIDE Evo to this app via Bluetooth and get started. 
●Direct Print
Transfer a photo from your Smartphone to the camera, and print it with the camera using the instax™ Direct Print feature on the App. 
Before printing the photo, you can use the instax WIDE Evo™ App to rotate it, enlarge it or reduce its size.
●Remote Shooting
Control the camera with your Smartphone for remote shooting of photos.
●Save Printed Images
You can transfer photos you had printed with the camera to the instax WIDE Evo™ App. You can also add instax™ frames to your images and save them on your Smartphone.
●Discover Feed
The Discover Feed section in the App allows you to explore other users’ images that were taken with the instax WIDE Evo™ hybrid　instant camera in addition to displaying your own images. You can 
also check out the effects and settings that were used.
●Add to Favorites
You can easily save the film effect settings of works you have printed or that others have used (where such photos are posted on the Discover Feed) to your camera favorites for future use.
[Supported OS]
iOS17.0 or later

bluejetty:00080354:ios.name: Playing Kafka
bluejetty:00080354:ios.summary: Although you did nothing wrong, you were arrested one morning. You arrived for work, but you don’t recognize your assistants. And your upbringing left you with a pervasive sense of guilt. Welcome to Playing Kafka, an adventure about the ali
bluejetty:00080354:ios.description:
Although you did nothing wrong, you were arrested one morning. You arrived for work, but you don’t recognize your assistants. And your upbringing left you with a pervasive sense of guilt. Welcome to Playing Kafka, an adventure about the alienation of modern society as well as unresolved family issues. The game adapts three works of the famously absurdist writer and was created with leading Kafka experts. 
Can you manage to win an unfair trial? Is the job even real? Can you escape your father’s crushing presence? How do you move forward, when all solutions are obfuscated by a web of unclear rules and machinations…
The game features:
• a fully voiced branching story, based on Kafka’s The Trial, The Castle and Letter To His Father
• atmospheric puzzles, fateful decisions and a drag and drop gameplay that makes characters and environments come alive
• approximately 1.5 hour of story in an ever-changing setting
Three books, three game chapters:
The Trial
You face an opaque legal trial and are slowly sucked into a web of perplexing bureaucracy. It is up to you how to approach the vague, but insidious accusation – choose who to ask for help and how to talk to judges, procurators, and others as the judgment is slowly closing in on you. Does it even matter if you’re innocent?
Letter to His Father
Drawing inspiration from Kafka's unsent confession to his father, this chapter delves into their tense relationship. Try to find the right words that helped Kafka come to terms with his upbringing. See Franz struggle to connect with his father in scenes from the past. Is there any hope of reconciliation?
The Castle
You arrive at a snow-laden village to work as a land surveyor, but you quickly find that nothing is as it seems – locals talk about the village Castle in hushed tones and each day brings more questions than answers. Will you ever be accepted by the forever out-of-reach Castle?
The game was developed to commemorate the centenary of Kafka’s death and was developed in cooperation with the Goethe-Institut, Prague.
The Chinese language version was initiated and supported by the Czech Centre Taipei.

bluejetty:00156747:ios.description:
Search. Book. Fly. Discover.
No matter where you’re going, it matters how you get there. Download the Wheels Up app for over 1,500 safety-vetted and verified private aircraft available at your fingertips.
Manage your trips from the palm of your hand.
- Take care of everything without making a phone call.
- Get real time pricing for instant booking.
- Personalize your searches by saving your favorite airports and passengers.
- Book your travel in a few steps adding passengers – including your pets – and add additional luggage to your trip.
- With push notifications and SMS, you’ll receive the latest information about your flights, including your tail number and FBO.
- View flight activity, edit your payment methods, and download invoicing information.
Arrange on board catering or ground transportation.
Let us provide you with snacks for your trip. Just tell us what you’d like, and it will be waiting for you on board. If you need a rental car or driver, we’ll be happy to arrange everything.
Fly private for less on empty legs and Shared Flights.
Members can lower their flight costs with empty leg opportunities or by sharing flights with other members.  
The sky’s the limit with exclusive benefits.
It’s one of the perks of membership. Access exceptional and personalized experiences both in the air and on the ground.
Get in touch.
Have questions? We have answers. Explore our FAQs section, or get in touch with our team directly from the app. Create an account now and get started. 
Passenger flights shall be arranged by Wheels Up Partners LLC, Wheels Up Private Jets LLC, or Air Partner LLC, each acting as a bona fide agent for charterer. Flights that depart from, or arrive, or conducted entirely outside of the U.S. shall be arranged by Air Partner Limited, Air Partner International, Air Partner International GmbH, and/or Air Partner Srl, each acting as a foreign indirect air carrier. The air charter broker(s) shall be disclosed to charterer in a Trip Quote.
All flights shall be operated by a direct air carrier or foreign direct air carrier that holds an Air Carrier Certificate under 14 C.F.R. § 119 (or equivalent license as a foreign air carrier under applicable foreign law), authorizing them to furnish air transportation services pursuant to 14 C.F.R § 121, 129 or 135 (or equivalent license authority as a foreign air carrier under applicable foreign law), as such air carrier may be utilized or designated to charterer with prior notice. For the avoidance of doubt, when Wheels Up Partners LLC or Wheels Up Private Jets LLC provide air transportation services to a charterer, they are a direct air carrier (also referred to as an "Operator"), and with respect to any cargo flights arranged by Air Partner LLC, such flights are arranged in its capacity as an indirect air carrier.

Need a simple, free, and easy-to-use journalling app? Meet Personal Diary!

You can also import as many photos as you wish into your entries. As an optional addition, you can set your mood, and add weather and tags to an entry.

 - Numeric passcode lock (any number of digits).
 - Unlock using Touch ID or Face ID on supported devices.
 - Auto-saves as you type.

 - Ability to pick a mood and weather of the day.

 - Daily notifications for writing in your diary.

bluejetty:00174922:ios.name: Seconds Pro Interval Timer
bluejetty:00174922:ios.summary:
Seconds Pro is an interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, circuits and any workout built from timed intervals. It calls each interval out loud, keeps running with the screen off, and runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Apple has featured
bluejetty:00174922:ios.description:
Seconds Pro is an interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, circuits and any workout built from timed intervals. It calls each interval out loud, keeps running with the screen off, and runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Apple has featured it, and Joe Wicks, The Body Coach, has said it is the fitness app he uses more than any other.
BUILD ANY WORKOUT
- Start from a HIIT, Tabata or circuit template, or build a timer from scratch with sets, rounds and intervals of different lengths.
- Chain timers into one compound timer, so a warm-up flows into the main set and then a cool-down.
- Color-code every interval so you know what is coming before the beep.
- Share a timer with a friend in one tap.
HEAR IT, DON'T WATCH IT
- Voice cues call out each interval by name and warn you before the next one starts.
- Beeps and bells are there too if you would rather not be talked at.
- Play your own music, per timer or per interval. Cues duck the music and it comes back up when they are done.
- The timer keeps going in the background while you use other apps or the screen sleeps.
ON THE GYM FLOOR
- A full-screen, color-coded display you can read from across the room, in portrait or landscape. On iPad it uses the whole screen.
- A lock button stops a stray tap from pausing your set.
APPLE WATCH
- Seconds Pro runs on the watch by itself, so the phone can stay in the locker. Timers you build on the phone sync to the wrist, and Quick Intervals builds a basic circuit on the watch itself.
MORE TIMERS
- A stopwatch that marks your best and worst laps.
- A countdown timer with five preset durations (three on Apple Watch).
APPLE HEALTH
- Save workouts and mindful sessions to Health. With a heart rate monitor connected, Seconds Pro reads your body measurements and year of birth from Health to estimate calories burned.
PAID ONCE, NOTHING TO UNLOCK
- Seconds Pro is paid for up front. Every feature is included and every timer you make can be run as many times as you like.
SECONDS AND SECONDS PRO
- Seconds is the free version of this app. It has the same features, but each timer locks after one run until a single in-app purchase unlocks it. The two are separate products and a purchase in one does not carry over to the other. If you bought Seconds Pro, download Seconds Pro. If you bought the unlock in Seconds, download Seconds and use Restore Purchases.

bluejetty:00120810:ios.description:
An exciting new chapter in the Ace Attorney series!
Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth takes the Ace Attorney series from the courtroom to the crime scene, leaving the legal battle behind while bringing the action to various crime scenes. This time around, the player takes on the role of famed prosecutor Miles Edgeworth, a memorable rival of charismatic legal eagle Phoenix Wright. By solving the challenging puzzles presented him, Edgeworth will work with the police to bring criminals to justice.
Game Summary
• Guide Miles Edgeworth through various locations, examine and analyze clues, work directly with characters on the scene, find contradictions in suspect statements, and get to the truth by presenting decisive evidence.

• High resolution graphics optimized for modern devices. 
• Utilize the all-new “Logic” system, where Miles can choose two pieces of information out of the various pieces he has collected and “combine” them to discover new information.
• Reproduce the crime scene using the in game hologram and discover new information.
• Experience the famously eclectic cast of characters of the Ace Attorney universe.

bluejetty:00011002:android.name: Stellar Path: Zodiac Echo
bluejetty:00011002:android.summary: Enter a cozy moonlit courtyard and test your focus in a relaxing pair-link puzzle. The board is filled with charming arcane tiles—rings, brooms, scrolls, portals, globes. Your task is simple and satisfying: find two identical tiles and conn
bluejetty:00011002:android.description:
Enter a cozy moonlit courtyard and test your focus in a relaxing pair-link puzzle. The board is filled with charming arcane tiles—rings, brooms, scrolls, portals, globes. Your task is simple and satisfying: find two identical tiles and connect them with a clear path to remove them from the board. Clear all tiles to complete the stage.
How to Play
Find a pair: Tap two identical tiles.
Link rule: The path between them must be clear and can turn up to two times (three straight segments). If the route is blocked, the pair won’t connect.
Remove & progress: Linked tiles vanish, opening new paths and freeing hidden matches.
Goal: Clear every tile to finish the level.
Helpful Tools
Hint: Reveal a connectable pair when you’re stuck.
Shuffle/Refresh: Rearrange remaining tiles to surface new routes.
Special tiles: Some golden or glowing tiles may act as wilds or grant bonuses—use them wisely.
What Makes It Fun
Zen flow: Soft visuals, gentle effects, and quick rounds perfect for short breaks.
Smart satisfaction: Each match opens corridors for the next—planning creates lovely chains.
Steady challenge: Compact early boards grow into intricate puzzles that reward observation.

bluejetty:00200186:ios.name: Chord Lab: Chord Synth
bluejetty:00200186:ios.summary:
Seven keys, a joystick and room for your ideas. Chord Lab turns your iPhone and iPad into a chord instrument with 3D controls, expressive sounds and layers of accompaniment. Open it, choose a sound and start playing.
MAKE THE CHORDS YOURS
bluejetty:00200186:ios.description:
Seven keys, a joystick and room for your ideas. Chord Lab turns your iPhone and iPad into a chord instrument with 3D controls, expressive sounds and layers of accompaniment. Open it, choose a sound and start playing.
MAKE THE CHORDS YOURS
Play full chords, strums, arpeggios or drones. Choose your key and octave, customize each button or build a voicing note by note. Save your shapes and assign different chord variations to the joystick's eight directions.
EXPLORE 110 SOUNDS
Combine original synthesizer sounds with a library of sample-based instruments. Discover pads, plucks, organs, synths and more. Shape each sound with glide, envelopes, filter cutoff and resonance.
BUILD YOUR EFFECT CHAIN
Explore 15 effects, including Cloud and Shimmer reverbs, delays, chorus, vibrato, phaser, tremolo, vinyl and drive. Connect up to six modules in series, adjust their parameters and save your chains. Effects process the chord keys while beats, sustained pads and textures stay independent.
LO-FI, RHYTHMS AND ATMOSPHERES
Play along with 40 electronic rhythms, including lo-fi grooves and beats inspired by the 1980s. Add sustained pads in all 12 keys and textures made from real recordings: vinyl, rain, forest, coffee machine, city and night. Each layer has its own volume.
CONNECT AND CAPTURE
Use MIDI input and output, visual control mapping and compatible game controllers. Record your mix as a 24-bit stereo WAV, listen back and share your ideas. Save and import setups to recall your settings. Layers you start can keep playing in the background.
An AUv3 instrument extension brings the sounds and sound controls to compatible hosts. The seven-key interface, beats and backing pads belong to the standalone app.
GIVE YOUR INSTRUMENT ITS OWN LOOK
Choose hardware colors and animated backgrounds with a retro feel. Play in portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad. The interface is available in English and Portuguese.
One purchase. No subscriptions or in-app purchases. Works offline, with no account required.
Support: contato@dedealbano.com
Privacy policy: https://dedealbano.com/politica-de-privacidade-chordlab/

bluejetty:00180691:ios.description:
Free up space and bring order to your photo library without losing the moments that matter. Cleaner groups duplicate and similar photos, screenshots, blurry shots, Live Photos, bursts, screen recordings and large videos so you can review what takes up space. You stay in control: Cleaner suggests the best photo, protects important items and never removes anything until you confirm.
Clean up photos and videos
• Review duplicates and similar shots side by side
• Find screenshots, blurry photos, Live Photos and bursts
• Spot screen recordings and large videos
• Use Best suggestions and protection markers to make safer choices
Swipe at your pace
Swipe to keep or remove each item, or choose Decide Later when you are not ready. Review your choices before confirming. Photos and videos you delete are moved by Apple Photos to Recently Deleted.
More ways to tidy up
Compress large videos when you want a smaller copy. Find duplicate contacts and calendar entries, then choose what to merge or remove.
Private by design
Photo and video analysis happens on your device. Your library stays under your control throughout the cleanup.
Subscription information
Subscriptions start at the price shown on the purchase screen. A free trial may be available only to eligible users, and its duration is shown before purchase. Prices vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://nestore.co/terms

bluejetty:00155756:ios.description:
Lake Elmo Bank Mobile
Lake Elmo Bank Mobile gives you a free secure, convenient access to your accounts anytime, anywhere. Designed to make everyday banking simple, the app puts the tools you need right at your fingertips—so you can manage your money with confidence.
What you can do:
• View balances, transactions, and account activity in real time
• Organize transactions with tags, notes, and receipt images
• Set up account alerts to stay informed about balances and activity
• Transfer money between your Lake Elmo Bank accounts
• Pay bills or send money to people you trust
• Deposit checks quickly by snapping a photo
• Turn your debit card on or off and request a replacement
• View, save, and download monthly statements
• Find nearby Lake Elmo Bank branches and ATMs
Security you can trust
Your security is our priority. Access your account using a secure passcode or biometric authentication (Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices), along with industry standard safeguards designed to protect your information.
Getting started
To use the Lake Elmo Bank Mobile app, you must be enrolled in Lake Elmo Bank Digital Banking. If you already use our online banking, simply download the app and log in with your existing credentials.

bluejetty:00077000:android.description:
Same great app, new improved name - "My Wi-Fi"’ has been renamed to "TELUS Connect".
Easily manage your TELUS home services from your mobile device! Self-install TELUS products, set up parental controls, personalize your service and troubleshoot issues right at your fingertips.
Key features:
* Monitor devices connected to your network, check your data usage and your billing information
* View and change your Wi-Fi name/password, and manage your guest Wi-Fi
* Pause Wi-Fi device access, or set up schedules to take back family time
* Set up family safety features such as adult content controls and network security 
* Access personalized troubleshooting and recommendations to keep your services running smoothly
* Self-install your TELUS products, including Boost Wi-Fi, modems, TV boxes and more. Requires TELUS hardware or a self-install kit.
Requirements:
* TELUS Internet subscription in Alberta, British Columbia or Quebec
* My TELUS // Espace client account
* Android 8 and later
* Feature availability may differ based on modem, region, and product subscription.

bluejetty:00063170:ios.description:
****Featured by Apple in "Must-Have Apple Watch Apps" and "Our Favorite Apple Watch Apps" collections****
Coloring is a great way to calm down and relieve stress. Experience the relaxing effects of coloring directly on your Apple Watch and iPhone. Originally designed exclusively for Apple Watch, Coloring Watch gives you a full coloring experience on your Apple Watch. Latest update brings this totally unique coloring app also on your iPhone! Now you can use both devices, Watch and Phone to color over 200 images. 
***MAIN FEATURES*** 
**One-time payment - No in-app purchases - All image updates for free**
**Color over 200+ images on your Apple Watch and iPhone**
-Animated and still images
-100 colors to choose from
-New image updates for free
-Create your personal "favorites" gallery on your Phone
**Your progress is automatically stored and you can continue your coloring anytime on Apple Watch and iPhone**
**Share your creations and create unique Watch Faces**
-Tap image on your iPhone and open the menu to share your creations to the world
-Share menu also contains a “Create Watch Face” button that lets you create unique Watch Faces on your Apple Watch
-Set your favorite coloring image as a complication on the following watch faces: Infograph, Infograph Modular, Meridian, California, Modular Compact and X-Large 
-Please note that the supported complications are only available on Series 4 and later device
**Choose the Phone Coloring Mode**
-You can choose between 2 modes: 
-Watch-like mode: Image parts are selected linearly. Tap RIGHT side of the image to select the NEXT part / LEFT side to select the PREVIOUS part
-Direct Tap mode: Tap the part of the image you want to color
**Accessibility for all - Voice Control support**
-Turn on the Voice Control mode in the Coloring Watch settings and you're able to color images with voice commands.
-NOTE: Voice control must also be enabled in your phone settings: Settings > Accessibility > Voice Control
**Mindful Minutes (OPTIONAL FEATURE)**
-You are able to track your heart rate during coloring by starting a 5 minute Coloring Session on your Apple Watch
-After completing Coloring Sessions, examine changes in your heart rate during the session
-Coloring Sessions can be started by opening the app menu on Watch (swipe to open the menu)
-Coloring Sessions are stored as Mindful Minutes into HealthKit and contribute to your Mindful Minutes in your Health app
-Coloring Session requires access to your HealthKit
***Privacy***
-In order to start optional Coloring Sessions that track your heart rate, Coloring Watch needs access to your Heart Rate and Mindful Minutes data in HealthKit
-Your personal data used by Coloring Watch is only stored and used locally on your devices and is never shared with third parties
***What to do if Coloring Watch does not appear on your Apple Watch***
-Download Coloring Watch directly from the App Store on your Apple Watch
If you have any questions we will happily help you:
contact@coloringwatch.com
HAPPY COLORING!

bluejetty:00168566:ios.name: MarginNote 4: AI Notes·MindMap
bluejetty:00168566:ios.developer: Beijing Yunsi Software Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00168566:ios.summary: MarginNote is the PDF study tool for deep readers. One excerpt is a PDF highlight, a mind map node, and a flashcard — one capture, three places. This is the Card Axis architecture, so you stop ferrying content between a PDF reader, a notes
bluejetty:00168566:ios.description:
MarginNote is the PDF study tool for deep readers. One excerpt is a PDF highlight, a mind map node, and a flashcard — one capture, three places. This is the Card Axis architecture, so you stop ferrying content between a PDF reader, a notes app, and a flashcard tool. A decade of iteration. 188K+ App Store ratings.
【Four Featured Mechanics】
▸ Card Axis — One excerpt, three renders. Document highlight, mind map node, and flashcard are the same card seen from three angles.
▸ Title Link — Old notes auto-surface in new documents. When a familiar concept appears in what you're reading, your past annotation lights up on the page.
▸ Extended Note — Long-press anywhere on a PDF to open writing space. No anchored text required; three display modes (inline / margin / collapsed).
▸ Immersive Mode (4.4) — Three-state toggle: Read / Write / Recall. UI folds away. Recall blurs excerpts with Gaussian blur — tap to reveal only after you've actually recalled.
【AI Capabilities (introduced in 4.2)】
AI book breakdown · AI OCR templates · AI translation · AI Q&A · AI flashcard generation
Our stance is AI as assistant, not replacement — every suggestion can be saved as your own thinking node, never thinking for you.
【Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+)】
Recall Mode hints can run on-device via Apple Intelligence — pick "Apple AI" or "cloud LLM" in Settings. With Apple AI selected, three tiers of help — Neighbor Coordinate · Reasoning Prompt · Key Distinction — are generated by Apple Foundation Models right on your device: no network calls, no AI credits used, your notes never leave your device. Even if you've selected cloud LLM, going offline auto-falls back to Apple Intelligence (provided your device supports it) — so libraries, planes, and exam-day silent rooms never break your hint loop.
【Full Workflow】
Fast OCR · Study Sets (PDF / EPUB / video / audio) · direct read from Zotero / cloud drives / USB · 10 mind map styles · book recomposition · dual-document compare · concept maps · handwriting layers
【FSRS Spaced Repetition】
Built on the open-spaced-repetition project's algorithm (paper accepted by ACM SIGKDD; Anki has used FSRS as its default scheduler since v23.10). Push short-term memory into long-term.
【Built For】
Anyone re-reading a single document until it sticks — med school (USMLE / MCAT) · law school (LSAT / bar exam) · grad prep (GRE / GMAT / CFA) · researchers · language learners (IELTS / TOEFL) · serious readers.
【All Apple Platforms】
iPhone + iPad + Mac under one Apple ID. iCloud syncs Study Sets, notes, and review progress. Native Apple Pencil support on iPad.
—
Questions? Email service@marginnote.com
Terms: https://dist.marginnote.com/MarginNote_Terms_and_Conditions.pdf
Privacy: https://dist.marginnote.com/MarginNote_Privacy_Policy.pdf

bluejetty:00149353:ios.name: Pocket Geek Mobile
bluejetty:00149353:ios.summary: Pocket Geek® Mobile is your personal tech genius that works behind the scenes to help keep your device secure and running smoothly. It also protects your personal data and content, lets you access your protection plan benefits from one conv
bluejetty:00149353:ios.description:
Pocket Geek® Mobile is your personal tech genius that works behind the scenes to help keep your device secure and running smoothly. It also protects your personal data and content, lets you access your protection plan benefits from one convenient place, and even provides one-tap access to get live support though call or chat. 
You’ll feel more empowered to manage your own device with self-service troubleshooting, helpful tips, and built-in protection features. Not to mention the ability to safely back up and restore your valuable information and content. Pocket Geek Mobile offers a broad suite of tools* to optimize your device’s overall health and performance, and protects you and your information. 
The Pocket Geek Mobile app provides the tools you need to make the most of your mobile device. And smart solutions to help you thrive in a connected world. 
• Avast’s Award-Winning Cybersecurity — Block malware-infected links and fake websites commonly used in phishing attacks.
• Coverage Center — View program features and benefits, check your service fees and deductibles, review your coverage documents and full program details, and file and track a claim. All in one place.
• Live Tech Support — Enjoy firsthand support from tech pros via chat, call, screen share, or camera share. Access fast solutions to tech challenges. Learn how to set up, connect, and sync your smart home devices. 
• Device Diagnostics — Get low battery alerts, and test Wi-Fi and network connection speeds.
• Self-Help Center — Access thousands of device-specific tips, tricks, and step-by-step quick fixes. 
• Secure Backup — Securely back up and restore your content with your allotted amount of storage. 
* Features not included with your plan will be disabled.
Why Pocket Geek Mobile?
Navigating the ins and outs of a device can be stressful. 
Constant security threats
Harmful viruses can infiltrate your device and malware can jeopardize your online safety. You can protect your device and the information it contains against viruses or malware with Pocket Geek Mobile. 
Clueless about coverage
If something happens to your device, it’s frustrating when you don’t remember what protection you have, what it covers, and what you need to do next to address the issue and file a claim. With Pocket Geek Mobile, all your important plan details — features and benefits, service fees and deductibles, and policy info — are in one spot. 
Complex configurations
Learning about a new device and its inner workings can be daunting. Figuring out how that device can connect and interact with your other devices is just as puzzling. Pocket Geek Mobile lets you talk or chat with a live tech pro. They’ll answer questions about your phone, help you connect and use your phone with other smart devices, and much more. 
Keep your device secure and running smoothly with Pocket Geek Mobile.
Protect your identity and personal information from cybercriminals, and stay away from phishing and malicious websites with advanced VPN technology.

bluejetty:00070033:ios.name: Microsoft Defender: Security
bluejetty:00070033:ios.summary:
Microsoft Defender is an online security app for your personal life[1]and work [2].
Use Microsoft Defender for individuals[1] at home and on the go to stay safer online. Defender is an easy-to-use app that helps keep you and your family one
bluejetty:00070033:ios.description:
Microsoft Defender is an online security app for your personal life[1]and work [2].
Use Microsoft Defender for individuals[1] at home and on the go to stay safer online. Defender is an easy-to-use app that helps keep you and your family one step ahead of threats. Microsoft Defender for individuals is available exclusively with a Microsoft 365 Personal or Family subscription.
All-in-one security app
Protect your personal identity, and devices against malicious threats with antivirus scanning[3], threat monitoring[4], multidevice alerts, and expert guidance.
Manage your security in one place
▪ Check the security status of your family’s devices and identity[5].
▪ Get threat alerts, notifications, and recommended steps across your devices.
▪ Receive security tips and take recommended actions to improve your online security.
Safeguard your family’s personal information
▪ Threats to your identity and personal identifying information[4] are continuously scanned on the dark web.
▪ Get credit monitoring with timely alerts and monthly credit reports.[6]
▪ Call an identity theft restoration expert anytime day or night if you need help.
▪ Get identity insurance coverage, up to USD1 million, to help cover legal and expert fees associated with restoration. Insurance coverage includes up to USD100,000 to recover lost funds.[7]
Trusted device and data protection
▪ Anti-phishing protection for your and your family’s devices against new and existing threats [3].
▪ Continuously scans for harmful links before you click on them to help protect you from malicious threats.
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint[2] is an industry-leading, cloud-powered endpoint security solution that helps to secure against ransomware, file-less malware, and other sophisticated attacks across platforms.
1. Microsoft 365 Family or Personal subscription required. Sign in with your Microsoft account. App is currently not available in certain Microsoft 365 Personal or Family regions.
2. If you are a member of a business or organization, login with your work or school email. Your school or business is required to have a valid license or subscription.
3. Does not replace existing malware protection on iOS and Windows devices.
4. Feature is available in the United States and US territories.
5. A one-time parent or legal guardian verification is required to receive dark web threat alert details for children. If the organizer’s family member is under 13, consent is not required to create and/or monitor a child’s identity. Consent is required to create and/or monitor identity of family members over 13 years of age.
6. Feature available in the United States and US territories. Credit score is a single bureau VantageScore 3.0 provided by Experian®. The monthly credit report is provided by Experian® using single bureau data. For users under the age of 18 or those without a credit history, credit score not included. Family organizers will not have the ability to onboard, view, and receive alerts related to family member credit monitoring. Your device's primary display language must be set to English.
7. The identity theft insurance is underwritten and administered by American Bankers Insurance Company of Florida, an Assurant company. Please refer to the actual policies for terms, conditions, and exclusions of coverage. Coverage may not be available in all jurisdictions. Review the Summary of Benefits: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/microsoft-365/summary-of-benefits-for-itm.

bluejetty:00152727:ios.description:
CountiQ makes multi-currency money tracking finally simple. Log income, expenses, and debts per contact in their original currencies (USD, EUR, SAR, and 200+ more), then see a unified balance in your base currency—instantly. With live FX rates updated every 30 seconds, clean PDF exports, and built-in AI insights, CountiQ is the easiest way to keep personal and freelance finances crystal-clear.
Made for people who live in more than one currency
Expats and frequent travelers
Freelancers paid in USD/EUR while spending locally
Online sellers and side hustlers with cross-border clients
Anyone who tracks what “Ahmed owes” across multiple partial payments
Why CountiQ
Track debts per contact: Record multiple payments for the same person in different currencies and let CountiQ handle the math.
200+ currencies with live FX (30s): Enter amounts “as received”—no manual conversion.
Unified balances: View totals in your base currency and per contact/project.
Clean, shareable PDFs: Export professional statements (income, expense, net) in a click.
AI assist: Ask quick questions (“Where did my money go this month?”) and get concise summaries.
Modern, comfortable UI: Fast, minimal, and designed for focus.
No ads: Stay productive without interruptions.
Secure sign-in: Sign in with Apple or Google.
Multi-language: English, Arabic, Turkish, French, German (more coming).
How it works (in 60 seconds)
Add a contact.
Log two payments in different currencies (e.g., EUR + USD).
Instantly see the combined balance in your base currency.
Export a tidy PDF or ask AI for a quick summary.
Free launch period
Enjoy all features free for 60 days from launch. After that, pick the plan that fits:
Free — up to 5 clients, 40 transactions, 10 PDFs, 10 AI prompts, 3 currencies, basic invoice storage.
Pro — everything you need with generous limits: $1.22/month or $9.90/year.
(Prices may vary by region. Taxes handled by the stores.)
Transparency you can trust
FX rates refresh every 30 seconds. Each entry stores its original currency and timestamp for clarity.
Totals are shown using mid-market style conversions for a fair, comprehensible view.
CountiQ provides insights, not financial advice.
Whether you’re tracking what friends owe after a trip, billing clients across borders, or simply keeping personal budgets straight, CountiQ gives you the clarity you’ve been missing—fast.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
CountiQ Pro – Monthly
• Duration: 1 month (auto-renewing)
• Price: US $1.19 / month (price varies by region; taxes may apply)
CountiQ Pro – Yearly
• Duration: 12 months (auto-renewing)
• Price: US $9.99 / year (~US $0.83/month; price varies by region; taxes may apply)
What you get (both plans)
• Unlimited use of all Pro features
• Unlimited transactions
• Multi-currency with real-time FX
• PDF exports
• Advanced budgeting & categories
• Smart reminders
• Priority support
Billing & Renewal
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
Legal
• Privacy Policy: https://countiq.app/privacy
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00071113:ios.summary:
Golf simulation meets fast-paced competition on real courses! 
Ultimate Golf is the free real-time multiplayer golf game where you duel rivals worldwide in live tournaments, head-to-head matches, and Golf Royale battles.
Made for golf love
bluejetty:00071113:ios.description:
Golf simulation meets fast-paced competition on real courses! 
Ultimate Golf is the free real-time multiplayer golf game where you duel rivals worldwide in live tournaments, head-to-head matches, and Golf Royale battles.
Made for golf lovers, competitive players, and sports gamers chasing the top of the leaderboard.
BUILT FOR AN AUTHENTIC GOLF EXPERIENCE
Every swing runs on realistic 3D physics, so reading the wind, judging the slope, working the rough, and landing your approach feels like real golfing. Master shot shaping, spin control and club selection to pull off the perfect shot.
PLAY REAL COURSES
Tee off at Pebble Beach, Harbour Town Golf Links, Bay Hill Club & Lodge, Torrey Pines Golf Course, Sedgefield Country Club, and 30+ other legendary courses — a real-world golf tour, right in your pocket.
REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER GOLF
Forget waiting for turns. Everyone plays at once in fast-paced, simultaneous head-to-head matches, the quickest way to settle who's the better golfer.
• Live 1v1 duels against rivals worldwide
• Daily and multi-day tournaments
• Golf Royale: up to 20 players race to the pin at once
GEAR UP YOUR WAY
Unlock and upgrade dozens of golf clubs, each with unique attributes, and collect specialty golf balls that reward different ways of playing: from power drivers to precision putters. Fine-tune your loadout for every course and condition.
GROW YOUR GOLF SKILLS
Real 3D physics and lifelike conditions let you practice like it's the real thing.
• Upgrade your gear and test it on iconic courses
• Win real-time duels to unlock rewards
• Sharpen every part of your game, from the tee to the putt, with satisfying, skill-based shots
CLIMB THE RANKS
Win matches, stack rewards, and move up from Amateur through the Tour Pro Leagues. Every round is a step toward the top of the leaderboard.
JOIN MILLIONS OF GOLFERS
Ultimate Golf is one of the most popular golf games on mobile, with 13M+ players worldwide and a 4.7-star rating. New courses and tournaments drop regularly, so there's always a fresh reason to tee off.
FEATURES AT A GLANCE
• Free real-time multiplayer golf game
• Stunning real-world courses, faithfully recreated in 3D
• Simultaneous head-to-head and Golf Royale modes
• Competitive daily and multi-day tournaments
• Realistic ball physics, wind, spin and club selection
• Golf clubs and golf balls to unlock, upgrade and collect
START PLAYING
Ultimate Golf is free to play, with real-time multiplayer at its core — duel rivals, climb the leaderboard, and master real-world courses whenever you've got a few minutes. No turn-waiting, no downtime. Grab your clubs and start your journey to becoming an ultimate golf champion!
PLAY YOUR WAY, FREE
Jump into a quick match or grind the tournament ladder! Ultimate Golf is free to play and built around live, skill-based competition against real golfers worldwide. Progress at your own pace across 13+ tiers of competitive play.
A network connection is required to play.
This game includes optional in-game purchases (includes random items).

Watch any web video, online movie, livestream or live TV show on your Samsung Smart TV or Blu-ray Player. Enjoy the show on your big screen with the no#1 web video streamer.

bluejetty:00026068:ios.description:
Lost your AirPods, headphones, or another Bluetooth device? Find it fast with a live BLE radar, signal strength, and distance hints—before the battery runs out.
Scan nearby Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices in seconds and walk toward the strongest signal.
HOW TO USE
1. Open the app and scan for nearby BLE devices.
2. Select the device you want to find from the list.
3. Move slowly while watching the radar, signal strength, and estimated distance.
4. When you are within a few meters, look around—your device is close.
KEY FEATURES
• Live scan for nearby Bluetooth Low Energy devices
• Radar view with signal strength and distance estimates
• Fast guidance to help you locate lost earbuds, headphones, speakers, watches, and more
• Clean, modern interface designed for quick recovery
COMPATIBLE DEVICES
Works with many BLE devices that are powered on and advertising, including:
• Wireless earbuds and AirPods
• Bluetooth headphones and headsets
• Portable Bluetooth speakers
• Smartwatches and fitness wearables
• AirTag and other BLE accessories
IMPORTANT
Your device must be turned on and broadcasting a Bluetooth signal to appear. Classic Bluetooth-only devices may not be detectable.

Ideal for architects, interior designers, landscape architects, industrial designers, urban planners, lighting designers, engineers, or members of any creative culture, Trace lets you create intelligent sketches & drawings to meet all of your design needs. Draw on top of images, PDFs, maps, photos, drawing sets, 3D models, background templates, and more TO SCALE using exceptional designer tools, brushes and pens. Bring new life to your design process and transform your workflow with the ease, flexibility and the magic of digital hand sketching.
______________
THINGS YOU CAN DO:
DESIGN
• Develop ideas, options & concepts
• Sketch buildings & objects
• Layout home, office & landscape renovations 
MARKUP
• Drawing sets & PDFs
• Construction site photos

DRAW

• Site plans & landscaping 
• Illustrations & presentation images
WORK
• Make & export drawing sets
• Scale & measure drawings or images
• Organize by project
______________

-Up to 5 Projects

-Export Images, PDFs or Sets

bluejetty:00162380:ios.name: Jungle: AI Flashcards & Quiz
bluejetty:00162380:ios.summary:
Studying doesn't have to suck.
Jungle makes great studying easy and fun for over 1 million students so you can now get As in half the time!
Turn your lecture slides or any class material (PDFs, word docs, youtube videos, etc.) into a quiz
bluejetty:00162380:ios.description:
Studying doesn't have to suck.
Jungle makes great studying easy and fun for over 1 million students so you can now get As in half the time!
Turn your lecture slides or any class material (PDFs, word docs, youtube videos, etc.) into a quiz with practice questions, flashcards, and multiple choice questions, in seconds. As you answer questions, you get immediate feedback from the AI on what you got right & wrong so that you can immediately identify the gap in your understanding.
As you answer questions you grow a tree. After each study session your character canoes farther down the river looking for new trees.
It's as if AI, Quizlet, and Duolingo had a baby.
Key Features
- Generate quizzes in seconds
- Get personalized feedback after you answer a question
- Chat with your document/video to ask questions when you're still confused
- Get personalized analogies and explanations to help you understand better
- Get a daily spaced repetition review to help you focus on the topics you most need to improve on (similar to Anki)
- Track your progress to stay motivated (we have a Jungle tree that grows as you learn and grow)
Our goal is to make top learning science research super easy and convenient to integrate into your study routine. And to try and make studying less boring while we’re at it!
File Formats you can generate questions from:
- PDFs
- Word Documents
- Powerpoints
- Video / Audio files
- YouTube videos
- Google Drive links
- URL of a webpage
Use Cases:
- AI generated flashcards
- AI generated multiple choice questions
- AI Quizzes
- PDF to Flashcards
- PDF to Quizzes
- Powerpoint to Flashcards
- Video to Flashcards
- YouTube to Flashcards
The wild animals in the Jungle are excited to learn with you! Join our community of over 1 million students and take your studying to the next level.

Get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate fusion of dress and makeup fashion with the Dress Up Fashion Stylist Game. Do you desire fashion, makeup, and style games and want to become a top stylist? Now, flaunt your styling skills in this fun dress-up game and keep up with fashion trends around the world.
If you adore fashion and want to create your style with the fun of playing a game, this is the perfect destination for you. This game has various styles like party, formal, casual, wedding, and more. Become a top-notch fashion designer, enhance your fashion sense with each look you style, and enjoy being a fashion influencer.
Dress Up Fashion Stylist Game brings much more than dress up; you have thousands of makeup options, hair styles, jewelry, shoes, accessories, and more! Create the best looks with your fashion prowess, and share them with your friends. This girls' game showcases body-positive styles, with models in 3 different sizes and a wide range of skin tones. Unleash your fashion designer skills and design stylish princess and supermodel looks that will turn heads on the runway.

* Daily Reward - Get extra daily rewards that will help you design top dress up styles to become a top stylist & fashion designer! Win rewards with spin wheels, scratch cards, and more!
*Vote & Win - Flaunt your Fashion prowess! Submit your best looks, earn event tickets, and vote for styles from other fashionistas to win fabulous in-game rewards!
Never stay out of style, and make fashion your middle name. This game brings you everything that you wish to have to create your own fashion line, makeup studio, and hair salon.

Have you ever experienced the frustration of misplacing your AirPods, case, Apple Pencil, or any other wireless device? With this Finder, those worries are a thing of the past!
Finder is a powerful app designed to help you effortlessly locate your lost devices. Using advanced Bluetooth technology, it quickly tracks the signals emitted by your wireless devices, providing you with real-time distance information.
No more frantic searching or wasted time. Simply launch Finder and let its intuitive interface guide you towards your misplaced device. The app's accurate distance indicator shows you how close you are, making your search efficient and stress-free.

Say goodbye to the frustration and hello to peace of mind. Download Finder now and let it be your go-to app for finding your misplaced wireless devices. Simplify your life and regain control with Finder.

bluejetty:00038888:ios.description:
카카오페이 하나로
모두가 금융할 수 있도록
“마음 놓고 금융하다, 카카오페이”
카카오페이, 이렇게 써보세요
■ 결제
 - 어느 탭에 있든 '결제' 탭 두 번 누르면 결제 준비 끝
 - 결제혜택도 맞춤으로, 가까운 혜택까지 다 챙겨서 결제
 - 멤버십 적립, 만료 가까워진 쿠폰도, 알고 있으면 유용한 결제 팁까지 한 번에 확인하고 결제
 - 제로페이도 되니까! 어디서나 카카오페이로 결제
 - 위젯만 있다면 잠금 화면에서도 바로 결제
 - 손목만 내밀면 끝! 애플워치로 결제
 - 생체 인증으로 빠르고 편하게 결제, 바코드와 QR코드로 장소 제한 없이 결제
■ 자산
 - 송금, 결제, 카드, 계좌, 보험, 대출, 투자까지 돈 쓸 일 많은 요즘, 
 번거로운 공인인증서 없이 가능한 자산관리
■ 증권
 - 투자에 필요한 맞춤 정보 제공, 다양하고 빠른 주식 주문 경험
 - 간편하게 시작하고 자동으로 수익을 쌓는 주식 모으기
 - 세액공제도 받고 투자 수익도 내는 연금저축
 - 거스름돈도 모으면 태산! 부담없이 시작하는 펀드 동전모으기
■ 보험
 - 가입한 모든 보험, 카카오페이에서 가입 내역부터 보장 내용까지 간편 관리 
 - 복잡한 서류 제출 없이, 간편한 병원비 청구
 - 자동차보험 고민 끝! 10개 보험사 비교로 내 차에 꼭 맞는 자동차보험 찾기
 - 카카오페이에서만 경험 할 수 있는 특별한 보험상품도 만나보세요
■ 혜택
 - 출석체크, 퀴즈타임, 매일모으기, 만보기 등 재미있는 혜택 서비스로 현금처럼 사용할 수 있는 페이포인트를 매일! 쉽게! 모아보세요.
■ 송금
 - 계좌번호 몰라도, 카톡 친구가 아니어도 바로 송금할 수 있는 내 주변 송금
 - 모임 회비, 용돈, 경조사비 등 깜박하지 않고 원하는 주기와 날짜에 예약 송금, 자동 이체
 - 카톡 친구에게 보낼 때, 카카오페이에 등록한 내 계좌로 보낼 때 무료로 송금
■ 안심하고 사용하세요
 - 핀테크 업계 최초, 금융보안원 정보보호 개인 정보 관리체계(ISMS-P) 통합 인증
 - 빅데이터・AI 기반 이상거래 감지시스템(FDS) 구축
■ 꼭 필요한 권한만 확인해요
 - 정보통신망법 제22조의 2(접근 권한에 대한 동의)에 따라 아래와 같이 카카오페이 앱 사용 시 필요한 접근 권한을 안내해드려요.
선택 권한 (선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스 사용이 가능해요)
 - 알림: 서비스 이용 시 필수 알림 수신
 - 카메라 / 마이크: 송금 및 결제 시 코드 스캔 또는 촬영 등
 - 위치: 송금 및 결제 시 위치 확인
 - 사진: QR 코드 이미지 저장
 - Face ID: 카카오페이 비밀번호 및 화면잠금 비밀번호 입력을 대체
 - 동작 및 피트니스: 만보기 걸음수 확인
 - 블루투스/로컬네트워크: 송금 가능한 주변인 탐색
 * 선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스 사용이 가능해요.
■ 당신을 위해 열려있어요
 - 카카오페이 고객센터 챗봇(카카오톡): 24시간, 365일 상시
 - 상담사 연결: 평일 9시~17시 30분
 - 고객센터: 1644-7405 (평일 9시~18시)
 - 분실 및 도용신고: 1833-7483 (24시간)

bluejetty:00022072:ios.name: Pikmykid Parent
bluejetty:00022072:ios.summary:
Enjoy saving time and feeling peace of mind with the award-winning Pikmykid Parent App which makes school arrivals and dismissals safe and easy!
Stay fully in control of your children's pickup schedule and make any plan changes with just a
bluejetty:00022072:ios.description:
Enjoy saving time and feeling peace of mind with the award-winning Pikmykid Parent App which makes school arrivals and dismissals safe and easy!
Stay fully in control of your children's pickup schedule and make any plan changes with just a few clicks
Should an emergency occur, you have the peace of mind knowing that your kids are safe by receiving communication in real time during reunifications.
With the Pikmykid Parent App, you’ll spend less time waiting in pick-up lines and being put on-hold on the telephone, and instead have everything you need for a safe and stress-free experience daily.
The Pikmykid Parent app gives you a simpler way to manage your kid’s school transportation, pickup delegation, and daily and emergency communications.
“Pikmykid is an extremely user-friendly and simple solution that provides a safe, quick pickup at school without the chaos of after school traffic. Love it!” 
Richard O., Parent
HOW PIKMYKID HELPS
> Take Stress Out of the Picture
You should be empowered with a tool that makes coordinating your kids’ transportation plans so easy, you never have to call the front office again. 
> Experience Stellar Communication
As you make dismissal changes, school staff can see exactly when to release your student, who to release them to, and can notify you they’re been safely dismissed.
> Stop Wasting Time & Enjoy Rest
With smooth dismissals, parents spend on average 33-50% less time in the car line. This means you’ll have more time to spend with your kids outside of school.
> Feel Safer During the School Day
With a platform that helps prevent accidents, stranger danger, custody battles, and exposure to harsh weather, you can feel safer sending your kids to school.
HOW IT WORKS
> Manage It All From One Place
Whether you need to communicate that your kid will be going home with a friend, or need to schedule an early release for a doctor’s appointment, Pikmykid lets you manage the process simply. 
> Make Dismissal Changes
You no longer need to call the front office to make dismissal changes. Instead you can instantly update how and with whom your kid will go home, and even schedule future carpools.
> Announce Your Arrival
You’ll be able to announce your arrival on the app so the teacher knows to send out your kid. The car line moves quickly and staff can verify the right person is picking up your kid as well.
> Receive Dismissal Notifications
Once dismissed, you’ll receive a notification on your app letting you know. You can also receive info from school like when a bus is running late or about an upcoming field trip.
HOW IT WORKS TO MAKE SCHOOL SAFER
> During Dismissal Your School Is Able To:
Verify pickup permissions.
Timestamp each student’s dismissal.
Maintain early dismissal changes.
Know with whom students are meant to go with.
Minimize custody issues.
Communicate consistently and clearly.
Maintain accurate attendance records.
> During an Emergency You Can:
Get notified quickly about an emergency.
Receive instructions on what to do & where to go.
Know when your kid is dismissed & to whom.
Reunite quickly during extreme emergencies.
HOW PIKMYKID SUPPORTS YOU
> World-Class Support
> Reliable Technology
> Based on Safety Best Practices
> Prioritizing Student Privacy
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
“The best part of Pikmykid is you don’t have to make the annoying phone calls or leave your meetings to let them know that the transportation has changed. You go on your app, make the change, and it’s done.” 
Jade G., Parent
“The app is great! It’s simple to use and it really streamlines the school pickup process. I’m most impressed with Pikmykid’s customer service! They respond quickly and in a very personalized manner.” 
Sue A., Parent

bluejetty:00157186:ios.name: Morrisville Smart Shuttle
bluejetty:00157186:ios.summary: Live Connected with the Morrisville Smart Shuttle! Think of the Smart Shuttle as a whole new way to get around Morrisville — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and green. The Smart Shuttle serves designated nodes in and around Morr
bluejetty:00157186:ios.description:
Live Connected with the Morrisville Smart Shuttle! Think of the Smart Shuttle as a whole new way to get around Morrisville — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and green. The Smart Shuttle serves designated nodes in and around Morrisville to help you get around town. 
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
· Book a ride on your phone.
· Get picked up at a nearby node.
· Share your ride with others.
· Save money and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SMART.
Request a pick up at a designated node using the app to get to destinations such as parks, shopping centers, school or even connect to other transit services!
SHARED.
Our node-based algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Morrisville a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Check us out at www.townofmorrisville.org/smartshuttle
or reach out to smartshuttle@townofmorrisville.org. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
 
How it works:
· Book a ride on your phone.
· Get picked up at a nearby node.
· Share your ride with others.
· Save money and reduce carbon emissions.
 
What we’re about:
SMART.
Request a pick up at a designated node using the app to get to destinations such as parks, shopping centers, school or even connect to other transit services!
 
SHARED.
Our node-based algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Morrisville a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
 
Questions? Check us out at www.townofmorrisville.org/smartshuttle
or reach out to smartshuttle@townofmorrisville.org. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00094659:ios.name: Vampire's Fall 2 RPG
bluejetty:00094659:ios.summary: Vampire's Fall 2 is the highly-anticipated sequel to the dark fantasy RPG classic Vampire’s Fall: Origins, which captivated over 10 million players worldwide. Dive back into a realm shrouded in darkness, mystery, and peril. Whether you're a
bluejetty:00094659:ios.description:
Vampire's Fall 2 is the highly-anticipated sequel to the dark fantasy RPG classic Vampire’s Fall: Origins, which captivated over 10 million players worldwide. Dive back into a realm shrouded in darkness, mystery, and peril. Whether you're a returning champion or a new adventurer seeking your destiny, Vampire's Fall 2 delivers an immersive RPG experience filled with vampires, intrigue, and tactical depth.
Set in a richly crafted 2D open world, Vampire's Fall 2 offers a seamless gameplay experience—no loading screens between exploration and combat. Witness your character's every detail, from armor to weapons, directly in the immersive world view. Engage enemies strategically, with battles occurring directly within the exploration mode, drawing you deeper into its atmospheric darkness.
Embark on a thrilling journey as you become a vampire early in the story, unlocking powerful abilities and new strategic gameplay elements. Your progression in Vampire's Fall 2 is enhanced by a refined leveling system, offering randomized bonuses at each level-up, allowing you to deeply customize your combat style—prioritizing health, agility, magical power, or tactical prowess.
Explore a living world filled with vibrant details and engaging interactions. NPCs realistically move around, following their daily routines and adding layers of immersion. With no random encounters, you have the freedom to choose your battles, confronting visible threats strategically. Engage in tactical battles that allow you to use HP and FP potions strategically, each action consuming precious turns and demanding thoughtful decisions.
Discover an expanded arsenal with six special weapon types, including the dagger and katana, offering deeper customization and tactical flexibility. The world itself is more densely crafted, minimizing empty space and maximizing your adventure time, ensuring less running around and more meaningful exploration.
Vampire's Fall 2 also offers integrated chat functionality, conveniently placed within the UI, enabling you to communicate effortlessly while continuing your adventure uninterrupted. PvP combat is available from day one, allowing you to immediately test your skills and tactics against other players.
Step into the shoes of an enigmatic hero, transformed by the shadows, whose choices shape the world around them. Do you have what it takes to master your vampiric powers and confront the darkness?
Adventure awaits—embrace your destiny in the world of Vampire's Fall 2.

bluejetty:00165999:ios.description:
PLAY, MANAGE, COLLECT, and COMPETE on the go!
Build and strategize MyTEAM basketball lineups with NBA 2K25 MyTEAM! Manage and assemble your legendary NBA lineup on the go, collecting your favorite NBA basketball stars through rewards and the Auction House, and enjoy the ability to compete in a variety of MyTEAM modes wherever you want, whenever you want.
NBA 2K25 MyTEAM bridges the gap between console and mobile by providing an online experience that connects your PlayStation or Xbox account with your mobile to sync your progress and continue leveling up with cross-progression compatibility. Piece together a Hall-of-Fame basketball lineup with today's superstars and legends of the game to expand your ever-growing collection as you challenge rival MyTEAM rosters. NBA 2K25 MyTEAM is perfect for fans of competitive basketball games, offering fast-paced action and deep strategy both on and off the court.
▶ CROSS-PROGRESSION AND CONNECTIVITY ◀
Authenticate with your XBOX or PlayStation account to enable cross-progression between mobile and console. Whether you're using PlayStation Remote Play or Xbox, your achievements, lineups, and rewards stay with you.
You can also play as a Guest, or Apple login, to manage your roster and enjoy MyTEAM exclusively on mobile.
Full controller support is available using your favorite compatible Bluetooth Controller. Navigate the menu and dominate on the court with ease—gaming on the go just got even better! This is the ultimate basketball game for fans looking to dominate on mobile.
▶ BUY & SELL AT THE AUCTION HOUSE ◀
The Auction House gives you access to buy and sell players on the go! Browse the marketplace for that coveted NBA legend to complete your basketball dream team or place players up for auction to dominate the court. The Auction House ensures collecting and managing your roster is fast and seamless.
▶ COMPETE IN A VARIETY OF FORMATS ◀
Experience a range of competitive game modes:
Breakout Mode: Navigate a dynamic board filled with challenges and arenas.
Triple Threat 3v3, Clutch Time 5v5, or full NBA lineup matches with shortened game durations to earn exclusive rewards.
Showdown Mode: Test your skills and strategies in head-to-head multiplayer battles where you’ll put your 13-card lineup to the test. Show off your lineup and explore these and other classic modes on the go!
Challenge legendary NBA teams or build your unique basketball team to climb the leaderboard. MyTEAM brings the competitive edge of NBA console gaming to your fingertips, making it the ultimate basketball game experience.
▶ BUILD & MANAGE YOUR LINEUP ◀
With 2K25 MyTEAM, you can customize and manage your lineup effortlessly. Experiment with different combinations of players, adjust tactics, and challenge opponents with curated rosters. Earn MyTEAM REP and climb the rankings as you complete exciting challenges and games.
▶ GAMEPLAY THAT EXCITES ◀
Feel responsive gameplay as you drive to the hoop, crossover defenders, and sink clutch shots with stunning graphics.
Enjoy full Bluetooth controller support for immersive gaming, giving you the freedom to play your way. Whether you’re fine-tuning your lineup or making big plays on the court, 2K25 MyTEAM ensures a console-level experience wherever you are. Experience next-level mobile basketball games with cross-platform play and competitive modes in NBA 2K25 MyTEAM.
Requires internet connection and iPhone 8 or above with 4+ GB of RAM.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa
Use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service (ToS) found at www.take2games.com/legal. Online and certain special features require an internet connection, may not be available to all users or at all times, and may be terminated, modified, or offered under different terms without notice. For more information on the availability of online features and services visit https://bit.ly/2K-Online-Services-Status.

bluejetty:00091020:ios.description:
ABOUT POCKETAPP
The better way to manage your everyday spending.
PocketApp is your everyday lifestyle and payments app that helps you send, receive and manage your money efficiently.
PocketApp is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria as a Mobile Money Operator, with funds insured by the NDIC.
HOW DOES POCKETAPP WORK?
PocketApp gives you different ways to manage your money, whether you’re handling everyday spending, planning your salary, paying for essentials, managing money with a group or sharing expenses with your friends.
Personal Pocket
Your Personal Pocket is where you manage your everyday money.
Send money to other Pocket users
Transfer money to any bank in Nigeria
Receive money directly into your Pocket
Pay bills quickly
Enable salary manager to plan your monthly spending
Salary Manager
Make your salary last from payday to payday.
Salary Manager helps you plan your income and organise your expenses, so you have a clearer picture of where your money is going throughout the month.
Plan how you want to use your salary
Set money aside for different expenses
Stay on top of your monthly spending
Manage your income with more structure
Pocket Groups
Manage money together with the people in your life.
Pocket Groups makes it easier to organise and manage money with friends, family, teams, households, communities, and other groups.
Create a Group Pocket for shared money
Manage funds with groups of 2–200 people
Set rules for how members can access funds
Give members visibility into group transactions
Manage contributions, household expenses, and day-to-day group spending

bluejetty:00131932:ios.description:
The free Prime app connects you to the most up-to-date journal citations and abstracts from the complete PubMed database. In addition to the ability to perform powerful searches and link to the publisher’s full text articles, Prime also provides a number of exclusive tools not available anywhere else creating a one-of-a-kind user experience.
PRIME FEATURES
- Search: Perform evidence-based searches by keyword, author, or journal then link to full text articles. 
- Organize: Bookmark and Tag important articles and searches to quickly return to them later
- Share: Share articles directly from the app via Email, Twitter, Facebook, SMS, Dropbox, and more
EXCLUSIVE TOOLS 
- Grapherence®: Unbound’s unique search option allows you to visually explore the influence and interrelationships among journal articles
- For You: Discover new articles in a feed designed specifically for you based on how you use the app
- Browse: Select specific journals you want to follow and receive alerts when new articles are published
WHAT IS GRAPHERENCE?
Grapherence® is Unbound’s interactive search that graphically represents the influence and interrelationships among journal articles. Tap the Grapherence button within a citation and instantly see how that article is related to others. Using this exclusive feature the researcher quickly uncovers difficult to find entries, determines overall significance, identifies clusters of thought, and locates seminal articles. 
ABOUT UNBOUND MEDICINE
With 50+ premium apps available, Unbound Medicine combines powerful software with best-selling content to deliver clinical answers wherever you need them. Top-selling apps include Johns Hopkins Antibiotic (ABX) Guide, Davis’s Drug Guide, 5-Minute Clinical Consult, Harriet Lane Handbook, The Washington Manual, Nursing Central™, and Diagnosaurus DDx.
